| CHI SIAMO
Dale Group, società di Consulenza Informatica specializzata nei settori Banking, Insurance e Financial Services, offre servizi ai principali player internazionali del mercato IT.

Società dedita all'eccellenza e all'impegno costante nel supportare le sfide dei propri clienti, fornisce soluzioni personalizzate contribuendo alla realizzazione e alla gestione di prodotti, servizi e strumenti ad alto valore strategico.
| DI COSA TI OCCUPERAI

Entrerai a far parte di un contesto strutturato e altamente dinamico, contribuendo allo sviluppo di dashboard e reportistica avanzata per supportare i processi decisionali e il monitoraggio delle performance aziendali.

Lavorerai a stretto contatto con stakeholder di business e team tecnici per raccogliere i requisiti, analizzare i dati e realizzare soluzioni di reporting efficaci e orientate alle esigenze del cliente.
In particolare ti occuperai di:
Raccogliere e analizzare i requisiti di business relativi alla reportistica
Progettare, sviluppare e manutenere dashboard e report interattivi tramite Power BI
Analizzare grandi volumi di dati provenienti da differenti fonti informative
Definire KPI e metriche a supporto delle esigenze di business
Garantire la qualità, la coerenza e l'affidabilità dei dati rappresentati nei report
Collaborare con i team IT e con gli stakeholder di business per l'evoluzione delle soluzioni di reporting
Supportare l'ottimizzazione dei processi di analisi e visualizzazione del dato.
| COSA RICHIEDIAMO
Laurea in discipline Economiche o affini
Almeno 4 anni di esperienza come Data Analyst o BI Analyst
Ottima conoscenza di Microsoft Power BI per lo sviluppo di dashboard e reportistica avanzata
Esperienza nella modellazione dei dati e nella definizione di KPI
Buona conoscenza di SQL per interrogazione e analisi dei dati
Esperienza maturata in contesti Banking e/o Insurance
Capacità di interfacciarsi con stakeholder di business e tradurre le esigenze funzionali in soluzioni di reporting
Ottime capacità analitiche, organizzative e di problem solving.
| COSA OFFRIAMO?
Inserimento su progetti strategici presso primari clienti dei settori Banking e Insurance
Ambiente strutturato e orientato all'innovazione
Opportunità di crescita professionale e sviluppo di competenze su progetti ad alto valore aggiunto.
Sede di riferimento operativa: Milano
Modalità di lavoro: ibrida (3+2)
Contratto: tempo indeterminato.
L’offerta si rivolge a candidati ambosessi, nel rispetto del Codice delle pari opportunità D.Lgs. 11 aprile 2006, N. 198 e ss.mm.ii.

4452235823,https://it.linkedin.com/jobs/view/senior-data-analyst-at-subito-4452235823?position=2&pageNum=0&refId=3%2FZ2lRvDYUJtVqLpMxIM2g%3D%3D&trackingId=uGoBcvoceX%2FWA4RdOMrNyA%3D%3D,Senior Data Analyst,Subito,"Milan, Lombardy, Italy","Job Description
Ciao, siamo Subito! 🚀

Hai presente quell'app che quasi ogni italiano ha installata sul telefono? Ecco, quella è casa nostra. Subito è il marketplace leader in Italia: un posto dove milioni di persone comprano, vendono e danno una seconda vita agli oggetti ogni giorno. Siamo un brand amato, con una valutazione di 4.8 stelle e una community vastissima, ma non ci sediamo sugli allori. Vogliamo trasformare ogni singolo dato in un'opportunità per rendere l'esperienza dei nostri utenti sempre più fluida, sicura e intelligente.
Il tuo posto nel team Data

Stiamo cercando un Senior Data Analyst che abbia la passione per i numeri e la capacità di trasformarli in narrazioni efficaci. Entrerai a far parte del team Data Analytics, il cui compito è estrarre valore dai dati per comprendere a fondo il mercato italiano. Studierai il comportamento degli utenti, valuterai le iniziative strategiche e sperimenterai nuove feature. Soprattutto, il tuo lavoro avrà un impatto diretto sulla crescita del nostro business.
Job Requirements
Cosa andrai a fare?
In Subito, i dati non sono solo numeri, ma la bussola che guida ogni nostra decisione:
Genererai Insight ad alto valore: Analizzerai i dati per supportare il business con insights rilevanti (funnel analysis, trend e pattern comportamentali) e presenterai i risultati agli stakeholder.
Democratizzerai il dato: Progetterai report e dashboard automatizzate e intuitive, permettendo a tutta l'azienda di accedere ai dati in modo semplice e immediato.

Modellerai il business: Imparerai a conoscere e aiuterai a progettare il nostro Data Lake per estrarre il massimo valore possibile dai dati e modellare al meglio le nostre logiche di business (data modeling).
Sperimenterai sul campo: Formulerai ipotesi e progetterai esperimenti per valutare l'impatto reale delle nuove feature sui nostri utenti.
Sarai un partner strategico: Collaborerai con gli stakeholder per raccogliere i requisiti e rispondere alle loro domande con l'approccio analitico più efficace.
Job Responsibilities
Come lavoriamo? (Spoiler: amiamo l'eccellenza tecnica)
Abbiamo costruito un ecosistema moderno dove il dato è al centro di tutto:
Tecnologia allo stato dell'arte: Lavoriamo su architettura AWS, utilizzando strumenti per l'estrazione, la manipolazione di dati su larga scala (SQL, Spark, Pandas/Polars).
Cultura del dato: Lavoriamo con il framework OKR (Objectives and Key Results) per garantire che ogni nostra azione sia allineata agli obiettivi aziendali.
Statistica Applicata: Andiamo oltre l’analisi descrittiva
column2: utilizziamo regressioni, analisi delle serie storiche e statistica bayesiana per generare insights profondi e scenari predittivi ad alto impatto.

column1: Data Storytelling: Crediamo che un'analisi sia utile solo se comunicata bene
column2: per questo curiamo molto la visualizzazione e la presentazione dei dati.

column1: Sei la persona giusta se...
Hai più di 5 anni di esperienza come Data Analyst in contesti complessi.
Sei un asso nell'estrazione e manipolazione di dati (SQL, Spark, Pandas, Polars...).
Hai un'ottima conoscenza di Python o R.
La statistica applicata non ha segreti per te (regressioni, ANOVA, analisi serie storiche, etc.).
Sai come trasformare un'analisi complessa in un racconto avvincente.
Bonus points (le ciliegine sulla torta):
Hai esperienza con Tableau e tool di tracciamento (Google Analytics, Snowplow...).
Sai come condurre A/B testing su feature di prodotto.
Hai già lavorato in aziende digitali o su progetti di Data Science.
Job Benefits
Cosa ti offriamo? 🎁
Vogliamo che tu sia stimolato e valorizzato. Il benessere in Subito è un pacchetto completo:
Compensazione & Crescita: RAL 40-55K bonus annuali e opportunità di formazione continua.

Lavoriamo in modalità ibrida, con due giorni a settimana in presenza e tre da remoto. Ci trovi in via Angelo Scarsellini 14 (fermata M3 Affori Centro): abbiamo creato un ufficio open space super luminoso e pieno di comfort, perfetto per collaborare dal vivo ma con tutta la flessibilità di cui hai bisogno. La distanza è troppa? Valutiamo l'opzione del full-remote per casi specifici direttamente durante il processo di interview.
Inclusività in Subito
In Subito accogliamo le persone per quello che sono. La diversità in ogni sua forma — genere, età, nazionalità o orientamento — è la nostra benzina creativa e ci aiuta a crescere insieme.
Ti senti pronto/a? Se hai voglia di far parlare i dati e costruire il futuro del marketplace leader in Italia, inviaci il tuo CV. Non vediamo l'ora di conoscerti! L'iter di selezione prevede:
Quick call con HR
Technical Test & Deep Dive con il Data Team
Call con Head of Data Analytics
Final call con HR e VP of Data & AI (soft skills & values fit)
Cosa aspetti? La tua nuova avventura inizia QUI.

4432346181,https://it.linkedin.com/jobs/view/data-analyst-at-digital360-4432346181?position=3&pageNum=0&refId=3%2FZ2lRvDYUJtVqLpMxIM2g%3D%3D&trackingId=kmWplq2Zv2znmAsK2QNrOA%3D%3D,Data Analyst,Digital360,Greater Milan Metropolitan Area,"Gruppo Digital360 è il gruppo italiano che supporta imprese e Pubblica Amministrazione nella trasformazione digitale, nell’innovazione organizzativa e valorizzazione del brand e posizionamento.

Digital360 unisce rigore accademico e visione imprenditoriale, affiancando le organizzazioni e le imprese, pubbliche e private, con team multidisciplinari che integrano competenze di natura umanistica, economica, tecnologica, legale e organizzativa e riunisce manager, imprenditori e professionisti presenti sul mercato da oltre quarant’anni. All’interno delle sue tre Business Unit – Advisory, GOV e Connect- il Gruppo offre servizi che si sviluppano sui principali pillar della trasformazione digitale, diventando un vero abilitatore dell’evoluzione organizzativa e tecnologica delle aziende e delle organizzazioni.

Nato nel 2012 da un’iniziativa del Politecnico di Milano, il Gruppo Digital360 è oggi una Società Benefit, con headquarter in Italia, a Milano e a Roma, con oltre 1.300 persone e 140M € di ricavi nel 2025.

Attualmente siamo alla ricerca di un Data Analyst appassionato/a, capace di trasformare numeri complessi in storie chiare e strategie vincenti. Il/la candidato/a lavorerà nell’area di Business Information a diretto riporto della direzione IT e si occuperà di raccogliere requisiti e disegnare soluzioni a supporto del business, del board e dell’area finance.
Principali responsabilità:
Analisi e Reporting: estrarre, pulire e analizzare dati provenienti da diverse fonti per supportare il decision-making aziendale.
Data Visualization: progettare e mantenere report interattivi e dashboard d'impatto su Power BI.
Optimization: utilizzare Excel a livelli avanzati per analisi rapide, modelli finanziari o riconciliazioni dati.
Insight strategici: collaborare con i diversi team per identificare trend, anomalie e opportunità di crescita.
Data Quality: monitorare l'integrità dei dati e ottimizzare i processi di raccolta.
Competenze e capacità richieste:
Power BI: conoscenza di Power Query, modellazione dati e linguaggio DAX.
Excel: ottima padronanza (Pivot, Cerca.Vert/XLOOKUP, Formule nidificate, Power Pivot).
Data mindset: capacità di tradurre i requisiti di business in indicatori tecnici (KPI).
Curiosità intellettuale: non ti fermi al ""cosa"", vuoi capire il ""perché"".
Precisione: hai un occhio clinico per il dettaglio.
Comunicazione: sai spiegare dati complessi anche a chi non mastica i numeri.
Requisiti:
Esperienza: Almeno 2-3 anni in ruoli analoghi.
Laurea in Ingegneria Informatica, Informatica o percorsi affini, oppure diploma tecnico con competenze equivalenti.
Cosa offriamo:
Inserimento a tempo indeterminato con CCNL Commercio Terziario
RAL compresa tra 30.000€ e 35.000€, definita in funzione del profilo e dell’esperienza complessivamente maturata
Pacchetto welfare aziendale
Buoni pasto per ogni giorno lavorato.
Perché lavorare con noi:
Entrerai in un gruppo che integra consulenza, tecnologia e comunicazione, lavorando su progetti concreti per imprese e Pubblica Amministrazione.
Avrai l’opportunità di confrontarti con competenze diverse e contribuire a iniziative che uniscono strategia, execution e sviluppo del mercato.
Lavorerai in un contesto in evoluzione, dove sperimentazione e collaborazione sono parte integrante del modo di operare.
Utilizziamo l’AI e strumenti avanzati per supportare le attività quotidiane e migliorare l’efficacia del lavoro.
Offriamo modalità di lavoro flessibili e un ambiente che favorisce autonomia e responsabilità.
Investiamo nella crescita delle persone, attraverso formazione continua e opportunità di sviluppo professionale.

La ricerca rispetta il d.lgs. 198/2006 ed è aperta a persone con disabilità, di qualsiasi orientamento o espressione di genere, orientamento sessuale, età, etnia e credo religioso. Il presente annuncio è stato ideato nel rispetto della diversity e dell’inclusività.
DIGITAL360 S.p.A invita a leggere l'informativa sulla privacy alla pagina: https://servizi.digital360.it/informativa-candidatura-unica

Gruppo Digital360 è il gruppo italiano che supporta imprese e Pubblica Amministrazione nella trasformazione digitale, nell’innovazione organizzativa e valorizzazione del brand e posizionamento.

Digital360 unisce rigore accademico e visione imprenditoriale, affiancando le organizzazioni e le imprese, pubbliche e private, con team multidisciplinari che integrano competenze di natura umanistica, economica, tecnologica, legale e organizzativa e riunisce manager, imprenditori e professionisti presenti sul mercato da oltre quarant’anni. All’interno delle sue tre Business Unit – Advisory, GOV e Connect- il Gruppo offre servizi che si sviluppano sui principali pillar della trasformazione digitale, diventando un vero abilitatore dell’evoluzione organizzativa e tecnologica delle aziende e delle organizzazioni.


Nato nel 2012 da un’iniziativa del Politecnico di Milano, il Gruppo Digital360 è oggi una Società Benefit, con headquarter in Italia, a Milano e a Roma, con oltre 1.300 persone e 140M € di ricavi nel 2025.


Attualmente siamo alla ricerca di un Data Analyst appassionato/a, capace di trasformare numeri complessi in storie chiare e strategie vincenti. Il/la candidato/a lavorerà nell’area di Business Information a diretto riporto della direzione IT e si occuperà di raccogliere requisiti e disegnare soluzioni a supporto del business, del board e dell’area finance.


Principali responsabilità:

  • Analisi e Reporting: estrarre, pulire e analizzare dati provenienti da diverse fonti per supportare il decision-making aziendale.
  • Data Visualization: progettare e mantenere report interattivi e dashboard d'impatto su Power BI.
  • Optimization: utilizzare Excel a livelli avanzati per analisi rapide, modelli finanziari o riconciliazioni dati.
  • Insight strategici: collaborare con i diversi team per identificare trend, anomalie e opportunità di crescita.
  • Data Quality: monitorare l'integrità dei dati e ottimizzare i processi di raccolta.


Competenze e capacità richieste:

  • Power BI: conoscenza di Power Query, modellazione dati e linguaggio DAX.
  • Excel: ottima padronanza (Pivot, Cerca.Vert/XLOOKUP, Formule nidificate, Power Pivot).
  • Data mindset: capacità di tradurre i requisiti di business in indicatori tecnici (KPI).
  • Curiosità intellettuale: non ti fermi al ""cosa"", vuoi capire il ""perché"".
  • Precisione: hai un occhio clinico per il dettaglio.
  • Comunicazione: sai spiegare dati complessi anche a chi non mastica i numeri.


Requisiti:

  • Esperienza: Almeno 2-3 anni in ruoli analoghi.
  • Laurea in Ingegneria Informatica, Informatica o percorsi affini, oppure diploma tecnico con competenze equivalenti.


Cosa offriamo:

  • Inserimento a tempo indeterminato con CCNL Commercio Terziario
  • RAL compresa tra 30.000€ e 35.000€, definita in funzione del profilo e dell’esperienza complessivamente maturata
  • Pacchetto welfare aziendale
  • Buoni pasto per ogni giorno lavorato.


Perché lavorare con noi:

  • Entrerai in un gruppo che integra consulenza, tecnologia e comunicazione, lavorando su progetti concreti per imprese e Pubblica Amministrazione.
  • Avrai l’opportunità di confrontarti con competenze diverse e contribuire a iniziative che uniscono strategia, execution e sviluppo del mercato.
  • Lavorerai in un contesto in evoluzione, dove sperimentazione e collaborazione sono parte integrante del modo di operare.
  • Utilizziamo l’AI e strumenti avanzati per supportare le attività quotidiane e migliorare l’efficacia del lavoro.
  • Offriamo modalità di lavoro flessibili e un ambiente che favorisce autonomia e responsabilità.
  • Investiamo nella crescita delle persone, attraverso formazione continua e opportunità di sviluppo professionale.


La ricerca rispetta il d.lgs. 198/2006 ed è aperta a persone con disabilità, di qualsiasi orientamento o espressione di genere, orientamento sessuale, età, etnia e credo religioso. Il presente annuncio è stato ideato nel rispetto della diversity e dell’inclusività.

  • Diffonde competenze e best practice analitiche verso i team con cui collabora, è punto di riferimento per Business Partner e Performance Leader.



Qualifiche e competenze:

  • Almeno 3 anni di esperienza in ruolo analogo.
  • Padronanza di SQL e buona familiarità con Python.
  • Attitudine problem-first e comprovata esperienza nella capacità di definire il successo di iniziative basandosi su outcome (risultati finali / impatto) vs output (deliverable di progetto).
  • Esperienza con metodologie statistiche e modelli predittivi, in particolare nel ramo disciplinare del marketing e dell’analisi di incrementalità (uplift modeling, causal inference, counterfactual analysis).
  • Conoscenza di strumenti di analisi e visualizzazione dati (es. Power BI, Tableau, Looker)
  • Conoscenza della lingua inglese fluente
  • Plus: Conoscenza applicata di strumenti AI agentici (e.g. Claude Code, Codex).



Cosa offriamo:

  • Percorsi di crescita internazionali – Mobilità interna Gruppo Adeo
  • Formazione continua – training on the job + learning platform digitale
  • Per questa posizione è previsto un range retributivo annuo lordo compreso tra 34.500 e 48.000. La proposta economica sarà commisurata all'esperienza, alle competenze e al percorso professionale, nel rispetto dell'inquadramento previsto per il ruolo.
  • Sistema incentivante e Azionariato diffuso
  • Sconti collaboratori
  • Assistenza sanitaria (FondoEst)



In Leroy Merlin crediamo nella diversità come leva fondamentale per il nostro successo e accogliamo con favore le candidature di tutti i membri della società.


Il tuo percorso in Leroy Merlin inizia da qui! Candidati ora e inizia la tua crescita con noi.

We Welcome Everyone!

This role is part of our commitment to fostering an inclusive workplace: this is why Satispay mainly dedicates this job opportunity to candidates eligible under specific employment protection laws, including those with disabilities or other protected status, in line with Italian law (L.68/99). We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

Still willing to apply for the role? This specific application form is dedicated mainly to candidates with disabilities. However, we value diversity and talent in all its forms, and everyone is welcome to apply for a job at Satispay! If you’re interested in the role, but you’re not a candidate with disabilities, visit the following link and apply here.
About Us
Traditional banking has never really given you control over your financial life. Satispay exists to change that: to empower people through finance.
That means making financial services easy and accessible for over 6.5M users. We started with payments, then benefits, investing, cards... and we’re not done. Not even close.
We follow the same logic every time: find a real problem, solve it properly, then look for the next one. The destination? To build the most loved financial platform in the world.

If you own outcomes rather than tasks, stay close to what users need, and refuse to wait for someone else to fix what's broken — you'll find people here who work exactly in the same way. And together, you'll build something worth being proud of.
What You'll Be Doing

As a Data Analyst, you will be a core member of our Growth & Marketing (G&M) team, taking the data and analytics lead on all Finance initiatives, playing a key role in enhancing decision-making by developing analytical models and self-service data assets that drive impactful solutions for financial planning, reporting, and operational steering.
Here's What That Looks Like In Practice

Build Financial Analytics & Reporting Capabilities - Develop P&L and cash flow analytics, plan vs. actual monitoring models, and financial KPI frameworks that enable Finance to steer the business with accurate, timely data.

Lead Investor Relations Analytics - Serve as the primary analytics and intelligence partner for Satispay's investors including top-tier VC firms, translating business performance into clear, data-driven narratives that maintain and strengthen those relationships.

Partner with Key Stakeholders - Act as the primary data and analytics partner for Finance, while collaborating closely with Marketing, Operations, and Product, bridging the gap between financial data complexity and business decisions and translating technical findings into clear recommendations.

Build High-Impact Visualisation Tools - Define key financial metrics and develop dashboards and reports that communicate financial insights effectively, empowering self-service across Finance and senior leadership.

Drive Business Economics Analytics - Partner with Finance to develop analytical frameworks across monetisation, unit economics, LTV, payback period, cost structure, and revenue drivers, bridging product performance and financial outcomes to support strategic planning.

Enhance Analytics Through AI-Powered Workflows - Design and implement AI-assisted workflows to automate anomaly detection, surface budget deviations, and unlock efficiencies in the analytical processes supporting budgeting and re-forecasting.

Contribute to Our Data Layer Evolution - Contribute to the development of our data mesh layer by designing financial data models and pipelines that integrate into the company’s federated data strategy, ensuring scalable and governed data ownership.
Who We're Looking For
This role needs someone with a strong analytical mindset who thrives in a collaborative environment, is detail-oriented, and is ready to take real ownership in a dynamic setting.
Relevant Experience - 4+ years in data-related roles spanning Data Analytics, and BI, with at least 2 years of hands-on experience in high-volume data environments.

Financial Data Expertise - Hands-on experience in financial data modelling, with a solid understanding of P&L structures, cash flow analytics, and plan vs. actual monitoring (familiarity with ERP data schemas like SAP and transforming financial data is highly valued).
Technical Proficiency - Strong command of SQL. Experience with Git and notebook-based analytics such as Jupyter is a plus.
Data Modelling & ETL - Proven experience designing data models, building ETL pipelines, ideally in high-volume, high-frequency financial data environments.

AI Fluency - Comfortable using AI tools day-to-day for analytics, automation, and generating ad-hoc analyses, C-level summaries, and business cases efficiently (proficiency with Claude is a strong plus).
Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills - Comfortable with ambiguity, able to break down complex financial problems into focused workstreams, and deliver evidence-based answers with end-to-end ownership.

Stakeholder Management & Communication - Able to independently lead initiatives across Finance and Marketing domains, efficiently translating technical findings into clear, actionable recommendations.

Unit Economics & Monetisation Knowledge - Familiarity with consumer lifecycle metrics (Acquisition, Activation, Retention, Monetisation) and user economics (ARPU, CAC, LTV, Payback Period) from a financial planning lens (Fintech-specific KPIs are a strong plus).
Data Visualisation - Experience with Hex, Looker, or similar tools to build clear and insightful financial data representations.

Don't worry if you don't tick every box. We believe in the power of different viewpoints and strengths. Your unique perspective is important as we build something special: if you're passionate and can make a difference, we truly encourage you to apply.
CareAbout: how we support your impact
About

We move fast, and evolution never stops. It’s a fun ride, but it can be challenging. To make sure our people truly thrive, we’re committed to making their lives easier, both in the office and out in the world. That’s why we created CareAbout:
❤️ Health: private insurance for you and your family, psychological support with Serenis, mental health workshops.
💰 Financial resources: Stock Option Plan, meal vouchers, relocation support if you’re moving countries.
⚙️ Growth and development: professional development programs, internal mobility, language courses with Preply.
🌱 Flexibility: unlimited PTO, hybrid working policy*, flexible working hours.
👨‍👩‍👧 Family: enhanced parental leave, additional leave for child sickness.
We embrace three days per week in-office (Tuesday and Thursday + 1 of your choice), with the option to request extra remote time.
Salary: €40,000.00 - €50,000.00 gross per annum

This range is set using objective, gender-neutral criteria for the role's core requirements. However, we do not believe in putting a ceiling on talent. The final compensation package is tailored according to your unique experience and expertise. If your skills go beyond the standard profile, apply anyway so we can discuss a package that reflects your true value.
Equal Opportunity Employer

At Satispay, we're proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and inclusion, welcoming individuals of all backgrounds. This opportunity is open to everyone, regardless - for instance - of race, colour, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, and national origin. Join us in a workplace where everyone belongs!

4432297247,https://it.linkedin.com/jobs/view/data-analyst-finance-at-satispay-4432297247?position=14&pageNum=0&refId=3%2FZ2lRvDYUJtVqLpMxIM2g%3D%3D&trackingId=DZO9PD9uB%2B6KvoEU0e3ibQ%3D%3D,Data Analyst - Finance,Satispay,"Milan, Lombardy, Italy","About Us
Traditional banking has never really given you control over your financial life. Satispay exists to change that: to empower people through finance.
That means making financial services easy and accessible for over 6.5M users. We started with payments, then benefits, investing, cards... and we’re not done. Not even close.
We follow the same logic every time: find a real problem, solve it properly, then look for the next one. The destination? To build the most loved financial platform in the world.

If you own outcomes rather than tasks, stay close to what users need, and refuse to wait for someone else to fix what's broken — you'll find people here who work exactly in the same way. And together, you'll build something worth being proud of.
What You'll Be Doing

As a Data Analyst, you will be a core member of our Growth & Marketing (G&M) team, taking the data and analytics lead on all Finance initiatives, playing a key role in enhancing decision-making by developing analytical models and self-service data assets that drive impactful solutions for financial planning, reporting, and operational steering.
Here's What That Looks Like In Practice

Build Financial Analytics & Reporting Capabilities - Develop P&L and cash flow analytics, plan vs. actual monitoring models, and financial KPI frameworks that enable Finance to steer the business with accurate, timely data.

Lead Investor Relations Analytics - Serve as the primary analytics and intelligence partner for Satispay's investors including top-tier VC firms, translating business performance into clear, data-driven narratives that maintain and strengthen those relationships.

Partner with Key Stakeholders - Act as the primary data and analytics partner for Finance, while collaborating closely with Marketing, Operations, and Product, bridging the gap between financial data complexity and business decisions and translating technical findings into clear recommendations.

Build High-Impact Visualisation Tools - Define key financial metrics and develop dashboards and reports that communicate financial insights effectively, empowering self-service across Finance and senior leadership.

Drive Business Economics Analytics - Partner with Finance to develop analytical frameworks across monetisation, unit economics, LTV, payback period, cost structure, and revenue drivers, bridging product performance and financial outcomes to support strategic planning.

Enhance Analytics Through AI-Powered Workflows - Design and implement AI-assisted workflows to automate anomaly detection, surface budget deviations, and unlock efficiencies in the analytical processes supporting budgeting and re-forecasting.

Contribute to Our Data Layer Evolution - Contribute to the development of our data mesh layer by designing financial data models and pipelines that integrate into the company’s federated data strategy, ensuring scalable and governed data ownership.
Who We're Looking For
This role needs someone with a strong analytical mindset who thrives in a collaborative environment, is detail-oriented, and is ready to take real ownership in a dynamic setting.
Relevant Experience - 4+ years in data-related roles spanning Data Analytics, and BI, with at least 2 years of hands-on experience in high-volume data environments.

Financial Data Expertise - Hands-on experience in financial data modelling, with a solid understanding of P&L structures, cash flow analytics, and plan vs. actual monitoring (familiarity with ERP data schemas like SAP and transforming financial data is highly valued).
Technical Proficiency - Strong command of SQL. Experience with Git and notebook-based analytics such as Jupyter is a plus.
Data Modelling & ETL - Proven experience designing data models, building ETL pipelines, ideally in high-volume, high-frequency financial data environments.

AI Fluency - Comfortable using AI tools day-to-day for analytics, automation, and generating ad-hoc analyses, C-level summaries, and business cases efficiently (proficiency with Claude is a strong plus).
Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills - Comfortable with ambiguity, able to break down complex financial problems into focused workstreams, and deliver evidence-based answers with end-to-end ownership.

Stakeholder Management & Communication - Able to independently lead initiatives across Finance and Marketing domains, efficiently translating technical findings into clear, actionable recommendations.

Unit Economics & Monetisation Knowledge - Familiarity with consumer lifecycle metrics (Acquisition, Activation, Retention, Monetisation) and user economics (ARPU, CAC, LTV, Payback Period) from a financial planning lens (Fintech-specific KPIs are a strong plus).
Data Visualisation - Experience with Hex, Looker, or similar tools to build clear and insightful financial data representations.

Don't worry if you don't tick every box. We believe in the power of different viewpoints and strengths. Your unique perspective is important as we build something special: if you're passionate and can make a difference, we truly encourage you to apply.

We move fast, and evolution never stops. It’s a fun ride, but it can be challenging. To make sure our people truly thrive, we’re committed to making their lives easier, both in the office and out in the world. That’s why we created CareAbout:

👨‍👩‍👧 Family: enhanced parental leave, additional leave for child sickness.
We embrace three days per week in-office (Tuesday and Thursday + 1 of your choice), with the option to request extra remote time.

About Us

Traditional banking has never really given you control over your financial life. Satispay exists to change that: to empower people through finance.

That means making financial services easy and accessible for over 6.5M users. We started with payments, then benefits, investing, cards... and we’re not done. Not even close.

We follow the same logic every time: find a real problem, solve it properly, then look for the next one. The destination? To build the most loved financial platform in the world.

If you own outcomes rather than tasks, stay close to what users need, and refuse to wait for someone else to fix what's broken — you'll find people here who work exactly in the same way. And together, you'll build something worth being proud of.

What You'll Be Doing

As a Data Analyst, you will be a core member of our Growth &
column2: Marketing (G&amp
column3:
M) team, taking the data and analytics lead on all Finance initiatives, playing a key role in enhancing decision-making by developing analytical models and self-service data assets that drive impactful solutions for financial planning, reporting, and operational steering.

Here's What That Looks Like In Practice

  • Build Financial Analytics &
column4: Reporting Capabilities - Develop P&amp
column5:
L and cash flow analytics, plan vs. actual monitoring models, and financial KPI frameworks that enable Finance to steer the business with accurate, timely data.
  • Lead Investor Relations Analytics - Serve as the primary analytics and intelligence partner for Satispay's investors including top-tier VC firms, translating business performance into clear, data-driven narratives that maintain and strengthen those relationships.
  • Partner with Key Stakeholders - Act as the primary data and analytics partner for Finance, while collaborating closely with Marketing, Operations, and Product, bridging the gap between financial data complexity and business decisions and translating technical findings into clear recommendations.
  • Build High-Impact Visualisation Tools - Define key financial metrics and develop dashboards and reports that communicate financial insights effectively, empowering self-service across Finance and senior leadership.
  • Drive Business Economics Analytics - Partner with Finance to develop analytical frameworks across monetisation, unit economics, LTV, payback period, cost structure, and revenue drivers, bridging product performance and financial outcomes to support strategic planning.
  • Enhance Analytics Through AI-Powered Workflows - Design and implement AI-assisted workflows to automate anomaly detection, surface budget deviations, and unlock efficiencies in the analytical processes supporting budgeting and re-forecasting.
  • Contribute to Our Data Layer Evolution - Contribute to the development of our data mesh layer by designing financial data models and pipelines that integrate into the company’s federated data strategy, ensuring scalable and governed data ownership.

    This role needs someone with a strong analytical mindset who thrives in a collaborative environment, is detail-oriented, and is ready to take real ownership in a dynamic setting.

    • Financial Data Expertise - Hands-on experience in financial data modelling, with a solid understanding of P&

  • Data Modelling &

    CareAbout: how we support your impact

    About

    We move fast, and evolution never stops. It’s a fun ride, but it can be challenging. To make sure our people truly thrive, we’re committed to making their lives easier, both in the office and out in the world. That’s why we created CareAbout:

    • ❤️ Health: private insurance for you and your family, psychological support with Serenis, mental health workshops.
    • 💰 Financial resources: Stock Option Plan, meal vouchers, relocation support if you’re moving countries.
    • ⚙️ Growth and development: professional development programs, internal mobility, language courses with Preply.
    • 🌱 Flexibility: unlimited PTO, hybrid working policy*, flexible working hours.
    • 👨‍👩‍👧 Family: enhanced parental leave, additional leave for child sickness.
    • We embrace three days per week in-office (Tuesday and Thursday + 1 of your choice), with the option to request extra remote time.

    Salary: €40,000.00 - €50,000.00 gross per annum

The final compensation package is tailored according to your unique experience and expertise. If your skills go beyond the standard profile, apply anyway so we can discuss a package that reflects your true value.

● Hai padronanza di linguaggi come R o Python

Edenred è leader nel settore degli employee benefit e offre alle aziende soluzioni digitali per migliorare la qualità di vita e il benessere delle persone che lavorano, dalla pausa pranzo, al tempo libero, fino alla cura della persona e alla mobilità sostenibile.

La nostra piattaforma digitale collega 60 milioni di utenti e oltre 2 milioni di affiliati in 45 Paesi attraverso circa 1 milione di aziende clienti. In Italia, l’ecosistema coinvolge oltre 2,5 milioni di beneficiari, 100 mila aziende clienti e 150 mila partner convenzionati.
Oggi il mondo è cambiato e noi ci impegniamo ad ideare soluzioni sempre più smart per supportare le funzioni HR e rispondere efficacemente alle esigenze correlate alle nuove abitudini lavorative.

“Enrich connections. For good.”, questo il purpose del Gruppo: sviluppare ed arricchire le connessioni per rafforzare le imprese e promuovere soluzioni inclusive, ponendo al centro non solo le persone, ma anche l’ambiente e il territorio.

Per noi, la diversità delle persone è un punto di forza e di ricchezza in grado di riflettere la diversità dei nostri clienti e stakeholder. Siamo inoltre impegnati nella protezione dell’ambiente, disegnando soluzioni spostenibili per la mobilità e lo spreco alimentare con l’impegno di raggiungere le zero emissioni nette entro il 2050.
Edenred è quotata alla Borsa Euronext di Parigi ed è inclusa nei seguenti indici: CAC 40 ESG, CAC Next 20, CAC Large 60, Euronext Tech Leaders, Euronext 100, FTSE4Good e MSCI Europe.
Vuoi sapere di più su di noi? Vai su https://www.edenred.it/

La risorsa ricercata è un* Sales Operations & Data Analyst che sarà inserita all’interno della Direzione Marketing. La figura sarà impegnata nell’analisi e monitoraggio delle performance di business, supportando la definizione di modelli per l’ottimizzazione delle stesse.
Principali attività:
Supportare proattivamente il business nell’analisi dei dati strutturando attività di reporting avanzato per il monitoraggio periodico delle performance
Partecipare al processo di budgeting, forecasting & targeting supportando la business unit attraverso analisi di dettaglio
Gestire fornitori esterni per il monitoraggio e l’ottimizzazione delle performance
Gestire il capacity planning di FTEs interni ed esterni in base ai volumi e agli obiettivi di business
Partecipare attivamente alla definizione e all’analisi dei KPIs funzionali al governo del business implementando dashboard dedicate e presentazioni in power point
Contribuire allo sviluppo e alla gestione di modelli analitici avanzati per l’ottimizzazione delle performance
Predisporre attività di chiusura mensile e analisi degli scostamenti proponendo eventuali azioni correttive
Fornire data driven insights di business alla business unit.
WE WILL VIBE WITH YOU

Passione per il cliente, rispetto, immaginazione, semplicità e spirito imprenditoriale sono i valori che ricerchiamo nelle nostre persone. Se ti riconosci ed hai voglia di metterti in gioco in un ambiente stimolante e multinazionale inviaci la tua candidatura e diventa anche tu un* Edenreder!
Almeno 4-5 anni di esperienza in un ruolo analogo o affine, preferibilmente maturati in società di consulenza.
Laurea in materie economico-scientifiche (Economia, Ingegneria Gestionale, Statistica..)
Eccellente padronanza di Excel e Power point
Nice to have: Power BI, Cognos e Salesforce

In qualità di Business Data Analyst entrerai a far parte del team Data e contribuirai a abilitare decisioni rapide e data-informed grazie alla co-creazione di data product con i nostri business partner, portando ad azioni di valore. Sarai un ponte tra il mondo del dato e le funzioni commerciali, traducendo esigenze di business in analisi concrete e insight azionabili. Lavorerai a stretto contatto con data professionals e stakeholder aziendali, contribuendo a diffondere una cultura data-driven in tutta l'organizzazione.
Nello specifico, sarai coinvolto/a nelle seguenti attività:
Analizzare e interpretare dati aziendali per supportare i processi decisionali delle funzioni commerciali e di business

Tradurre le esigenze dei business partner in requisiti analitici chiari e in query SQL strutturate, garantendo accuratezza e tempestività dei risultati Costuire le basi dati e la documentazione ad abilitare il business nel self service analytics tramite AI
Mappare e comprendere i processi commerciali end-to-end, identificando opportunità di ottimizzazione e aree di intervento basate sui dati
Collaborare con il team Data e con le funzioni aziendali per garantire che i dati siano accessibili, comprensibili e utilizzati efficacemente per generare valore
·Contribuire alla definizione e al monitoraggio dei KPI commerciali, supportando il business nel misurare l'impatto delle proprie azioni
REQUISITI
Must have
Almeno 4 anni di esperienza in ruoli di Business Data Analyst, Business Analyst o ruoli affini

Esperienza consolidata nel mercato telco e/o forte conoscenza dei processi di business, in particolare di quelli commerciali (vendite, retention, marketing, prodotto, customer lifecycle, customer care)
Conoscenza solida di SQL per l'interrogazione e la manipolazione di database relazionali
Capacità di tradurre domande di business in analisi dati strutturate e di comunicare i risultati in modo chiaro a stakeholder non tecnici
Ossessione per una documentazione chiara ed esaustiva
Conoscenza dell'inglese
Nice to have
Esperienza con strumenti di Business Intelligence (Tableau, Power BI, Qlik, Looker o simili)
Esposizione a concetti di data governance e data quality
Conoscenza del francese
PAY TRANSPARENCY

Partiamo con la trasparenza: la Retribuzione Annua Lorda (RAL) prevista per il ruolo parte da 30.500 euro lordi annui, a cui si aggiunge il pacchetto benefits iliad. Questa cifra rappresenta il minimo del range retributivo previsto per laposizione. Integrating and consolidating data from multiple sources

Join us as a Staff Data Analyst - Compliance to build the analytics foundations that power Qonto's compliance execution. You'll own a brand-new scope — monitoring KYC/KYB funnels, remediation campaigns, and financial exposure — working cross-functionally with Product, Ops, Risk & Compliance, and Internal Control, under the guidance of Alma, our Lead Data Analyst.
👩‍💻🧑‍💻 As a Data Analyst at Qonto, you will

Build compliance process monitoring from scratch: You'll build and own the data infrastructure that powers compliance monitoring at Qonto — from onboarding funnel analytics to remediation financial exposure — giving product, operations and compliance teams the self-service tools they need to make decisions without waiting on a data request.

Model and transform data with dbt: With the collaboration of Analytics Engineer Team, you'll build end-to-end transformation pipelines from source to consumption layer, keeping metric definitions clean and trusted by non-technical stakeholders.
Turn regulatory questions into self-service assets: You'll partner with Product, Ops, Risk & Compliance, and Internal Control to scope and ship analytical tools

Own the KYC/KYB funnel analytics end-to-end: You'll deliver insights from CS initiation through KYB validation — refusal reasons, document gaps, lead-time distributions — so teams can act on friction fast.
Track remediation campaigns and financial exposure: You'll measure MRR secured, at risk, or lost across active campaigns, with peak intensity in Q4 (budget season) and May-June (reforecast).
🤔 What You Can Expect
A greenfield, strategically critical scope: Qonto is under close regulatory scrutiny — you'll build analytics foundations that matter company-wide, not just for your team.
Senior, cross-functional exposure from day one: Product, Ops, Risk & Compliance, Internal Control — few DA roles give you this breadth of senior stakeholder access at this level.
Real ownership in the Modern Data Stack: You'll build in Omni and dbt with a high degree of autonomy — no legacy to untangle, just foundations to create.
A team where AI is a first-class tool: Unlimited access to AI tools (Claude, Cursor, and more) to evolve how you work, not just output more.
➡️ Your future manager

Your manager will be Alma, our Lead Data Analyst for Ops & Finance. Alma knows exactly what it takes to build an analytics function that actually changes decisions, and she'll push you to do the same.
Alma reports to Erwan, Director of Business Analytics who oversees the entire Analytics function and ensures alignment across teams.
🏅 About You

Compliance or regulated environment experience: You've worked analytically on KYC/KYB, AML, remediation, or similar regulatory/operational processes — and you know how to get credible with those stakeholders fast.

Self-service product mindset: You've designed dashboards and models for end-users to explore autonomously, adapting the same dataset from ops-level (daily SLA tracking) to exec-level (budget readouts).
Cross-functional stakeholder management: You've juggled competing analytical priorities across multiple teams — and you know how to scope clearly, push back when needed, and drive adoption.
Strong SQL and data modelling skills: You've built end-to-end transformation pipelines, enforced data quality, and made non-technical stakeholders trust your numbers.
AI-native workflow: You actively use AI tools to accelerate your analytics work — from data modelling to stakeholder communication — and you're genuinely curious about going further.

Founded in 2017 as an innovative startup, Witailer is now a leading player in digital commerce strategy and in the management of major European and international marketplaces.

As part of Alkemy Group ecosystem of capabilities and within [Alkemy]+ - the Group’s brand that integrates creativity, design, media, and commerce - Witailer helps brands navigate the competitive landscape and define growth and consolidation strategies across marketplaces and retailer ecosystems, with a strong focus on Amazon but extending to a broader retail environment.

Through tailored strategies, proprietary software solutions, and dedicated marketing and advertising consulting services, Witailer enables brands to build a more effective, structured, and measurable presence in digital commerce.
Are you passionate about transforming data into an insightful story to influence our clients’ decisions?
Are you curious about all the changes that the ecommerce world is currently undergoing, and do you want to be part of a team that handles future implications for brands?
Do you excel in cooperating with different teams to devise the best answer for our clients’ business questions?
Then our Business Insights Analyst role is for you!

At Witailer, you will learn everything about e-commerce and the recipe for success on e-marketplace platforms. Our mission is to help brands succeed in this complex ecosystem, offering end-to-end solutions. We serve our clients as consultants and as partners in the implementation of digital strategies. Become an expert in Amazon and online retailers, knowing all the possibilities offered by these platforms to obtain success as a brand and how to best exploit the data they generate.
Work on analyzing retail, consumers, market data and choose when to put them all together to present actionable insights to our clients.
Collaborate with different teams to understand the clients’ needs and what analysis suits them best.
Suggest new ways of answering our clients’ business questions with reliable data and therefore explore all the possible analytical methodologies and data sources.
What will you find?

This is a great opportunity for you to develop new skills, make a difference by innovating, working with innovative e-marketplace data, and exploiting your analytical capabilities. Our work culture is friendly and collaborative, we value the opinion of each team member, and we encourage each person to directly shape the company, processes and direction. We believe in continuous growth and we make sure each team member has ownership over their work.
You will also find:
A growing, dynamic team, working with a startup mindset
Competitive salary
Hybrid setup, with smart working and flexibility
Restaurant tickets

Bachelor’s degree
Fluency in both English and Italian is essential
2-3 years of working experience in teams that work in turning data into insights (e.g. business intelligence, research, trade marketing, research institutes)
Experience in communicating insights from data to internal or external teams. This is a client-facing role and communication skills are important
Strong data-analysis skills with links to business questions
Strong problem-solving and prioritization skills, roll-up sleeves attitude and willingness to learn
Previous Experience with Data visualization tools (Tableau, PowerBI) is preferred
Previous Experience with ecommerce or retail data is preferred

We bring together people with diverse professional backgrounds and experiences under the same roof and continuously promote a culture of knowledge sharing and ongoing growth.

Working knowledge of CRM data governance, database segmentation and customer data management, including privacy and consent frameworks (GDPR).
Hands-on experience with data analysis and reporting tools, with the ability to build clear KPI dashboards.
Exposure to predictive/scoring models (e.g. churn, CLV) or strong interest in developing these skills.
Experience supporting CRM campaign execution and monitoring, with a test-and-learn (A/B testing) mindset.
Strong Excel and big data-handling skills

Per la nostra sede di Bergamo ricerchiamo un/una:
BI Specialist

La figura, inserita all’interno del Team Business Intelligence, sarà coinvolta nelle attività di analisi, valorizzazione e rappresentazione del dato aziendale, operando a stretto contatto con le funzioni Operations, Retail, Finance e IT. La risorsa avrà un ruolo trasversale che comprenderà sia la preparazione e modellazione dei dataset provenienti da fonti eterogenee, sia la progettazione e lo sviluppo di report e dashboard attraverso Microsoft Power BI, con l’obiettivo di acquisire progressiva autonomia nella gestione delle attività e dei progetti di Business Intelligence.
Nello specifico, la risorsa si occuperà di:
Connettere, integrare e trasformare dati provenienti da fonti eterogenee, quali SAP, SQL Server, Azure e file flat, utilizzando Power Query e M Language.
Contribuire alla modellazione semantica dei dati in Power BI, definendo tabelle dei fatti, dimensioni, gerarchie e relazioni secondo le principali best practice di data modeling.
Sviluppare misure e KPI attraverso DAX, garantendo correttezza e adeguate performance delle formule.
Collaborare con il team Data Engineering alla definizione e al mantenimento di dataflow e dataset certificati.
Monitorare la qualità del dato, gestendo anomalie e riconciliazioni con i sistemi sorgente e contribuendo alla documentazione del data lineage.
Progettare e sviluppare report e dashboard Power BI, curandone layout, navigazione, leggibilità e user experience.
Realizzare dashboard interattive utilizzando funzionalità avanzate di Power BI, quali slicers, bookmarks, drill-through e tooltip personalizzati.
Contribuire alla realizzazione di visualizzazioni custom attraverso strumenti quali Deneb / Vega-Lite e componenti disponibili su AppSource.
Gestire la pubblicazione dei report, i workspace e le principali configurazioni di autorizzazione su Power BI Service.
Raccogliere i requisiti degli stakeholder di business e tradurli, con il supporto del team, in soluzioni dati, specifiche tecniche e wireframe.
Contribuire alla standardizzazione e manutenzione di template e temi condivisi all’interno del team BI.
Il/La candidato/a ideale presenta le seguenti caratteristiche:
Laurea in Informatica, Ingegneria Informatica, Statistica, Matematica o discipline affini, oppure percorso equivalente supportato da esperienza e portfolio di progetti.

Padronanza di strumenti di analytics e data visualization (es. Google Analytics 4, Looker, Power BI, Tableau)
Ottima capacità di tradurre dati complessi in insight e narrazioni comprensibili per il business

Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese
Conoscenza di linguaggi di scripting per la manipolazione dei dati (es. Python)
Familiarità con strumenti di AI generativa applicati all'analisi
Esperienza con ambienti di data warehousing (es. BigQuery, Snowflake)
Background in contesti growth-oriented o di performance marketing

** We are looking for a Financial Reporting & Data Quality Analyst to join our Finance Team. Application must be submitted in English **

As Financial Reporting & Data Quality Analyst, you will join the Financial Reporting & Tax Team of Redion EB and contribute to the production, validation and continuous improvement of financial and management reporting processes supporting a global business operating across more than 120 countries. You will work in close collaboration with finance professionals and business stakeholders, contributing to the reliability, consistency and quality of the data used for management decision-making and regulatory reporting purposes.
Your responsibilities will include (non-exhaustive list):
Supporting the preparation and validation of periodic financial, management and operational reports for internal and external stakeholders
Performing data quality reviews and reconciliation activities to ensure the accuracy, completeness and consistency of financial and business information
Assisting in the analysis of reporting data, identifying trends, anomalies and areas requiring further investigation
Contributing to the maintenance and enhancement of reporting processes, methodologies and controls
Collaborating with multiple functions across the organization to collect, review and challenge data used within reporting processes
Supporting the production of executive dashboards, performance indicators and management presentations
Participating in data governance and continuous improvement initiatives aimed at strengthening reporting reliability and operational efficiency
Assisting during quarterly and year-end reporting cycles, ensuring the timely delivery of high-quality information
Supporting ad hoc analyses and projects requested by management
The above list is not limitative and may be amended/adapted at any time by the Employer, at its own discretion, in accordance with the business needs.
Why should you join us?

Because here, your ideas matter, your contribution is visible, and your growth is supported. You'll join an ambitious, international team that is transforming employee benefits while keeping people at the heart of everything we do. At Redion EB, careers are built, not just jobs filled.

We give our people the opportunity to learn, grow, lead, and make an impact. From developing specialist expertise to leading international projects, taking on broader responsibilities, or stepping into management roles, we actively support career progression at every stage.
If you're looking for an employer that invests in your future while giving you the freedom to make a difference today, we'd love to meet you.
What we are looking for
knowledge of Power BI, Power Query, SQL or similar data analysis tools would be considered an advantage
knowledge of SAP 4Hana, SAP SRV and/or Prima system would be considered a big asset
strong analytical and quantitative mindset
natural attention to detail and commitment to delivering high-quality work
ability to manage and analyse large datasets while maintaining data integrity
good communication and interpersonal skills
curiosity, willingness to learn and proactive attitude
advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel
good command of English, any other language would be considered an asset
Ideal background would be
2 to 5 years of professional experience in financial reporting, audit, data analytics, controlling, finance transformation or similar areas
Bachelor’s or master’s degree in economics, Finance, Accounting or Business Administration
Previous experience within a Big 4 firm (Audit, Risk Advisory, Financial Advisory or Consulting) highly desirable
Experience within insurance, reinsurance, financial services or regulated industries would be considered an advantage

The recruitment and selection process will be conducted in full compliance with the principles of equal opportunity, inclusion, and non-discrimination. This position is open to all candidates regardless of gender and welcomes applications from individuals belonging to protected categories under Italian Law 68/99.
This is a permanent position, based in Assago (Italy), covered by the CCNL ANIA and is at the Impiegato III level.

Annual gross base salary offered for this position ranges from EUR 30,000.00 to EUR 35,000.00 (final package will be confirmed individually to the final selected candidate, in line with the profile and the adequation with the position requirements).
Redion Employee Benefits’ commitment for recruiting:

Redion Employee Benefits is committed to promote equal opportunities in employment. Candidates will receive equal treatment regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or maternity, race, color, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief, sex or sexual orientation.

At Generali and Redion, we believe that it is our differences that make the difference. At the heart of everything we do, we value the fact that we are all human beings, unique in our own ways, bringing different cultures, lifestyles, mindsets, and preferences. Our commitment is to leverage this Diversity to create long-term value, to be innovative, sustainable, to make the difference for our people, our clients, our partners as well as our communities. We strive to promote a culture where D&I is embedded in how we work and do business every day. All of us around the world are taking actions every day to create an inclusive and accessible workplace, where every person feels empowered to take ownership, to challenge biases and lead the transformation with a human touch.

Redion Employee Benefits endeavours to contact candidates within 21 days of application. However, if you do not hear back after 3 weeks then please assume on this occasion, unfortunately, you have not been successful.
Personal data collected will be strictly used for recruitment purpose only. All unsuccessful applications will be destroyed max. 3 months after this recruitment campaign closing.

Job Description
We are currently seeking a Global CRM Specialist as part of our dynamic team in Milan.
How you will contribute?

Support the Global CRM manager with the extraction of weekly, monthly & quarterly reports, dashboards and scorecards including main CRM KPIs  and their analysis for internal and external distribution (Kering)
Ensure data quality, consistency, and reliability across CRM reporting by conducting regular data validation, governance checks, and performance monitoring
Perform analyses on customer behavior, retention, client engagement, loyalty, clienteling effectiveness, to identify growth opportunities and business risks
Communicate with the regions and manage local CRM requests related to analytics and support for the CRM System
Support the design and continuous enhancement of global dashboards and reporting solutions in collaboration with internal teams and external partners
Identify opportunities to innovate CRM and client analytics processes through emerging technologies, AI-powered solutions, and new visualization techniques.

CCNL Applied: National Collective Labour Agreement per gli Addetti alle Industrie Manifatturiere delle Pelli e Succedanei e Ombrelli e Ombrelloni
Indicative Starting Salary: 28.000€
Eligibility to sales incentives as per company policy.
Benefit: in addition to those provided by the applicable National Collective Labor Agreement and by law, further benefits
and initiatives are provided in accordance with current company policies.
Who you are?
University Degree in Marketing, Economics or equivalent experience
Direct experience of 2 - 3 years in a similar role, preferably in a Luxury Company but not mandatory
Extensive knowledge and experience with reporting tools (Power BI, Tableau, Microsoft Excel) and analytics
Familiarity with AI-powered analytics, automation tools, predictive modeling, or emerging technologies applied to CRM and customer experience is a strong plus
Strong analytical mindset with excellent problem-solving and storytelling skills.
Fluent English, Italian preferable
Customer driven orientation
Good at working with and managing cross-functional teams including MIS, Retail and multiple Regions
Strong project management capabilities, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and stakeholders in a fast-paced international environment.
Curious, innovative, and eager to explore new technologies that can drive business performance and enhance decision-making
Strong interpersonal, team-player and communication skills
Why work with us?

This is a fabulous opportunity to join the Kering adventure and to actively contribute to the development of the business by becoming part of a global Luxury Group that offers endless possibilities to learn and grow. Talent development is a managerial principle at Kering and we are committed to fostering internal mobility. Modella il futuro del business e della tecnologia sviluppando soluzioni all'avanguardia in grado di generare nuovo valore.
Il tuo ruolo e le tue prospettive

Entra a far parte del nostro network di talenti nel Reinvention Partner Industry & Enterprise, in ambito AI & Data. Lavorerai con tecnologie innovative su progetti entusiasmanti, aiutando le aziende leader a livello mondiale a sviluppare le loro strategie IT. In particolare potrai:
Partecipare allo sviluppo di soluzioni innovative basate su Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning e Generative AI
Collaborare alla progettazione di applicazioni e use case AI a supporto della trasformazione dei processi aziendali
Analizzare dati per generare insight in grado di guidare decisioni strategiche e modelli di business innovativi
Lavorare con moderni ecosistemi Data & AI, contribuendo allo sviluppo di soluzioni analytics e data-driven
Collaborare con esperti di AI, Data Science, Data Engineering e Strategy su progetti ad alto impatto e respiro internazionale
Investire nella propria crescita attraverso formazione continua, certificazioni e percorsi di sviluppo sulle tecnologie emergenti.

La retribuzione prevista in Accenture viene definita sulla base di molteplici elementi di valutazione, tra cui – ad esempio – il ruolo ricoperto, il livello di seniority, il grado di responsabilità, le competenze professionali e l’esperienza maturata. Per la presente posizione, è previsto un livello di inquadramento B2 nel CCNL Metalmeccanico. La fascia di retribuzione annua lorda prevista è compresa tra 28.099,93€ e 34.600€.
Se vuoi fare della tua passione una carriera e hai le seguenti caratteristiche, ti stiamo aspettando:
Neolaureati o professionisti con fino a 2 anni di esperienza
Laurea Magistrale in Informatica, Ingegneria, Matematica, Fisica, Statistica, Data Science, Economia o discipline affini
Forte passione per tematiche di Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, Machine Learning e Data Analytics
Conoscenza accademica o lavorativa di Python, SQL e strumenti di analisi e visualizzazione dati
Curiosità verso le nuove tecnologie e desiderio di lavorare sui trend che stanno ridefinendo il futuro del business
Mentalità analitica, attitudine al problem solving e predisposizione al lavoro in team
Ottima conoscenza, scritta e parlata, delle lingue italiana e inglese.

Se desideri prepararti al meglio al nostro processo di selezione ti invitiamo a consultare la nostra sezione FAQ: https://www.accenture.com/it-it/careers/explore-careers/area-of-interest/journey-to-accenture

4456737637,https://it.linkedin.com/jobs/view/business-insights-analyst-at-witailer-4456737637?position=2&pageNum=2&refId=yuNvsAsTIAnmRrAjC13owQ%3D%3D&trackingId=p4hOp7AWYBqWTtfKQCGT2Q%3D%3D,Business Insights Analyst,Witailer,"Milan, Lombardy, Italy","Witailer supports brands and companies in growing their business on marketplaces by combining expertise in commerce, data analysis, and business intelligence.
Founded in 2017 as an innovative startup, Witailer is now a leading player in digital commerce strategy and in the management of major European and international marketplaces.

As part of Alkemy Group ecosystem of capabilities and within [Alkemy]+ - the Group’s brand that integrates creativity, design, media, and commerce - Witailer helps brands navigate the competitive landscape and define growth and consolidation strategies across marketplaces and retailer ecosystems, with a strong focus on Amazon but extending to a broader retail environment.

Through tailored strategies, proprietary software solutions, and dedicated marketing and advertising consulting services, Witailer enables brands to build a more effective, structured, and measurable presence in digital commerce.
Are you passionate about transforming data into an insightful story to influence our clients’ decisions?
Are you curious about all the changes that the ecommerce world is currently undergoing, and do you want to be part of a team that handles future implications for brands?
Do you excel in cooperating with different teams to devise the best answer for our clients’ business questions?
Then our Business Insights Analyst role is for you!

At Witailer, you will learn everything about e-commerce and the recipe for success on e-marketplace platforms. Our mission is to help brands succeed in this complex ecosystem, offering end-to-end solutions. We serve our clients as consultants and as partners in the implementation of digital strategies. We are professionals with an international view, passion for technology and an entrepreneurial attitude.
As a Business Insights Analyst you will:
Become an expert in Amazon and online retailers, knowing all the possibilities offered by these platforms to obtain success as a brand and how to best exploit the data they generate.
Work on analyzing retail, consumers, market data and choose when to put them all together to present actionable insights to our clients.
Collaborate with different teams to understand the clients’ needs and what analysis suits them best.
Suggest new ways of answering our clients’ business questions with reliable data and therefore explore all the possible analytical methodologies and data sources.
What will you find?

This is a great opportunity for you to develop new skills, make a difference by innovating, working with innovative e-marketplace data, and exploiting your analytical capabilities. Our work culture is friendly and collaborative, we value the opinion of each team member, and we encourage each person to directly shape the company, processes and direction. We believe in continuous growth and we make sure each team member has ownership over their work.
You will also find:
A growing, dynamic team, working with a startup mindset
Competitive salary
Hybrid setup, with smart working and flexibility
Restaurant tickets
Requirements
Bachelor’s degree
Fluency in both English and Italian is essential
2-3 years of working experience in teams that work in turning data into insights (e.g. business intelligence, research, trade marketing, research institutes)
Experience in communicating insights from data to internal or external teams. This is a client-facing role and communication skills are important
Strong data-analysis skills with links to business questions
Strong problem-solving and prioritization skills, roll-up sleeves attitude and willingness to learn
Previous Experience with Data visualization tools (Tableau, PowerBI) is preferred
Previous Experience with ecommerce or retail data is preferred
Ti chiediamo di allegare una breve lettera di motivazione alla candidatura
WHAT WE OFFER

At Alkemy, we are constantly committed to creating the best conditions for all our people to fully express their value and talent—and to feel that Alkemy is their home—regardless of gender, age, nationality, sexual orientation, or religious beliefs.

We have always been firmly convinced that an inclusive work environment that values diversity is not only a matter of principle but also a critical success factor for our business. We bring together people with diverse professional backgrounds and experiences under the same roof and continuously promote a culture of knowledge sharing and ongoing growth.
Excellence, Passion, Integrity, and Pragmatism are Alkemy’s core values. They are shared by all of us and guide us in fulfilling our mission.

Alkemy’s values define our identity and form the foundation of our organizational culture. They guide our behavior toward our people and our clients, shaping and continuously evolving our approach to business.

In accordance with the provisions of Legislative Decree No. 96/2026 on pay transparency, the Gross Annual Salary (RAL) envisaged for this position ranges between €28.000 and €35.000, determined on the basis of objective and gender-neutral criteria, taking into account the position level and the applicable Collective Bargaining Agreement (CCNL).

The determination of the specific compensation package, including any variable components (such as MBO bonuses) and additional benefits, will depend on the assessment of the candidate’s profile against the requirements of the position.
Candidates whose profiles are considered a match will be contacted within 20 days. Applications submitted without a complete CV attached will not be considered.
Candidates’ personal data will be processed in accordance with the Privacy Notice, which is always available on the Alkemy website.

Exposure to predictive/scoring models (e.g. churn, CLV) or strong interest in developing these skills.

Propensione al lavoro di gruppo

** We are looking for a Financial Reporting & Data Quality Analyst to join our Finance Team. Application must be submitted in English **

As Financial Reporting & Data Quality Analyst, you will join the Financial Reporting & Tax Team of Redion EB and contribute to the production, validation and continuous improvement of financial and management reporting processes supporting a global business operating across more than 120 countries. You will work in close collaboration with finance professionals and business stakeholders, contributing to the reliability, consistency and quality of the data used for management decision-making and regulatory reporting purposes.
Your responsibilities will include (non-exhaustive list):
Supporting the preparation and validation of periodic financial, management and operational reports for internal and external stakeholders
Performing data quality reviews and reconciliation activities to ensure the accuracy, completeness and consistency of financial and business information
Assisting in the analysis of reporting data, identifying trends, anomalies and areas requiring further investigation
Contributing to the maintenance and enhancement of reporting processes, methodologies and controls
Collaborating with multiple functions across the organization to collect, review and challenge data used within reporting processes
Supporting the production of executive dashboards, performance indicators and management presentations
Participating in data governance and continuous improvement initiatives aimed at strengthening reporting reliability and operational efficiency
Assisting during quarterly and year-end reporting cycles, ensuring the timely delivery of high-quality information
Supporting ad hoc analyses and projects requested by management
The above list is not limitative and may be amended/adapted at any time by the Employer, at its own discretion, in accordance with the business needs.
Why should you join us?

Because here, your ideas matter, your contribution is visible, and your growth is supported. You'll join an ambitious, international team that is transforming employee benefits while keeping people at the heart of everything we do. At Redion EB, careers are built, not just jobs filled.

We give our people the opportunity to learn, grow, lead, and make an impact. From developing specialist expertise to leading international projects, taking on broader responsibilities, or stepping into management roles, we actively support career progression at every stage.
If you're looking for an employer that invests in your future while giving you the freedom to make a difference today, we'd love to meet you.
What we are looking for
knowledge of Power BI, Power Query, SQL or similar data analysis tools would be considered an advantage
knowledge of SAP 4Hana, SAP SRV and/or Prima system would be considered a big asset
strong analytical and quantitative mindset
natural attention to detail and commitment to delivering high-quality work
ability to manage and analyse large datasets while maintaining data integrity
good communication and interpersonal skills
curiosity, willingness to learn and proactive attitude
advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel
good command of English, any other language would be considered an asset
Ideal background would be
2 to 5 years of professional experience in financial reporting, audit, data analytics, controlling, finance transformation or similar areas
Bachelor’s or master’s degree in economics, Finance, Accounting or Business Administration
Previous experience within a Big 4 firm (Audit, Risk Advisory, Financial Advisory or Consulting) highly desirable
Experience within insurance, reinsurance, financial services or regulated industries would be considered an advantage

The recruitment and selection process will be conducted in full compliance with the principles of equal opportunity, inclusion, and non-discrimination. This position is open to all candidates regardless of gender and welcomes applications from individuals belonging to protected categories under Italian Law 68/99.
This is a permanent position, based in Assago (Italy), covered by the CCNL ANIA and is at the Impiegato III level.

Annual gross base salary offered for this position ranges from EUR 30,000.00 to EUR 35,000.00 (final package will be confirmed individually to the final selected candidate, in line with the profile and the adequation with the position requirements).

At the heart of everything we do, we value the fact that we are all human beings, unique in our own ways, bringing different cultures, lifestyles, mindsets, and preferences. Our commitment is to leverage this Diversity to create long-term value, to be innovative, sustainable, to make the difference for our people, our clients, our partners as well as our communities. We strive to promote a culture where D&I is embedded in how we work and do business every day. All of us around the world are taking actions every day to create an inclusive and accessible workplace, where every person feels empowered to take ownership, to challenge biases and lead the transformation with a human touch.

Job Description

The JJMT Transformation function is responsible for designing and realizing the future-state supply chain network for Johnson & Johnson MedTech. This function includes oversight of consolidation and rationalization actions for the global distribution network, a strategic shift toward an asset-light model, and the build-out of new, future-looking logistics capabilities including partner management, network design, systems strategy, and defining the transition standards required to sustain performance in the future state. The team operates centrally, working in close partnership with regional Deliver teams across EMEA, APAC, LATAM, and North America.
PURPOSE OF POSITION

As part of the Logistics Partner Management pillar within the Transformation function, this role supports analytics, reporting, and operational tracking activities related to 3PL partner management across the global distribution network.

The position is responsible for supporting data analysis, KPI tracking, reporting development, and operational insights generation to enable visibility into partner performance, operational execution, and adherence to defined standards and expectations. This includes supporting governance processes through preparation of analytics, tracking partner-related metrics, and identifying trends, gaps, and improvement opportunities across the logistics partner network.

The role works closely with regional teams and cross-functional stakeholders to support data-driven decision-making, operational transparency, and continuous improvement within the asset-light operating model.
RESPONSIBILITIES / PRINCIPAL DUTIES (Essential Functions)
Support development and maintenance of reporting, dashboards, and analytics related to 3PL partner operations and performance
Collect, consolidate, validate, and analyze operational and performance data from regional teams and logistics partners
Track KPIs and operational metrics related to service, operational execution, governance, and partner adherence to defined expectations
Support governance forums through preparation of reporting materials, analytical insights, and performance summaries
Identify trends, risks, gaps, and improvement opportunities through analysis of operational and partner-related data
Maintain standardized reporting templates, tracking files, and data repositories supporting partner management activities
Support issue tracking and follow-up activities, ensuring visibility into action items, risks, and operational escalations
Collaborate with regional teams and stakeholders to ensure consistency and accuracy of operational and performance reporting
Support continuous improvement initiatives through analysis of operational performance trends and process effectiveness
Assist in documentation and standardization of reporting methodologies, KPI definitions, and analytical frameworks
Education/Experience
Education and/or additional training:
A minimum of a Bachelor’s degree is required
A Master's degree in Supply Chain, Operations, Business, Engineering, or a related field is preferred
Experience And Functional Competencies
Minimum 2–5 years of relevant experience in supply chain, logistics, analytics, reporting, or operations support roles
Experience working with operational data, KPI reporting, dashboards, or performance tracking
Exposure to warehouse, transportation, or 3PL-managed logistics environments is preferred
Strong analytical skills, including ability to interpret operational data and generate actionable insights
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint required
