4465696382,https://it.linkedin.com/jobs/view/data-visualization-expert-at-bip-4465696382?position=5&pageNum=5&refId=2TjDHekdm1YHkvzJIHK3Dg%3D%3D&trackingId=dOsK9Cz9ZIkvNXRRZT5kMQ%3D%3D,Data Visualization Expert,BIP,"Milan, Lombardy, Italy","
Entra nel nostro mondo.
Trasforma insieme a noi.
Nati nel 2003, abbiamo raccolto e valorizzato l’esperienza storica della consulenza e abbiamo aggiunto due ingredienti chiave: l’innovazione e la digitalizzazione.

Grazie a questo percorso siamo oggi oltre 4500 professionisti e professioniste, presenti in 13 Paesi, con oltre 4500 progetti alle spalle e le conoscenze più all’avanguardia nell'ambito della Digital Transformation, Data Science, Cybersecurity, Industry 4.0, IOT e di tutte le Disruptive Technologies che mettiamo a servizio di ogni settore di mercato.
Aiutiamo i nostri clienti a fare la differenza creando qualità su larga scala attraverso una formula che opera su tre leve: Valore, Persone e Tecnologia.

Crediamo nel valore dell’eccellenza, che è la bussola su cui orientiamo il nostro agire, e adottiamo un approccio etico e leale nei confronti di quante e quanti scelgono di lavorare con noi, promuovendo un ambiente in cui le persone possano crescere insieme, grazie alla contaminazione tra competenze diverse.
Data Visualization Expert
Quale sarà la tua sfida?
Entra a far parte di BIP – xTech, il Centro di Eccellenza di BIP specializzato in consulenza e servizi innovativi in ambito Big Data, Data Science, RPA, Cloud, Blockchain e Networking.

Le posizioni aperte riguardano profili junior/intermediate, neolaureati/e o con almeno 1 anno di esperienza maturata preferibilmente in società di consulenza direzionale, informatica o System Integrator.

Sarai responsabile di operare su piattaforme di data visualization tradizionali e Big Data per realizzare dashboard e strumenti di analisi dati visuale avanzati nell’ambito di progetti dedicati o all’interno di progettualità di Data Science e Data Governance.

Lavorerai con strumenti di Dynamic Data Visualization come QlikView, QlikSense, Tableau, MS PowerBI, Tibco Spotfire, SAS Visual Analytics o meno frequentemente su strumenti di BI enterprise come Oracle BI, SAP BO, Microstrategy per costruire dashboard operative o di taglio executive.

Il tuo lavoro consisterà nel progettare e realizzare questi ambienti, partendo dalla fase di Advisory della tecnologia più adatta, al dimensionamento, al disegno funzionale e tecnico, all’implementazione del dataset/mart, comprensivo di metriche e KPI calcolati e logiche di aggregazione, fino alla parte di dashboard grafica.

Come plus verrà valutata la capacità di coprire più strumenti (almeno 2 strumenti sono mandatori) e di saper realizzare anche visualizzazione attraverso librerie grafiche su linguaggi di programmazione (es. python, R, SAS) o su strumenti di office automation (es. reporting kit costruiti tramite automazione VBA su pacchetto Office).

Ti sarà richiesto, in modo commisurato alla tua seniority, di dimostrare ed evolvere le capacità di costruire relazioni con clienti, vendor, partner, assicurare il raggiungimento della migliore elaborazione dei risultati delle tue analisi comunicandoli efficacemente a colleghi, colleghe e Clienti e, per finire, il coordinamento di analisti/e più junior all’interno di team articolati.
Sarai tu ad entrare nel nostro Team?
Requisiti Indispensabili:
.       Ameno 6 anni di esperienza nel ruolo
·       Laurea Specialistica in Ingegneria Informatica, Ingegneria Matematica, Ingegneria delle Telecomunicazioni, Informatica, Statistica, Economia o discipline affini (STEM)
·       Esperienza comprovata su almeno due strumenti di data visualization (es. QlikView, QlikSense, Tableau, PowerBI, Spotfire, SAS VA) per la realizzazione end to end di dashboard/cruscotti
·       Esperienza su automazione reporting su Excel/Powerpoint/VBA

·       Esperienza nella redazione di specifiche funzionali e tecniche, design di data model e data mart, nelle diverse tecnologie sopra citate, calcolo KPI e metriche, sviluppo concept grafico, realizzazione, test, packaging, redazione manuali
·       Ottima conoscenza e competenza in ambito costrutti SQL
·       Conoscenza fluente di italiano e inglese
Plus:
·       Esperienza comprovata su strumenti di Business Intelligence tradizionale (SAP BO, Oracle BI, Microstrategy, Pentaho)
·       Esperienza comprovata su librerie grafiche di linguaggi di programmazione (es. Python, R, SAS Base/Guide, ecc.)
Soft Skills:
·       Standing consulenziale
·       Ottime doti relazionali e comunicative
·       Orientamento al cliente e al raggiungimento degli obiettivi
·       Buona attitudine a lavorare in team
·       Precisione e stress tolerance nel rispetto delle scadenze
·       Disponibilità per trasferte in Italia e all’estero
Perchè Bip?
Crescita e Formazione
Più di 300 corsi su tecnologie e business emergenti, programmi di sviluppo personalizzati e iniziative di training e people care per supportare la tua crescita professionale e personale.
Flessibilità e Work-Life Integration

Lavoro agile con possibilità di programmare le giornate da remoto e in ufficio con il proprio responsabile e in base alle esigenze di progetto, Banca Ore Solidale per usufruire o mettere a disposizione ore di permesso a colleghi e colleghe che vivono momenti di difficoltà e una cultura che favorisce l’equilibrio tra vita e lavoro.
Salute & Benefits
Assicurazione sanitaria, check-up agevolati, piattaforme per il benessere psicofisico e un piano welfare integrativo. Ticket restaurant e altri benefit dedicati.
Famiglia e Genitorialità

Supporto concreto a neogenitori: integrazione al 100% per i primi 3 mesi del congedo parentale o bonus una tantum, giorni extra per i papà e iniziative di supporto durante il congedo e al rientro in azienda.
Inclusione e Valori
Promuoviamo l’unicità e garantiamo pari opportunità a tutte le persone. Lavoriamo per un ambiente etico, equo e accogliente, anche attraverso politiche attive per le categorie protette (L. 68/99).
Cosa offriamo / What we offer
La retribuzione prevista per questa posizione è compresa tra € 45.000 e € 65.000 lordi annui, in funzione dell'esperienza, delle competenze e del livello di seniority del candidato.
L'inquadramento sarà definito durante il processo di selezione sulla base del profilo individuato e nel rispetto della normativa e del CCNL Metalmeccanici Industria
La retribuzione indicata si riferisce alla sola RAL (Retribuzione Annua Lorda).

Il pacchetto complessivo può includere ulteriori componenti variabili, correlate al raggiungimento di specifici obiettivi individuali e/o aziendali, welfare e benefit aziendali. La proposta economica finale sarà definita in base alle caratteristiche del profilo selezionato e alla coerenza con i requisiti della posizione.
Next Steps
Una volta ricevuto il tuo cv ci prenderemo del tempo per valutarlo attentamente.
Se c’è un match con questa o con altre posizioni aperte all’interno del Gruppo, ti contatteremo per iniziare la nostra conoscenza reciproca.
L’iter di selezione comprende generalmente un colloquio con HR, un colloquio tecnico con un line manager ed un eventuale colloquio con un Partner.
L’ordine e il numero delle interviste potrebbero variare a seconda delle esigenze di recruiting.
In alternativa, saremo felici di conservare il tuo CV nel nostro database per poterlo rivalutare per altre opportunità future.
Se dovessi identificare ulteriori posizioni di tuo interesse ed in linea con il tuo profilo, aspettiamo la tua
candidatura per poterla valutare nuovamente.

Commercial Analysis Specialist
Vuoi trasformare le tue passioni in un percorso di sviluppo continuo?

Come Commercial Analysis Specialist, sarai una figura chiave nel supportare le attività di analisi commerciale, monitoraggio dei mercati energetici e valorizzazione degli asset internazionali di Snam. Farai parte della Direzione Snam International, nello specifico all’interno del team Commercial and Operation Coordination, occupandoti di analisi qualitative e quantitative, sviluppo di strumenti di monitoraggio e supporto alle attività di asset management, business development e processi M&A.
Cosa Farai In Particolare

Contribuirai alle attività di analisi qualitativa e quantitativa sulle partecipate estere di Snam, con riferimento a flussi, capacità prenotate, indicatori commerciali e principali KPI di performance.
Supporterai la gestione degli strumenti di monitoraggio commerciale, tra cui dashboard, reportistica automatizzata e sistemi di news monitoring e tracking.

Parteciperai ad analisi e monitoraggio dei mercati di riferimento, con focus sulle dinamiche del gas, sull’evoluzione dei prezzi e sugli sviluppi infrastrutturali, quali gasdotti, stoccaggi e impianti di produzione.

Supporterai le attività di asset management attraverso analisi commerciali finalizzate a migliorare la performance delle società controllate e partecipate di Snam, anche in relazione all’offerta commerciale e all’identificazione di rischi e opportunità derivanti dai principali trend di mercato.
Contribuirai alla valutazione di opportunità su specifici progetti di asset management e business development, anche a supporto di eventuali processi di M&A.
Cosa serve per unirti al nostro team?
Laurea in Economia o Ingegneria.
Ottima conoscenza della lingua inglese.
Esperienza, anche breve, nel settore energy o in società di consulenza.
Conoscenza di strumenti di data analysis, quali Python, Excel e Power BI, ed esperienza nella creazione e gestione di dashboard e soluzioni di reportistica automatizzata.
Approccio analitico, con attenzione ai driver e ai trend di mercato, alla costruzione di scenari previsionali, alla definizione di KPI e al monitoraggio delle performance.
Forte interesse per il mercato dell’energia e per le infrastrutture energetiche.
Sei tu la persona che stiamo cercando?
Sei una persona affidabile, precisa e proattiva, con un forte orientamento all’analisi, alla qualità del dato e al miglioramento continuo degli strumenti di monitoraggio.
Sai pianificare le attività, individuare le priorità e gestire scadenze sfidanti, mantenendo efficacia e attenzione al dettaglio anche in contesti dinamici e sotto pressione.

Ti contraddistinguono buone capacità relazionali e comunicative, che ti consentono di collaborare con stakeholder a diversi livelli organizzativi, anticipando eventuali criticità e proponendo soluzioni efficaci.
Cosa offriamo
CCNL applicato: Energia e Petrolio
Tipologia contrattuale: Tempo Indeterminato
La retribuzione offerta sarà commisurata all’esperienza maturata e alle competenze specifiche.
La Retribuzione Annua Lorda minima per il ruolo è indicativamente pari a €43.668,66.
In caso di contratto di apprendistato professionalizzante, alla retribuzione sarà applicata la percentualizzazione prevista dal CCNL di riferimento per la specifica tipologia contrattuale.
La posizione è inoltre destinataria di un sistema incentivante annuale, secondo le policy aziendali.
Benefit
Nel nostro impegno per il benessere dei dipendenti e per favorire l’equilibrio tra lavoro e vita privata, offriamo un pacchetto completo di benefit tra cui:
Assicurazione Sanitaria: copertura completa per te e la tua famiglia
Previdenza complementare: risparmio pensionistico sostenuto dal datore di lavoro
Welfare e Wellbeing: accesso a un ampio programma di iniziative e convenzioni dedicate al benessere, allo sport, alla salute e alla qualità della vita
Modello di lavoro flessibile che include la possibilità di lavorare da remoto, per aiutarti a conciliare al meglio impegni professionali e personali
Offerta formativa: sosteniamo la crescita delle persone attraverso programmi di formazione continua e sviluppo professionale
Piano di Azionariato Diffuso: opportunità di aderire al piano di azionariato diffuso godendo di tutti i benefici riservati ai dipendenti del Gruppo

In conformità agli obblighi definiti dalla Direttiva UE 2023/970 e dalla normativa nazionale di recepimento, e coerentemente con procedure interne dedicate, Snam non richiede né raccoglie informazioni sulla retribuzione o sull’inquadramento pregressi dei/delle candidati/e: tali informazioni non vengono richieste durante i colloqui, né via e-mail, né tramite società di selezione, head hunter o altri soggetti terzi coinvolti nel processo

L’azienda si riserva, al termine del processo di selezione, in presenza di esperienza professionale e competenze tecniche e trasversali diverse dal profilo ricercato, di formulare una offerta retributiva differente rispetto a quanto riportato nel presente annuncio, nel rispetto degli obblighi di trasparenze definiti nel decreto rif. D. Lgs 96/26. A tal fine si è dotata di procedure interne volte ad assicurare l’adozione di fattori oggettivi e non discriminatori che possano motivare retribuzioni diverse nell’ambito di una medesima categoria di lavoratori.

Tutti gli annunci di lavoro da noi pubblicati si intendono rivolti ad ambo i sessi, a persone di tutte l’età e nazionalità (ex L.903/77, D.Lgs 215/03 e 216/03 s.m.i.). Informativa sul trattamento dati (GDPR: Reg. UE 2016/679).
Our Culture
At Snam, we believe that diversity is the key to innovation and long-term success. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where every voice is heard, respected and valued.
We actively promote fairness in hiring, professional development and career progression, while fostering a culture of open dialogue, collaboration, and continuous feedback.
We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified candidates, making our hiring decisions based solely on objective criteria and alignment with the requirements of the role.
Candidates whose profiles best match the position will be contacted and invited to participate in the selection process.

If you are ready to take on a new challenge and see yourself reflected in the profile described above, we encourage you to submit your application through the Snam Careers Portal. For further information, please contact carriere@snam.it.

Nel nostro impegno per il benessere dei dipendenti e per favorire l’equilibrio tra lavoro e vita privata, offriamo un pacchetto completo di benefit tra cui:

  • Assicurazione Sanitaria: copertura completa per te e la tua famiglia
  • Previdenza complementare: risparmio pensionistico sostenuto dal datore di lavoro
  • Welfare e Wellbeing: accesso a un ampio programma di iniziative e convenzioni dedicate al benessere, allo sport, alla salute e alla qualità della vita
  • Modello di lavoro flessibile che include la possibilità di lavorare da remoto, per aiutarti a conciliare al meglio impegni professionali e personali
  • Offerta formativa: sosteniamo la crescita delle persone attraverso programmi di formazione continua e sviluppo professionale
  • Piano di Azionariato Diffuso: opportunità di aderire al piano di azionariato diffuso godendo di tutti i benefici riservati ai dipendenti del Gruppo

In conformità agli obblighi definiti dalla Direttiva UE 2023/970 e dalla normativa nazionale di recepimento, e coerentemente con procedure interne dedicate, Snam non richiede né raccoglie informazioni sulla retribuzione o sull’inquadramento pregressi dei/delle candidati/e: tali informazioni non vengono richieste durante i colloqui, né via e-mail, né tramite società di selezione, head hunter o altri soggetti terzi coinvolti nel processo

L’azienda si riserva, al termine del processo di selezione, in presenza di esperienza professionale e competenze tecniche e trasversali diverse dal profilo ricercato, di formulare una offerta retributiva differente rispetto a quanto riportato nel presente annuncio, nel rispetto degli obblighi di trasparenze definiti nel decreto rif. D. Lgs 96/26. A tal fine si è dotata di procedure interne volte ad assicurare l’adozione di fattori oggettivi e non discriminatori che possano motivare retribuzioni diverse nell’ambito di una medesima categoria di lavoratori.

Our Culture

At Snam, we believe that diversity is the key to innovation and long-term success. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where every voice is heard, respected and valued.

We actively promote fairness in hiring, professional development and career progression, while fostering a culture of open dialogue, collaboration, and continuous feedback.

We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified candidates, making our hiring decisions based solely on objective criteria and alignment with the requirements of the role.

Candidates whose profiles best match the position will be contacted and invited to participate in the selection process.

If you are ready to take on a new challenge and see yourself reflected in the profile described above, we encourage you to submit your application through the Snam Careers Portal. For further information, please contact carriere@snam.it.

Data & Simulation Analyst

Als Data & Simulation Analyst ben je verantwoordelijk voor het vertalen van complexe en unieke klantbehoeften naar correcte, efficiënte en productieklare collatieschema’s voor collectible kaartenproducten.

Je zorgt ervoor dat alle kaartvarianten in de juiste aantallen, samenstellingen en configuraties in flowpacks, decks en displays terechtkomen, in lijn met zowel klantverwachtingen als productietechnische mogelijkheden.
Jouw functie
Met jouw analytische blik en technische feeling…
…Vertaal je klantbehoeften naar haalbare oplossingen
Je analyseert klantwensen en adviseert op basis van technische en statistische inzichten.
…Ontwerp je collatieschema’s van A tot Z
Je ontwikkelt vorm-, lay‑out- en dropschema’s en zorgt voor correcte kaartcombinaties.
Je maakt scenario­berekeningen voor duidelijke keuzes en alternatieven.
…Lever je sterke simulaties en analyses
Je bouwt displaysimulaties op basis van kansberekening.
Je maakt impactanalyses en rapporten die beslissingen ondersteunen.
…Bewaak je data en kwaliteit
Je houdt namelists en control sheets up-to-date.
Je voert nauwkeurige 4‑eyes checks uit.
…Optimaliseer je tools en processen
Je verbetert bestaande tools en workflows en ondersteunt toolontwikkeling.
…Communiceer je vlot met interne partners
Je stemt af met Sales en productie en maakt technische info begrijpelijk voor iedereen.
Jouw profiel
Je bent voor ons de ideale kandidaat omdat je…
Denkt op masterniveau en een wetenschappelijke of wiskundige achtergrond hebt.
Sterke analytische skills hebt en vaardig bent in statistische berekeningen.
Nauwkeurig werkt, een oog hebt voor detail en steeds gaat voor topkwaliteit (4 eyes mindset zit in jouw DNA).
Complexe materie helder kan uitleggen en graag meedenkt in oplossingen.
Uitblinkt in Excel. Basis tot programmeervaardigheden is mooi meegenomen.
De taal van zowel Sales als Productie begrijpt en deze werelden moeiteloos met elkaar verbindt.
Proactief verbeterkansen ziet en graag werkt aan efficiëntere processen en slimmere tools.
Je jezelf vlot kan uitdrukken in het Nederlands en Engels.
Aanbod

We bieden je de uitdaging om zelfstandig een boeiende en gevarieerde job uit te oefenen. Je komt terecht in een dynamische onderneming en een hecht team waar je kan werken in een aangename werksfeer. 4454542061,https://be.linkedin.com/jobs/view/data-analyst-at-rgf-staffing-belgium-4454542061?position=3&pageNum=0&refId=gtRqRUMTjCvZd5LQCICGzw%3D%3D&trackingId=WFx3Hm%2BnJjIV%2BPjIUWl2MQ%3D%3D,Data Analyst,RGF Staffing Belgium,"Antwerp, Flemish Region, Belgium","Streef jij naar optimalisatie, werk je graag zaken grondig uit en wil je ook je communicatieve vaardigheden kwijt? Dan is dit jouw job!
Als Data Analyst werk je samen met je collega's aan het creëren, onderhouden en beheren van centrale datastores die als inputbron dienen voor andere applicaties binnen onze organisatie.
Wat doe je concreet?

Je werkt mee aan integratie- en dataprojecten waarbij je in kaart brengt welke data centraal moet worden bijgehouden en beheerd. Je verzamelt de functionele requirements voor de betrokken datastore en vertaalt deze naar een helder datamodel, dat vervolgens verder wordt uitgewerkt door technische designers en developers.

Je neemt actief deel aan workshops om de mappings tussen applicaties en de centrale datastore te bespreken en te aligneren. In samenspraak met technische collega's maak je weloverwogen keuzes over het type database en de ontsluiting ervan — voornamelijk via webservices in een AWS-omgeving.
Daarnaast neem je deel aan integratietesten en ondersteun je de gebruikerstesten. Na livegang draag je bij aan de ondersteuning en het beheer van de systemen.

Je combineert proceskennis met analytisch vermogen: je begrijpt de databehoefte vanuit functioneel perspectief, schrijft heldere specificaties én werkt het datamodel uit dat als basis dient voor de databaseopbouw.
Jouw expertisedomein omvat onder meer:
MDM — kennis van Master Data Management is een pluspunt
column2: sommige databases worden volgens dit concept opgezet, andere eerder operationeel.

column1: SQL — een must om de nodige technische ondersteuning te kunnen bieden.
AI — bij voorkeur heb je ervaring met het inzetten van AI ter ondersteuning van analyse en testing.

GDPR & security — aangezien we werken met gevoelige persoonsdata, zijn audit, privacy en beveiliging geen bijzaak. Als analist ben jij verantwoordelijk voor het bewaken en verankeren van deze topics in elk design.
Wat is jouw profiel?
Je blikt terug op verschillende jaren ervaring binnen het domein rond datamodellering.
Je hebt ervaring in het gebruik van AI tools voor de ondersteuning van analyses & testen.
Dankzij jouw vlotte communicatieskills bouw je gemakkelijk professionele en constructieve relaties uit, zowel met de interne klant als met leveranciers.
Als teamplayer hou je ervan om samen met je collega’s resultaten en successen te behalen, maar je haalt evenzeer voldoening uit autonoom werken.
De volgende technische skills zijn een pluspunt:
Tools: Postman, Bruno, Jira, confluence
Databases: Oracle DB, MS SQL, PostGress, Aurora DB, Document DB
Begrippen: ISO27001, GDPR, MDM, ETL, UML

We’re looking for an Analytics Engineer to join our team in Ghent. If you’re looking to work in an international company in a role that offers autonomy, ownership and impact, this is the role for you!
💼 About The Role

As an Analytics Engineer, you will play a key role in shaping Qargo's data landscape. You'll build and maintain reliable data models, develop impactful dashboards, and turn complex datasets into actionable insights that support decision-making across the organisation.

This role offers plenty of variety and impact. You'll collaborate with product, engineering, sales, account management, finance, and customer onboarding teams to help make data a strategic asset for Qargo.
You'll contribute to both internal and customer-facing dashboards, help scale our data infrastructure, and support the continued growth of our analytics capabilities as Qargo expands.

Create product and engineering analytics, including feature usage dashboards using Mixpanel or custom-built tracking solutions.

Build billing and cost-analysis dashboards, including API call cost allocation and tenant-level breakdowns.
Continuously improve our analytics environment by identifying opportunities to optimise data quality, reporting, and processes.

Strong proficiency in SQL, data modelling, and dashboarding tools (Lightdash, Superset, Tableau, Looker, or Power BI).

Comfortable collaborating with multidisciplinary teams including product, engineering, sales, and finance.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to data quality and scalability.
A background in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Statistics, or a related field.
A proactive mindset and eagerness to learn, take ownership, and continuously improve.
🤝 What We Offer
Real impact and ownership in a growing international scale-up.
A supportive and collaborative team culture.
Hybrid working setup with flexibility and trust.
Opportunities to learn, grow, and expand your technical knowledge.
Competitive salary and benefits package.

4456316420,https://be.linkedin.com/jobs/view/datamanager-at-synergie-belgium-4456316420?position=9&pageNum=0&refId=gtRqRUMTjCvZd5LQCICGzw%3D%3D&trackingId=Zd1neZo2RraZNW88MACx3A%3D%3D,Datamanager,Synergie Belgium,"Hasselt, Flemish Region, Belgium","Binnen deze organisatie wordt een nieuwe rol van Data Engineer gecreëerd. Geen functie die al volledig in beton gegoten is, maar net een positie waarin je mee bepaalt welke richting je uitgaat. Je krijgt ruimte om verbeteringen te initiëren, projecten vast te pakken en met jouw analyses een directe impact te hebben op de werking en resultaten van de organisatie.
Je werkt rond pricing, productdata, procurement en procesoptimalisatie en krijgt daarbij de nodige verantwoordelijkheid én budgetten om ideeën ook daadwerkelijk te realiseren.
Jouw projecten en verantwoordelijkheden
Je analyseert prijs-, verkoop- en marktdata en vertaalt inzichten naar concrete acties.
Je beheert en optimaliseert de prijzenmatrix en wordt back-up voor de collega die de pricing mee bepaalt.
Je trekt projecten rond pricing, marktanalyse en procesoptimalisatie.
Je onderzoekt waar calculatie- en bedrijfsprocessen efficiënter kunnen.
Je vergelijkt het assortiment en prijsniveau met de markt en denkt mee over nieuwe producten.
Je onderhandelt mee met leveranciers en neemt een actieve rol op binnen procurement.
Je groeit uit tot een aanspreekpunt voor collega's en interne stakeholders.
De organisatie staat voor een belangrijke digitale transitie: de huidige software wordt vervangen door een nieuwe oplossing. Dat wordt één van de eerste projecten waarin je je tanden kunt zetten.
Wat zoeken we?

Je bent iemand die graag begrijpt waarom iets werkt zoals het werkt en vervolgens ook nadenkt over hoe het beter kan. Data, cijfers en processen spreken je aan, maar je verliest daarbij het commerciële plaatje niet uit het oog.
Je beschikt over een masterdiploma, of gelijkwaardig door ervaring in het vooropgestelde takenpakket.
Je hebt een sterk analytisch denkvermogen en werkt graag nauwkeurig en gestructureerd.
Complexe data of processen schrikken je niet af: je duikt erin, legt verbanden en komt graag tot een onderbouwd advies.
Je neemt graag zelf initiatief en voelt je goed bij een functie waarin je ruimte krijgt om zaken vast te pakken en verder uit te werken.
Naast je analytische blik heb je ook een commerciële ingesteldheid. Je begrijpt dat een goede pricingstrategie niet alleen technisch klopt, maar ook moet werken in de praktijk.
Je bent nieuwsgierig en leert graag bij, zeker wanneer het gaat over software, data, pricing of procesoptimalisatie.
Excel kent voor jou weinig geheimen. Ervaring met ERP-systemen of bijvoorbeeld Odoo is mooi meegenomen.
Je bent matuur in je aanpak en communiceert vlot met verschillende stakeholders, van collega's tot leveranciers.
Je spreekt zeer goed Nederlands. Frans is een sterke troef, maar geen absolute must.
Wat bieden we?

Je komt terecht in een organisatie die actief is in de wereld van ramen en deuren en is de drijvende kracht achter twee sterke merken! Via een uitgebreid franchisenetwerk zijn de merken actief in België, Nederland en Frankrijk. Vanuit het hoofdkantoor worden de franchisepartners ondersteund met onder meer producten, pricing, calculatie, processen en digitale oplossingen.

De organisatie telt over de drie landen heen zo’n 1.000 medewerkers. Jouw werk heeft daardoor een bredere impact: de processen en oplossingen waar jij aan meewerkt, ondersteunen een groot netwerk van medewerkers en franchisepartners.
Je krijgt de tijd om de organisatie, producten en processen grondig te leren kennen via een uitgebreid onboardingtraject. Daarna kan de functie verder evolueren volgens jouw talenten en interesses.
€3.700 – €5.600 bruto / maand
bedrijfswagen
maaltijdcheques van €8
groeps- en hospitalisatieverzekering
€150 netto onkostenvergoeding
gsm-abonnement en cafetariaplan
thuiswerkmogelijkheid
12 ADV-dagen
open, familiale bedrijfscultuur met ruimte voor initiatief
Dagelijks verse soep, fruit en fijne teammomenten
Zin om terecht te komen in een organisatie waar je niet alleen een functie krijgt, maar ook de ruimte om ze mee vorm te geven? Dan maken we graag kennis met jou.
Contacteer ons via freya.keirse@synergiejobs.be met je persoonlijke CV en we contacteren je asap.

4459853307,https://be.linkedin.com/jobs/view/data-analist-%E2%80%93-engineer-at-vlaams-instituut-voor-kwaliteit-van-zorg-4459853307?position=12&pageNum=0&refId=gtRqRUMTjCvZd5LQCICGzw%3D%3D&trackingId=EQRGkgSW13l%2FJ7QZ%2F7VyrA%3D%3D,Data Analist – Engineer,Vlaams Instituut voor Kwaliteit van Zorg,"Ghent, Flemish Region, Belgium","Wat doet het Vlaams Instituut voor Kwaliteit van Zorg (VIKZ)?

Het VIKZ heeft als doel om de kwaliteit van zorg in Vlaanderen te meten en transparant te maken met als doel deze te verbeteren. We zijn hiervoor een belangrijke partner van de Vlaamse Overheid. Met een team van projectcoördinatoren en data-analisten, en via de structurele samenwerking met de sectoren, experten en patiënten, ontwikkelen en berekenen we kwaliteitsindicatoren die inzicht bieden in de geleverde kwaliteit van zorg in de Vlaamse zorgvoorzieningen. Via Zorgkwaliteit.be publiceren we de resultaten van de gemeten kwaliteitsindicatoren openbaar. Hiermee willen we kwaliteitsverbetering stimuleren, bijdragen aan beleidsondersteuning en patiënten helpen bij het maken van geïnformeerde keuzes.

Functieomschrijving Het Vlaams Instituut voor Kwaliteit van Zorg (VIKZ) zoekt een Data Analist - Engineer (M/V/X) om het team te versterken. Wil je mee werken aan het meten, transparant maken en verbeteren van de kwaliteit van zorg in Vlaanderen? Heb je een passie voor het analyseren van grote datasets en het visualiseren van resultaten in interactieve dashboards? Dan is deze job iets voor jou!

We zijn in de eerste plaats op zoek naar een ervaren Data Analist die zijn of haar expertise wil inzetten voor de analyse van gezondheidsdata en het ontwikkelen van kwaliteitsindicatoren. Daarnaast krijg je de kans om je verder te ontwikkelen in data-engineering en mee te bouwen aan het dataplatform en datawarehouse achter Zorgkwaliteit.be.
Bij het VIKZ werk je met grote datasets. Je ontdekt patronen, vertaalt die naar heldere analyses en kwaliteitsindicatoren, en presenteert inzichten in duidelijke rapporten en interactieve dashboards.

Je ontwikkelt en onderhoudt robuuste data-analyse-pipelines die de volledige dataverwerking efficiënt, reproduceerbaar en zoveel mogelijk geautomatiseerd laten verlopen. Hierbij waak je over datakwaliteit en validatie: je voert interne en externe controles uit, detecteert anomalieën en zorgt dat de data betrouwbaar genoeg is om kwaliteitsindicatoren op te baseren.

Samen met inhoudelijke experten vertaal je de complexe analyses vervolgens naar begrijpbare inzichten voor zorgprofessionals, beleidsmakers en patiënten. Je slaat de brug tussen technische precisie en inhoudelijke relevantie, zodat data écht gebruikt wordt om de kwaliteit van zorg in Vlaanderen te verbeteren.

Daarnaast heb je de kans om het dataplatform en datawarehouse achter Zorgkwaliteit.be mee uit te bouwen en te verfijnen. Je ontwikkelt conceptuele datamodellen die het platform versterken en zorgt voor een doordacht beheer van metadata, een toekomstgerichte datawarehouse-architectuur en performante visualisatielagen. Je denkt actief mee over schaalbaarheid, datastromen, datakwaliteit en de optimale inrichting van het platform, zodat onze data-infrastructuur klaar is voor de groeiende hoeveelheid gezondheidsdata en nieuwe indicatoren.
Profiel Wat verwachten we van jou?

Je beschikt over een masterdiploma in een voor deze functie relevante richting, zoals bijvoorbeeld een Master in Statistical Data Analysis, Master Management en Beleid in de Gezondheidszorg, Master Biomedische Wetenschappen, Master in de Psychologie, Master in Economische Wetenschappen, Master Ingenieurswetenschappen, Master Handelsingenieur, Master in Toegepaste Informatica, telkens gekoppeld aan de benodigde ervaring met data-analyse
column2: een PhD is een plus.

column1: Je hebt een zeer goede beheersing van R en/of Python en Excel. Ervaring met SQL en/of PowerShell/bash zijn een plus.
Je hebt ervaring in het bouwen van visualisaties voor niet-technische stakeholders met behulp van dashboards zoals Tableau, PowerBI en/of Shiny apps.
Je hebt ervaring met of wil groeien in database-architecturen en databeheer, bij voorkeur Snowflake of Databricks.
Je hebt ervaring met reproduceerbare analyses en versiebeheer.
Het is een meerwaarde als je vertrouwd bent met de principes van informatieveiligheid en kennis hebt van gezondheidszorgdatabanken, coderings- en classificatiesystemen of analyse van survey data.

Je hebt een uitstekende beheersing van het Nederlands, aangezien je regelmatig overleg voert met zorgvoorzieningen, stakeholders en inhoudelijke experten. Daarnaast heb je een goede kennis van het Engels.
Wie je bent
Analytisch sterk — Je legt verbanden, structureert informatie en komt tot heldere conclusies.
Innovator — Je neemt initiatief, bent leergierig en werkt je expertise continu bij. Je gaat proactief op zoek naar verbetermogelijkheden.
Kwaliteitsgericht — Je werkt gestructureerd, efficiënt en met oog voor detail. Je bent kritisch en hebt een sterk probleemoplossend denkvermogen.
Teamspeler — Je werkt constructief samen met collega’s binnen en buiten het VIKZ om gezamenlijke doelen te verwezenlijken, met respect voor deadlines en afspraken.
Zelfstandig — Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor je projecten en werkt zelfstandig.

We beseffen dat we deze competenties en functievereisten allicht niet allemaal in dezelfde persoon zullen terugvinden. Het profiel is dan ook aan te passen op basis van de kandidatuur, waarbij complementariteit zal gezocht worden met de huidige teamleden en mogelijke toekomstige aanwervingen.
Aanbod Van € 4.000 tot € 6.000 per maand Wat bieden we jou?

Een voltijdse functie van onbepaalde duur in een jong team van een tiental data-analisten en projectcoördinatoren, in een intellectueel stimulerende netwerkorganisatie met grote maatschappelijke impact.

Marktconforme verloning met extralegale voordelen: lap top, gsm, structureel thuiswerk met telewerkvergoeding, vergoeding openbaar vervoer en fietsvergoeding, hospitalisatie- en groepsverzekering, vakantiegeld en 13e maand. Naast 20 wettelijke, tien extralegale verlofdagen.
Een werkplek in de kantoren van de Vlaamse Overheid in Gent, vlot bereikbaar met openbaar vervoer. De mogelijkheid tot thuiswerk van twee dagen per week is structureel voorzien.

We provide our clients with professional services, specialised aerospace and defence sales, delivery, and operational subject matter expertise. We are looking for personnel to join our team and support key client projects.
Who we are supporting

The NATO Communication and Information Agency (NCIA) is responsible for providing secure and effective communications and information technology (IT) services to NATO's member countries and its partners. The agency was established in 2012 and is headquartered in Brussels, Belgium.
The NCIA provides a wide range of services, including:
Cyber Security: The NCIA provides advanced cybersecurity solutions to protect NATO's communication networks and information systems against cyber threats.
Command and Control Systems: The NCIA develops and maintains the systems used by NATO's military commanders to plan and execute operations.
Satellite Communications: The NCIA provides satellite communications services to enable secure and reliable communications between NATO forces.
Electronic Warfare: The NCIA provides electronic warfare services to support NATO's mission to detect, deny, and defeat threats to its communication networks.
Information Management: The NCIA manages NATO's information technology infrastructure, including its databases, applications, and servers.
Overall, the NCIA plays a critical role in ensuring the security and effectiveness of NATO's communication and information technology capabilities.
The program
Assistance and Advisory Service (AAS)

The NATO Communications and Information Agency (NCI Agency) is NATO’s principal C3 capability deliverer and CIS service provider. It provides, maintains and defends the NATO enterprise-wide information technology infrastructure to enable Allies to consult together under Article IV, and, when required, stand together in the face of attack under Article V.

To provide these critical services, in the modern evolving dynamic environment the NCI Agency needs to build and maintain high performance-engaged workforce. The NCI Agency workforce strategically consists of three major categorise's: NATO International Civilians (NIC)'s, Military (Mil), and Interim Workforce Consultants (IWC)'s. The IWCs are a critical part of the overall NCI Agency workforce and make up approximately 15 percent of the total workforce.
Role ID – C005356
Role Duties and Responsibilities
Support data source onboarding by maintaining the Data Source registry and validating that the data presented matches the data model and has ingested correctly

Analyse data sources related to assets, configurations and vulnerabilities, including identifying and cataloguing relevant data sources, extracting pertinent data, assessing vulnerabilities and security gaps, and reviewing asset configurations against established security standards

Lead technical discussions on data sources, correlation and SOPs, including setting agendas, facilitating discussions, synthesising diverse viewpoints, and hosting and attending data boards, including running the data governance board

Prepare and present technical findings, provide recommendations and document results, including compiling and analysing data-driven insights, preparing technical reports and presentations, and documenting the methodology, results and implications of the analysis

Review the project service for depth, compliance and vulnerability exposure, including examining the service architecture, configurations, operational procedures, documentation, SOPs and technical reports to identify discrepancies, compliance requirements, areas for improvement and potential vulnerabilities.
Attend, input and where necessary lead various boards including the Data Source Onboarding Group and Data Governing Board.
Essential Skills, Experience and Certifications
Nationally recognized/certified engineering university/college qualification with preferably Master of Science degree and 3 years post-related experience

4463504176,https://be.linkedin.com/jobs/view/bi-analyst-%E2%80%94-power-bi-and-data-pipelines-for-nato-with-security-clearance-at-wlg-4463504176?position=17&pageNum=0&refId=gtRqRUMTjCvZd5LQCICGzw%3D%3D&trackingId=Vaa6RYr2hbsfIVFdTZjDIw%3D%3D,BI Analyst — Power BI and Data Pipelines for NATO with security clearance,WLG,"Braine-l’Alleud, Walloon Region, Belgium","An enterprise service performance dashboard has come out of prototype and now has real users, real feedback and a growing list of service providers who need to feed data into it. A small analytics team is being formed to take it further: more features, a better interface, and pipelines that can absorb far more service data than they do today.
You would be one of five analysts in that team, working alongside a service level manager, on site with the customer's own technical staff.
What You Would Be Doing
Analysing how services are performing and turning that into metrics people will actually act on.
Designing and building new dashboard features, from the first look at user feedback through to the released version.
Improving the experience of using the dashboard — the visualisations, the accessibility and the plain usability of it.
Designing the data collection interface: formats, measurements and controls, written up as a specification and taken through a formal review with the people who will use it.
Building, testing and deploying that interface so several service providers can supply their own performance data to one standard.
Building and automating the pipelines behind it with Python and modern ETL tooling, so the dashboard scales as more services are added.
Operating and maintaining what you build — incidents, access requests, user questions and training — against agreed availability and resolution targets.
Keeping the as-built documentation, use cases and data model accurate as the thing changes.
What you would bring
A relevant degree from a recognised university and at least four years of related experience, as a data analyst, data scientist or UX designer.
Demonstrable Python, and SQL against relational databases such as SQL Server.
Real depth in data visualisation, principally Power BI.
Experience building and integrating APIs so that monitoring can be driven by data rather than by hand.
Experience managing data flows with ETL and ELT tooling — Apache NiFi specifically is required.
Sound knowledge of KPIs and formal reporting through dashboards, including how to design user-experience metrics and monitor them.
Practical UX and UI design skills, and experience of IT service management.
The ability to write technical documentation, requirements and user guides, and to translate between what users ask for and what gets built.
Excellent spoken and written communication, with good briefing skills.

4428822035,https://be.linkedin.com/jobs/view/customer-data-analyst-at-delhaize-belgium-4428822035?position=18&pageNum=0&refId=gtRqRUMTjCvZd5LQCICGzw%3D%3D&trackingId=QtYW4xzjVLwE5zPZhcmCkA%3D%3D,Customer Data Analyst,Delhaize Belgium,"Asse, Flemish Region, Belgium","Wat ga je doen

Als Audience Analyst word je betrokken in het hart van Delhaizes marketingactivteiten, namelijk de customer data. Je gaat aan de slag met onze eigen (1st party) klantendata en maakt je deze volledig eigen. Via gerichte analyses, het identificeren van commerciele opportuniteiten en detecteren van patronen zorg je voor een essentiële meerwaarde naar onze interne en externe stakeholders toe. Jouw input is immers van essentieel belang om enerzijds de klantenbetrokkenheid te verhogen alsook de interne strategische richtlijnen verder vorm te geven.
Jouw Verantwoordelijkheden
Je verzamelt, structureert en onderhoudt een breed scala aan marketingdatasources (klantgegevens, campagnedata, prestatiedashboards,… ).
Op basis hiervan lever je actiegerichte inzichten om de marketingbesluitvorming te ondersteunen.
Je reageert op ad-hoc dataverzoeken van jouw collega-marketeers, gaande van eenvoudige query’s tot meer geavanceerde analyses.
Je analyseert grondig het klantgedrag, de prestaties van verschillende kanalen en de efficiëntie van de marketingfunnel.
Je detecteert proactief trends, patronen en opportuniteiten in data om gerichte targeting, personalisatie en de optimalisatie van campagnes te ondersteunen.
Je maakt rapporten op met duidelijke conclusies en inzichten en je zorgt voor continue optimalisatie, en dit met de ondersteuning van D&A, Local IT en de groep.
Je waarborgt de kwaliteit, consistentie en nauwkeurigheid van data en rapporten, inclusief correcte metricdefinities, zodat het marketingteam kan steunen op betrouwbare inzichten en besluitvorming.

4457349348,https://be.linkedin.com/jobs/view/analytics-engineer-northern-belgium-at-xebia-4457349348?position=23&pageNum=0&refId=gtRqRUMTjCvZd5LQCICGzw%3D%3D&trackingId=iAagtQlfAloEUDsK%2FCK3hw%3D%3D,Analytics Engineer (Northern Belgium),Xebia,"Antwerp, Flemish Region, Belgium","DOES THIS SOUND LIKE YOU?

Your passion is data and analytics. You want to create value for our clients by uncovering, organizing, and making sense of data. You understand that it is important to build robust solutions. You feel comfortable operating in the sweet spot between business and engineering.
WHAT YOU WILL DO TO MAKE ORGANIZATIONS DATA-DRIVEN

The Analytics Engineer is the bridge between business and analytics. You understand what data can bring to the organization. With your effective communication skills, you help uncover business needs and how to support them with data, reporting, and visualization. You use software engineering best practices to write production-grade data pipelines, making high-quality data available for creating business value with analytics. You leverage modern tooling to model, test, and document data.

Your efforts enable data democratization by improving the reliability and accessibility of data products. As an Analytics Engineer, you play a vital role in empowering end users to make data-driven decisions.
Check out our website or one of our customer stories to get a more detailed understanding of what we do.
Interested in learning more about how and why the role of Analytics Engineering emerged? You can read this blogpost from one of our Analytics Engineers!
WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

Within the Analytics Engineering team, we are looking for like-minded people that we would like to work with. We are not looking for a specific type of professional. We all come from very different cultural and educational backgrounds. We love this diversity, and we built an inclusive culture around it. We do not judge, instead, we care about and support each other. We share a genuine curiosity about what we do, and together we get better at it every day. We look for people with this mindset before anything else. The Analytics Engineer is part of the central data platform team and reports to the Data Platform Lead. The Analytics Engineer works closely with the Data Engineers, the Data Governance Specialist, and the Data Stewards from the domains. During the Foundation and Operationalization phases, the Analytics Engineer temporarily fulfills the steward role for departments that do not yet have their own Data Steward.
Responsibilities and tasks
· Designing and building data transformations that convert raw data from the platform into semantic datasets and data products
· Developing reports, dashboards, and analytical datasets in collaboration with Data Stewards and business users
· Translating content-related questions from the business into technical data products in collaboration with the Data Steward of the relevant domain
· Contributing to the business glossary in Microsoft Purview, particularly regarding the definitions resulting from transformations
· Documenting datasets and data products in a manner accessible to business users
· Performing acceptance tests on data deliveries together with the Data Owner and requester
· Contributing to data quality incidents as described in process 3 of the TOM, particularly regarding reports arising from transformations or data products
· Participating in the agile working method of the team
· Contribute to code reviews and quality assurance of the work of fellow engineers
WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

As an Analytics Engineer, you are the one who converts raw data into something the business can actually work with. You will work in a team of five data specialists and maintain continuous contact with colleagues from the business to understand their information needs and translate them into concrete data products.
Your responsibilities include, among others:
· Contributing ideas regarding architectural coherence and identifying technical debt
· Designing and building data transformations that convert raw data into usable datasets and reports
· Translating business requirements into technical data products in collaboration with the Data Stewards from the domains
· Building reports and analytical datasets that assist in operational and strategic decision-making.
· Temporarily fulfilling a steward role for departments that have not yet appointed their own Data Steward, acting as the bridge between that department and the data platform
· Documenting what you build in a way that is understandable to both fellow engineers and business users
· Working in an agile team where shared quality and delivery come first
THIS IS YOUR DREAM JOB IF…
✅ You love creating value by solving various problems with data, in the most sustainable and robust way.
✅ You are trained as a data analyst, scientist, or engineer but have a deep interest in data modeling and software engineering best practices.
✅ You are a jack-of-all-trades, who wants to become a true authority in the field by learning new skills and trying out the latest data tools.

✅ You have excellent communication skills, are interested in learning about the whole data cycle, can write efficient SQL queries, have hands-on experience with Python, Dbt, and cloud platforms, and you stand out for your expertise in one or more areas of analytics engineering.
✅ You like staying on projects long-term.
THIS IS NOT YOUR DREAM JOB IF…
❌ You always take the academic approach to data and analytics and find it hard to be pragmatic.
❌ You do not enjoy communicating with stakeholders, getting to know the needs of the business, and formulating sustainable solutions.
❌ You do not want to become an authority. You are hesitant to take a proactive approach and bring your ideas forward.
❌ You dislike sharing knowledge by leading trainings, organizing workshops, or writing blog posts.
❌You are not located in Belgium and cannot accommodate the required on-site presence of approximately three days per week.
WHAT IT IS LIKE TO BE A CONSULTANT AT XEBIA DATA

As a consultant at Xebia Data, you will have projects of varying length. Some are 2 weeks, some are 1 year, most are in between. Every project is different, as is every client. We, however, always deliver the best quality possible. It is not always easy, but it is always rewarding. You will have exposure to different companies, different problems, different systems and solutions. You will be surrounded by experts in different fields, and you will learn so many new things in a short time. Xebia Data offers the perfect environment to shine as a data professional.

You will never be alone on this journey. We have all experienced imposter syndrome, had a difficult project, or felt down at times. We know what it takes, we know it is difficult sometimes, and we will be there for you when you need it. We say People First, and we mean it.
Xebia Data offers you great benefits too, of course!

We work in a hybrid model – at client sites, in our own office in Amsterdam Oostenburg, and from home. While flexibility is important, coming to the office is essential for building the close-knit team we are. We value team cohesion, knowledge and personal development, innovation, and fun. We strive for authority in everything we do. At most companies, you'll see similar statements, but at Xebia Data, we back this up with concrete benefits:
Monthly Hackathons
Full-day hackathons on company time. You can choose to work on whatever and with whomever. Want to invite a friend from outside? No problem.
Development Budget
€5,000 per year and 6 days of dedicated development time – it's your obligation to spend it on anything that will make you a better data professional.
Conferences and Speaking
Attending and speaking at relevant conferences doesn't come out of your vacation time.
Knowledge Sharing
Bi-weekly knowledge sharing events with your Xebia colleagues that include dinner.
Sandbox Environments ☁️
Build, test, and experiment with anything you want in our GCP, AWS, and Azure sandbox environments.
A modern office in Eindhoven and Antwerp
Great Community
We're heavily involved in our community by sponsoring, hosting, and organizing events. Have an idea for a meetup we should sponsor? Or want to start a new one? Let's do it!
Physical and Mental Well-being
Great benefits for your physical and mental health, plus free healthy lunches and not-so-healthy drinks/snacks at our offices.
Tech and Mobility Budget
A generous tech budget, plus a monthly mobility budget to spend on leasing a car, leasing the e-bike of your dreams, or getting an NS Business Card.
Unlimited Book Budget
Feed your curiosity and keep learning – order any books you want, on us.
Very Good Pension Plan
We've got your future covered with a solid pension plan.
Fun events and activities like ski trips, BBQs, cooking workshops and more! 👩🏽 🍳

Our core values are people first, quality without compromise, knowledge sharing, and customer intimacy. At Xebia Data, you will find like-minded colleagues who are at the forefront of their field and have the courage to go off the beaten track

4453435689,https://be.linkedin.com/jobs/view/data-management-analyst-erp-at-erprecruit-4453435689?position=24&pageNum=0&refId=gtRqRUMTjCvZd5LQCICGzw%3D%3D&trackingId=1Mr%2FDiB31e%2F%2BamWDbjyeug%3D%3D,Data Management Analyst (ERP),ERPrecruit,"Antwerp, Flemish Region, Belgium","The Role

Our client is looking for a Data Management Analyst to support the accuracy, setup, maintenance, and overall integrity of master data. This role is responsible for ensuring high-quality, consistent, and reliable data across business applications, including ERP systems.

The successful candidate will use strong analytical and problem-solving skills to understand and deliver business data requirements. They will play an important role in maintaining data integrity across the organisation, with a strong understanding of master data management, information lifecycle management, data modelling, data governance, and business requirements gathering.
This role is based at our client's offices in Kontich & Antwerp, Belgium offices and reports directly to the Global MDM Manager.
Key Responsibilities
Master Data Management & Analysis
Execute master data setup, maintenance, and configuration across ERP systems and other business applications.
Manage master data requests through workflow tools and central mailboxes, ensuring requests are completed accurately and within agreed service levels.
Partner with internal and external stakeholders to ensure data management processes, policies, and procedures are followed.
Review and analyse business requests to ensure they are complete, accurate, and compliant with established data standards before processing.
Identify, investigate, and resolve master data discrepancies and data quality issues.
Provide master data support to business functions across IKO as required.
Collaborate with business teams to understand their data requirements and provide data-driven recommendations.
Review and continuously improve master data request guidelines, processes, and procedures to increase efficiency and data quality.
Escalate complex or high-impact data issues to the Global MDM Manager when appropriate.
Data Quality, Governance & Continuous Improvement
Monitor the overall health and quality of master data and perform regular data cleansing activities.
Conduct data audits, validation checks, and quality assessments to identify gaps, trends, and improvement opportunities.
Analyse data and processes to identify opportunities for redesign, optimisation, and continuous improvement.
Maintain a strong understanding of end-to-end business processes and apply this knowledge to support data integrity and management.
Complete daily and weekly data quality and integrity activities.
Ensure agreed service level agreements (SLAs) are consistently met.
Work independently to investigate and resolve moderately complex data issues, seeking guidance or escalating more complex matters when required.
Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of data governance standards, controls, and processes.
Business Analysis & Cross-Functional Collaboration
Support internal projects requiring data analysis, master data expertise, or data quality support.
Gather and analyse business requirements for workflow, process improvement, and other initiatives that may impact master data.
Apply business analysis techniques to identify data requirements, process dependencies, and potential impacts.
Work closely with Business, IT, MDM, and other cross-functional teams to understand requirements and provide analytical insights.
Support the design and implementation of improved data and workflow processes.
Build effective working relationships across the organisation and contribute positively within a collaborative, team-oriented environment.
Our Ideal Candidate
We are looking for someone who combines strong analytical capabilities with a practical understanding of master data and business processes.
Experience & Qualifications
Minimum 2 years’ experience in Master Data Management or a closely related data management role.

Sinds onze oprichting in 2020 is Mint Tandartsen uitgegroeid tot een ambitieuze speler in de dentale sector. Vandaag bouwen we verder aan een snel uitbreidend netwerk van tandartspraktijken en een toonaangevende tandtechnische labogroep. Onze groei wordt gedreven door een actieve M&A-strategie en een sterke focus op kwaliteit, innovatie en ondernemerschap. We bouwen, optimaliseren en schalen met een duidelijke focus op kwaliteit, efficiëntie en ondernemerschap. Geen logge structuren, maar een hands-on omgeving waar initiatief nemen en impact maken centraal staan.

In dit dynamische scale-upverhaal zijn we vandaag op zoek naar een Application & Data Analyst - Patient Management Systems. Je werkt in ons Operations team en staat in contact met onze Performance Manager, COO, IT en de rest van het Operations en Integration team.

Als Application & Data Analyst ben je de expert en het centrale aanspreekpunt voor onze Patient Management Systemen, met een sterke focus op DentAdmin en CareConnect. Je zorgt ervoor dat onze praktijken maximaal rendement halen uit deze tools. Je gebruikt data en inzichten om processen binnen het service center en de groep continu te verbeteren. Je combineert een analytische blik met een hands-on mentaliteit en werkt nauw samen met de operationele teams, praktijkverantwoordelijken en management.
EEN GREEP UIT HET TAKENPAKKET VAN APPLICATION & DATA ANALYST - PATIENT MANAGEMENT SYSTEMS:
· Je bent de interne expert en key user voor DentAdmin en CareConnect
· Je analyseert data uit beide systemen en vertaalt deze naar bruikbare inzichten en dashboards
· Je identificeert opportuniteiten voor procesoptimalisatie en operationele verbeteringen binnen onze tandartspraktijken
· Je ontwikkelt en implementeert standaarden en best practices voor het gebruik van de PMS-systemen
· Je ondersteunt en begeleidt gebruikers bij vragen, incidenten en optimalisaties
· Je begrijpt de onderliggende datastructuur van de PMS-systemen: hoe tabellen, velden en modules onderling gelinkt zijn en met elkaar interageren
· Je werkt als brug tussen de PMS-databron en onze bredere data-architectuur (NetSuite, datawarehouse, Power BI)
· Je werkt samen met softwareleveranciers om verbeteringen en nieuwe functionaliteiten te implementeren
· Je neemt een actieve rol op in digitaliserings- en verbeterprojecten binnen de organisatie
· Je monitort KPI's en rapporteert over de prestaties van onze praktijken op basis van data uit de PMS-systemen

HET PROFIEL VAN DE IDEALE APPLICATION & DATA ANALYST:
Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands en Engels. Kennis van het Frans is een pluspunt
Je hebt een bachelor- of masterdiploma of bent gelijkwaardig door ervaring.
Je hebt ervaring met practice management software, ERP-systemen of andere operationele softwareplatformen.

Ervaring met DentAdmin, CareConnect of software binnen de zorgsector is een sterke troef. Heb je die nog niet, dan sta je te open om deze zeer grondig te analyseren en te begrijpen gedurende een periode van enkele weken waarbij je effectief naar de praktijken gaat.
Je kan om met een dynamische omgeving en bent stressbestendig
Je hebt een positieve ‘can do’ attitude
Je bent down-to-earth en spontaan in de omgang
Je hebt een teamplayer mentaliteit maar kan ook perfect autonoom werken
Je kan omgaan met verschillende stakeholders en kan op een duidelijke, gestructureerde manier communiceren
Je hanteert een kritische blik, hebt oog voor detail en weet steeds de juiste vragen te stellen
Het water is nooit troebel voor jou, je ziet wat wel en niet moet gebeuren en weet de juiste accenten en prioriteiten te leggen

Een gevarieerde en uitdagende job door dediversiteit aan entiteiten
Een gedreven team met collega’s die elkaar ondersteunen en waar het delen van kennis centraal staat
De kans om mee te groeien met de snel evoluerende organisatie en gaandeweg meer verantwoordelijkheid op te nemen

Post Context Supreme Headquarters Allied Powers Europe (SHAPE) provides an integrated Strategic Effects framework, employing a multi-domain and multi-region focus to create a 360-degree approach, with the flexibility to enable, upon direction, a seamless transition from Baseline Activities and Current Operations (BACO) up to the Maximum Level of Effort (MLE). SHAPE supports SACEUR in fulfilling his terms of reference, as directed by the North Atlantic Council.
The J9 Cooperation and Liaison Division provides overarching direction, coordination and advice across ACO on interaction between the Civil and Military entities.

The Support Analyst provides Systems oversight, including the data management, data collection requirements and operationalization of the NATO CIMIC Analysis and Assessment Capability (NCAAC) throughout ACO and in coordination with NATO HQ.
Principal Duties The incumbent's duties are:

Provide ACO’s data specific inputs as contribution to the Capability Development process through all its phases during the NCAAC development, including inputs for the development of NATO’s CIMIC database/area of interest and the articulation of data for the development and update of tools answering ACO’s CIMIC Community of Interest (CoI) dashboards.
Gather and organise data as per the CIMIC analysts requirements and ensure its accuracy and completeness.
Present findings through reports, dashboards, and visual representations to aid decision-making.
Contribute to ensure data integrity, to the protection of sensitive information, in accordance with NATO regulations and directives.
Provide guidance to deliver training for the preparation and the delivery of data using visualisation tools and dashboards in the NCAAC.

Provide the NCAAC with existing data digested from other existing Functional Area Systems in ACO, and from similar initiatives by the Resilience Committee in NATO HQ (IS) and other relevant stakeholders.
Provide CIMIC data to other Functional Area Systems in ACO if required.

Special Requirements and Additional Duties The employee may be required to perform a similar range of duties elsewhere within the organisation at the same grade without there being any change to the contract
The incumbent may be required to undertake TDY assignments both within and without NATO’s boundaries and be willing to work unsocial hours.
The work is normally performed in a Normal NATO office working environment.
Normal Working Conditions apply.
The risk of injury is categorised as No risk / risk might increase when deployed.
Essential Qualifications
Professional/Experience
Minimum of 2 years post-related experience relating to information and data management, analytics or a related field in line with expertise and competencies outlined for this role.
Experience managing large and complex data sets, including both structured (e.g., relational databases, time-series data) and unstructured data (e.g., natural language, sensor data).

Experience with data processing (regular and distributed), data transformation, integration and analysis, including cleaning, and pre-processing of structured and unstructured data for statistical modelling.
Experience with NATO or national Intelligence Requirements Management and Request for Information processes.
Experience with protecting, managing, and storing sensitive and classified information, in accordance with NATO regulations and directives.

Education/Training Higher Secondary education and completed higher vocational training in information technology, economics, statistics, operations research or related discipline leading to a formal technical or professional certification with 3 years function related experience, or Secondary education and completed advanced vocational training in that discipline leading to a professional qualification or professional accreditation with 5 years post related experience.
In case of ambiguity the required job specific experience have priority over the standard education and training levels described here.
Language English - SLP 3333 - (Listening, Speaking, Reading and Writing)
Desirable Qualifications
Professional Experience
Experience in briefing and communicating analytical products with senior military and civilian staff.
Practical experience using big data ecosystems.
Knowledge of NATO software application services e.g.TOPFAS, NCOP, MAVEN Smart System or national equivalent.
Experience designing and delivering training for the use of information systems and processes.

Attributes/Competencies Personal Attributes: The range of personal attributes required for this post are very demanding and exacting, but without them the function will fail. Foremost, an analytical mind is needed to identify and evaluate complex and competing issues and that can develop imaginative yet still pragmatic solutions. Inter-personal skills must also be highly developed. The post holder will be working in an international community where different cultural values and styles exist. The holder will need to be able to work successfully with staff at all levels of the organization, from the lower ranks during the analysis work up to the highest levels when presenting findings and recommendations. This requires tact, judgement and agility. High standards of personal and professional behavior and moral courage are also needed.

Professional Contacts: The incumbent must be comfortable to engage with a range of individuals from across ACO SHAPE and also with the NATO Command Structure and Partner nations. This will be a mixture of Military and Civilian personnel. The individual must have a high level of understanding and be cognizant of sensitivities with an international environment.
REMARKS:

Duration of contract: The successful candidate will fill this post as a Project Linked NATO International Civilian (PLN) with a three-year definite duration contract within the NATO 2030 Agenda. On expiry of this term the PLN will be deleted or absorbed into the ceiling pending approval or will exceptionally be considered for extension.

The salary will be the basic entry-level monthly salary defined by the NATO Grade of the post, which may be augmented by allowances based on the selected staff member’s eligibility, and which is subject to the withholding of approximately 20% for pension and medical insurance contributions.

NATO is committed to diversity and inclusion, and strives to provide equal access to employment, advancement, and retention, independent of gender, age, nationality, ethnic origin, religion or belief, cultural background, sexual orientation, and disability. NATO welcomes applications of nationals from all member Nations.

Building integrity is a key element of NATO’s core tasks. As an employer, NATO values commitment to the principles of integrity, transparency, and accountability in accordance with international norms and practices established for the defence and related security sector. Selected candidates are expected to be role models of integrity, and to promote good governance through ongoing efforts in their work.

Applicants who prove to be competent for the post but who are not successful in this competition may be offered an appointment in another post of a similar nature, which might become vacant in the near future, albeit at the same or lower grade, provided they meet the necessary requirements.
We believe that all people are capable of great things. Because of this, we encourage you to apply even if you do not meet all of the criteria listed within this job description.
HOW TO APPLY FOR A NATO CIVILIAN POST AT SHAPE:

Applications are to be submitted using NATO Talent Acquisition Platform (NTAP) (https://nato.taleo.net/careersection/2/jobsearch.ftl?lang-en). Applications submitted by other means (e.g. mail, e-mail, fax, etc) are not accepted.
More information to be found on these links:
6 Tips for Applying to NATO
Application Process

Shortlisted candidates will be requested to provide original documentary evidence and a set of copies supporting statements in their applications. Appointment is subject to obtaining a NS security clearance and a medical certificate.
Final remarks:
Only nationals from the 32 NATO member states can apply for vacancies at SHAPE.

Applications are automatically acknowledged within one working day after submission. In the absence of an acknowledgement please make sure the submission process is completed, or, re-submit the application.
Qualified redundant staff of the same grade interested in this post should inform this office, via their HR/Personnel Office by not later than vacancy’s closing date.
Candidates’ individual telephone, e-mail or telefax enquiries cannot be dealt with. All candidates will receive an answer indicating the outcome of their application.

NATO will not accept any phase of the recruitment and selection prepared, in whole or in part, by means of generative artificial-intelligence (AI) tools, including and without limitation to chatbots, such as Chat Generative Pre-trained Transformer (Chat GPT), or other language generating tools. All applications prepared, in whole or in part, by means of such generative or creative AI applications may be rejected without further consideration at NATO’s sole discretion, and NATO reserves the right to take further steps in such cases as appropriate.

About Us

Bridgestone Americas, Inc. (BSAM), headquartered in Nashville, Tennessee, and Bridgestone Europe, Middle East and Africa (BSEMEA), headquartered in Brussels, Belgium, operate collectively as a “Bridgestone West” strategic region. This region services the strategic business needs of teams across the Americas, Europe, Middle East and Africa. BSAM and BSEMEA are subsidiaries of Bridgestone Corporation, globally headquartered in Japan. Bridgestone and its subsidiaries develop, manufacture and market a wide range of Bridgestone, Firestone and associate brand products and solutions to address the needs of a broad range of customers and industries.
About The Role
Job Purpose

As part of the Procurement Operations, Digitalization & Strategic Excellence team, the Procurement Data & Digital Excellence Specialist is responsible for building and maintaining the data foundations that enable modern, data-driven procurement operations.

The role ensures procurement data is accurate, reliable, governed, and accessible in real time to support operational excellence, advanced analytics, and AI-enabled capabilities. Working closely with procurement, IT, data engineering, and business stakeholders, the specialist will transform procurement data into a strategic asset that drives better decision-making and continuous improvement

Also, Bridgestone Europe is embedding AI across multiple ERP (mostly SAP - S/4HANA, BDC) landscapes and platforms. Within Procurement, this role delivers the data products that make those use cases possible: clearly defined, properly modelled, documented, and trusted.
Responsibilities
Data Governance & Stewardship
Act as the Procurement Data Steward for master and transactional procurement data.
Define, implement and continuously improve procurement data standards, governance and quality rules.
Monitor data quality KPIs and drive corrective actions with business and IT teams.
Ensure data consistency across SAP and connected procurement applications.
Data Foundation & Architecture

Data Attribute Definition: Define and document data attributes, business rules, calculation logic, and field-level definitions for all procurement data products — spend, suppliers, contracts, and purchasing KPIs.
Collaborate with IT and Data Platform teams to ensure procurement data is available, secure and scalable.
Support the integration of SAP data with enterprise data platforms and analytical environments.
Contribute to the evolution of procurement data architecture.
Source-to-Target Validation: mappings from SAP S/4HANA and various data sources into SAP Business Data Cloud and Databricks, ensuring data flows correctly and completely.
Analytics & Business Intelligence
Develop and maintain procurement dashboards, KPIs and self-service reporting solutions.
Translate business requirements into actionable reporting and analytics.
Support procurement category managers and leadership with insightful data analysis.
Promote data-driven decision making throughout the procurement organization.
AI Enablement
Ensure procurement data is AI-ready by improving its quality, structure and accessibility.
Support the deployment of AI and Generative AI use cases within procurement.
Partner with Digital and AI teams to identify opportunities for automation and predictive analytics.
Qualifications & Experience Required
Education, Master, other certification:
Master’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Statistics, or a related field.
SAP certifications or proven experience in S/4HANA, BTP, Datasphere / Business Data Cloud, SAP Analytics Cloud, Databricks, or hyperscaler data platforms are a strong advantage.
Training in data modelling, data governance, or AI and machine learning fundamentals is a plus.
Experience (years):
3-5 years in a data, analytics, procurement operations, or procurement technology role.
SAP is essential: hands-on experience with S/4HANA procurement data structures, plus exposure to SAP Business Data Cloud, Datasphere, BTP, and SAP Business AI.
Proven end-to-end delivery of data products, from definition to production, not one-off extracts.
Hands-on experience with Databricks, Python, and SQL within a lakehouse or cloud data platform.
Experience with integration and harmonisation of data across multiple or heterogeneous ERP systems.
Experience preparing and governing data for AI, machine learning, or advanced analytics use cases.
International, multi-country transformation programmes are a plus.
Technical Skills:
SAP S/4HANA procurement data objects and master data: vendor, material, info records, source lists, contracts, purchase orders.
SAP Business Data Cloud: data products, spaces, replication, consumption models

Every professional in our company is essential. Thanks to their talent, we continue to expand: today, we are a global team of more than 11,000 people working toward a shared mission.

Ayesa Digital is currently participating in high-impact European Union projects designed to address major European challenges and drive science and innovation. These strategic technological initiatives stand out for their international scope and strong commitment to socially oriented results.
We are looking for a Data Analyst to join our international team and contribute to collect and clean data from various sources.
Key Responsibilities
Analyse datasets to identify trends and patterns.
Create interactive dashboards and reports that utilize data storytelling to effectively present findings, with defined refresh cadences and Service Level Agreements (SLAs) for key deliverables.
Collaborate with stakeholders to understand data needs.
Develop and maintain data dashboards and reporting tools that provide intuitive access to key metrics and insights, supported by clear documentation and update schedules.
Perform statistical analysis to support decision-making.
Ensure data accuracy and consistency through the implementation of data quality checks, validation rules, and regular reconciliation processes with source systems.
Conduct exploratory data analysis to uncover insights.
Document methodologies and analysis processes.
Recommend improvements based on data insights.
Partner with Data Engineers on data modelling (e.g., star/snowflake schemas) and contribute to a centralized definitions and metrics catalogue.
Present data-driven insights and create actionable, decision-oriented recommendations tailored for non-technical audiences and stakeholders.
Write complex Structured Query Language (SQL) queries for data extraction and transformation, and optimize them for performance and efficiency.
What We Are Looking For (Requirements):
Knowledge of data analysis and manipulation using SQL, Python, or R to extract, transform, and analyse structured and unstructured datasets.
Experience with data visualization and reporting tools (e.g., Power BI, Qlik, Microsoft Fabric) to design interactive dashboards and reports.
Knowledge of statistical analysis methods and tools (e.g., SPSS, R, Python libraries) to support evidence-based insights.
Familiarity with spreadsheet tools, especially Microsoft Excel.
Knowledge of data warehousing concepts and platforms (e.g., star/snowflake schemas, Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, BigQuery) to support scalable reporting
Knowledge of data preparation and transformation tools (e.g., Alteryx, Power Query, dbt) to ensure clean and reliable dataset

Je bent analytisch en oplossingsgericht.

Je neemt initiatief en blijft kritisch voor datakwaliteit.

Wij zijn denkers, doeners, voelers, aanpakkers, zinhebbers en collega’s. Mensgericht, met een hart voor de klant en voor elkaar.
