As Lansweeper scales its SaaS business across new products and markets, revenue analytics has become a critical function for steering executive and board-level decisions. This role exists to bring structure, trust, and clarity to how Lansweeper measures and understands its revenue.

You will be the dedicated Revenue Analytics Engineer within a 10-person Data & Analytics team — the first hire focused entirely on revenue — reporting directly to the Data Platform Manager. Your work will directly shape how C-level leaders and the board understand growth, and how sales and finance teams plan and act.
In the near term, your goals are to establish a single source of truth for revenue KPIs, build board-ready reporting, and deliver forecasting models that drive go-to-market decisions.
Challenge
The Main Challenges You'll Face Are

Speed vs. complexity: The sales organization moves fast and needs reliable revenue facts quickly — but revenue data is sourced from multiple systems (CRM, billing, ERP) with historic complexity from acquisitions and system migrations, and data quality that varies over time.

Keeping up with a changing business:** As Lansweeper's product and market evolve, sales and marketing allocation must follow. You'll need to continuously adapt revenue models to reflect new business processes and priorities.

Being the first and only:** You are the sole analytics engineer focused on revenue. You'll need to build foundations from scratch, establish trust in the numbers, and earn your seat at the table with finance and executive stakeholders — all at the same time.
Key Responsibilities
Build, maintain, and improve revenue data models** that power executive-level reporting and board-ready metrics across ARR, MRR, churn, expansion, contraction, and renewal cycles
Reconcile revenue data across systems of record** — CRM, billing, and ERP — and establish a single, trusted source of truth for financial KPIs
Design and deliver dashboards and reports** that translate complex revenue data into clear, actionable insights for sales, finance, and leadership
Partner with sales operations and finance** to understand evolving business processes and reflect them accurately in revenue analytics models
Develop and maintain forecasting models** for key revenue metrics to support go-to-market planning and strategic decision-making
Investigate and explain trends, anomalies, and shifts** in revenue data, linking them back to underlying sales and finance drivers
Proactively improve data quality and integrity** across revenue-related data pipelines to ensure consistent, reliable reporting
Key Requirements
Hard Skills
Financial metrics reporting — solid understanding of how revenue, bookings, churn, ARR, MRR, expansion, contraction, and renewal KPIs are defined and measured in a SaaS context
Strong SQL skills — ability to write, optimize, and debug complex queries against large datasets
Systems reconciliation — hands-on experience resolving data mismatches between CRM, billing, and finance systems to produce a reliable single source of truth
Data modelling — familiarity with best practices such as dimensional modelling and slowly changing dimensions

AI-Specific Skills
Lansweeper is an AI-native company. In this role, AI fluency is a hard requirement — not a nice-to-have.

You are expected to use AI tooling as a standard part of your day-to-day workflow: this includes AI-assisted SQL generation and debugging, using AI to accelerate data modelling and anomaly investigation, and leveraging AI features within your analytics stack (such as Snowflake Cortex or dbt-integrated tooling). You should be comfortable prompting AI tools effectively, evaluating their outputs critically, and integrating AI into repeatable workflows — from data pipeline development to generating draft narrative summaries for executive reporting. General AI fluency across platforms such as ChatGPT or Copilot is expected.

You'll join the Insights & Intelligence team, part of the broader Data & Analytics function at Lansweeper. The team has 10 people and is led by the **Data Platform Manager**, who you will report to directly. You will work closely with sales operations, finance, and data engineers across the organization.
As the **only analytics engineer focused on revenue**, you will own this domain end-to-end — a rare opportunity to define how a growing SaaS company understands and steers its revenue.
The team is based across Ghent, Belgium and Alicante, Spain, with a hybrid working model at both locations.

Benefits — Spain

The opportunity to **build the revenue analytics function from the ground up** in a scaling SaaS company
A front-row seat to C-level and board decision-making, with your work directly influencing strategic direction

Lansweeper is the AI Cyber Asset Intelligence platform helping IT and Security teams gain full visibility, reduce cyber risk, and scale automation with confidence.

See – Truly complete visibility across hybrid environments

Act – Automate workflows, coordinate remediation, and enforce policy at scale

One Team – United across boundaries

Each level maps to a salary band based on salary benchmarks from the Software/SaaS industry of your country, so your pay reflects what the market pays for comparable roles.

He wants to know how his warehouse is doing. How much do his pickers get done per hour? What does he pay for transport? What’s the fill rate of the shipping boxes and pallets? And what can he improve?
Your job is to answer that with numbers he can act on.
After that, you onboard the customer and advice them to get the most out of our software.
About Optioryx
We build software that makes warehouse work faster and more efficient.

Our product is called Pulse. It tells you where in the warehouse to position your SKUs, how optimal picking plans look like and what the right box sizes are for your order/item profile. It connects to your WMS and increases picking productivity by 20-30%. It also builds a digital twin of the warehouse, so you can test changes before anyone moves a pallet.
Our software runs in warehouses in 28 countries, from Mexico to Australia. Big 3PLs, e-commerce fulfilment sites and medtech industry. We are an enthusiastic team in Ghent.
What you will do
Profile the warehouse and build the business case. This is the main part of the job:
1. Load the customer's order data, SKU master and warehouse layout into Pulse Studio, our digital twin.
2. Work out how the warehouse runs today. Picker productivity, lines per hour, transport cost per order, fill rate.
3. Find where the productivity improvements are. Run what-if scenarios for slotting, picking and transport.
4. Explain what you found and present it to the customer yourself.
Get customers live. Set up Pulse so it matches how their warehouse operations. Map their data, train the team on the floor, and be the person they call when something goes wrong.
Who we are looking for
You like data. A WMS export with 200,000 rows does not scare you. You know your way around Excel: pivot tables, lookups, cleaning up data. SQL or Python is a bonus, not a must.

You know how a warehouse works. You know what a wave is, why replenishment matters, and what happens on the floor when SKUs are positioned badly. Maybe you worked in a warehouse, maybe you were a consultant, maybe you studied it and spent a lot of time on site. Either way, you can walk the aisles with an ops manager and understand his operations.
You can explain things. You can tell a Logistics director what the numbers mean and tell a team leader what changes on Monday. In Dutch and English. French helps.
You have a continuous improvement mindset. You find this stuff interesting. Warehouses, throughput, spotting the thing nobody else saw.
You take responsibility. Small team, real deadlines. You pick things up yourself.
Nice to have
Worked at a logistics consultancy, a 3PL, or in warehouse operations
Know your way around WMS systems and how they export data
Studied business engineering, industrial engineering or supply chain. Or learned it on the job.
Done slotting, ABC analysis or picking optimization before
What is in it for you
Direct contact with customers. You are in front of logistics directors and operations managers. You have ownership of your analysis work.
Impact you can see on the floor. Your suggestions change operational processes at our clients.
A young team that moves fast. We are a small, enthusiastic crew in Ghent. Short lines and fast decisions. You will learn from colleagues directly.
A market conform salary. A salary and perks in line with the market for your experience.
Room to grow. We are scaling in 28 countries, and your role grows with you. Depending on what you are good at, this can go towards customer success, solution consulting or helping the product team.
We are going hard (doubling customer base every year), and we expect the same from you.
Interested?
Send your CV and a short note to wewantyou@optioryx.com

De Data Analyst is de schakel tussen operations, business en IT. Door data, automatisering en AI te verbinden met de operationele realiteit, zorgt deze rol voor meer transparantie, betere besluitvorming en efficiëntere processen. Zo versnelt de Data Analyst de transformatie van Antwerp Gateway naar een slimmere, productievere en toekomstgerichte terminal.
Wat ga je doen?

Als Data Analyst voer je diepgaande analyses uit op operationele data en vertaalt deze naar bruikbare inzichten en opportuniteiten om de productiviteit en capaciteit van de terminal verder te verhogen.
Hiervoor zet je datamodellen, KPI-kaders en monitoringprocessen op die een betrouwbare prestatieopvolging mogelijk maken

Verder neem je een cruciale rol op binnen data-heavy projecten (Process automation, Machine Learning toepassingen) en werkt hiervoor nauw samen met de operationele teams, data engineers en BI-experts om bij te dragen aan use case-identificatie, datavoorbereiding, modelevaluatie en implementatie binnen een multidisciplinaire omgeving
Verder ondersteun je ons traject van continue verbetering met een data-gedreven (Six Sigma) aanpak
Je bent onze expert in data-analyse en data-visualisatie, en ondersteunt andere departementen en cross-functionele project teams met analyse tools en methodieken.
Je rapporteert aan de Director Business Optimization
Wat breng jij mee?

Een bachelor – of masterdiploma in een bedrijfseconomische richting met 5 à 8 jaar relevante ervaring in een vergelijkbare analytische of data-gedreven rol. Ervaring in logistiek, supply chain of containeroperaties is een voordeel
Sterke analytische vaardigheden met ervaring in complexe data-analyse, datamodellering en visualisatie, en het vermogen om operationele inzichten uit data te halen
Kennis van statistische analysetechnieken en gevorderde vaardigheden in Excel, Power BI, Python of vergelijkbare analysetools - Six Sigma is een plus
Proactieve en leergierige mindset, met een continue focus op procesverbetering en het bijblijven met nieuwe tools en technologieën
Sterke samenwerkings- en communicatieve vaardigheden om effectief te werken in een cross-functionele omgeving met operations, business en IT

Hybrid (2 days on-site per week, at client premises or company office
column2: 3 days from home)

column1: Permanent, full-time

The systems that track assets, flag maintenance needs and inform mission readiness do not run on gut feeling, they run on clean data and sharp analysis. As Analytics Engineer you will split your time between being embedded at a defence customer site as part of a structured Forward Deployed Engineer team and contributing to the Product Engineering Team, turning raw operational data into the dashboards and insights that operational teams actually rely on. The rotation structure means you carry real on-site ownership while a full team provides backup and coverage
column2: you are not alone.

column1: Your Mission
Own the SQL layer end-to-end, from raw source data through to production-ready models, with performance and maintainability as the standard.

Build and maintain analytical and dimensional models that underpin asset tracking, maintenance workflows, readiness reporting and mission planning, datasets that operational teams act on, not prototypes.

Author and publish dashboards and views in close cooperation with client stakeholders, translating operational requirements into analytical deliverables that are clear, accurate and fit for a defence environment.
Apply Python for data transformation, lightweight analysis and integration glue work, keeping pipelines reliable and documented.
Elicit and interpret requirements directly from French- and Dutch-speaking client teams when forward deployed, then translate those needs into concrete analytical outputs.
Own testing and technical documentation during on-site rotations, with clean handover to the wider engineering, testing and documentation teams between deployments.
What success looks like

Over time, the client teams you support will reach for your dashboards first because the data behind them is trustworthy and the models are built to last. Requirements you gather on-site translate cleanly into working deliverables. Domain experts recognise that you understood what they needed — not just what they said. The components you build are documented well enough that the wider team can maintain, extend and take them into operational use without relying on your recall.
What you bring
Production-grade SQL, complex transformations, modelling and query optimisation, not basic retrieval.
Practical Python scripting for ETL, data transformation, analysis and automation
column2: this is not a software engineering role, but the code you write must be clean and maintainable.

column1: Analytical and dimensional modelling at mid-to-senior level — this is the core technical differentiator for the role.
Dashboard authoring experience in at least one BI or analytical tool
column2: you will work with proprietary tooling here and ramp up on it after joining, so transferable experience is what counts.

column1: Consulting and requirements-gathering skills, when forward deployed you are the primary client interface, and the ability to elicit, interpret and translate operational requirements is essential.
Professional working proficiency in French, Dutch and English — you will conduct requirements discussions in both French and Dutch and coordinate in English
column2: all three are required for delivery and this is not flexible.

column1: Git discipline and comfort working in structured, security-conscious environments with the composure that client-facing work in defence demands.
Eligibility to obtain and maintain the required national or NATO security clearance for this role (we support candidates through the clearance process).
The language requirement and clearance eligibility are firm
column2: for everything else, we consider the overall strength of your experience.

column1: Nice to have
Experience working with logistics, maintenance, asset-management or defence-operations data.
Prior experience with Oracle or PostgreSQL in a data modelling or transformation context
Build Your Future with ILIAS

ILIAS Solutions, part of the Patria Group, builds software that defence organisations use to manage operational readiness, asset tracking, maintenance, mission planning and the data layers beneath them. The work has real consequences, and the people who do it know it.

As Analytics Engineer you will have direct contact with operational outcomes: the dashboards you build are not internal reporting tools — they are the view a team uses to make decisions about equipment and readiness. At the same time, the rotation structure means you are backed by colleagues, technical depth in the wider team, dedicated testing and documentation support outside your on-site periods, and the kind of stability that comes with a permanent role inside an established defence-software group.
If you want data work that is consequential, a client environment that takes precision seriously, and a team structure that supports without micromanaging, this is that role.

Annual bonus scheme
Company car
Group and health insurance

Meal and eco vouchers

Eligibility

Because of the nature of our work, this role may require eligibility under applicable export-control regulations and the ability to obtain national or NATO security clearance. We assess eligibility lawfully and on a role-by-role basis
column2: specific requirements are discussed during the selection process. We do not exclude candidates on the basis of nationality except where mandated by applicable export-control or security-clearance law.

About Us

In defence operations, timing and reliable information shape every decision. Many organizations still rely on fragmented systems, limiting visibility and slowing execution. ILIAS Solutions connects logistics, maintenance, and operations into one integrated platform. This creates a single source of truth and enables teams to act on real time data across strategic, operational, and tactical levels. Large volumes of operational data move continuously between systems. This data reflects maintenance cycles, logistics flows, and asset readiness. Accuracy and consistency directly impact operational outcomes.

As Analytics Engineer you will split your time between being embedded at a defence customer site as part of a structured Forward Deployed Engineer team and contributing to the Product Engineering Team, turning raw operational data into the dashboards and insights that operational teams actually rely on. Your Mission

  • Own the SQL layer end-to-end, from raw source data through to production-ready models, with performance and maintainability as the standard.
  • Build and maintain analytical and dimensional models that underpin asset tracking, maintenance workflows, readiness reporting and mission planning, datasets that operational teams act on, not prototypes.
  • Author and publish dashboards and views in close cooperation with client stakeholders, translating operational requirements into analytical deliverables that are clear, accurate and fit for a defence environment.
  • Apply Python for data transformation, lightweight analysis and integration glue work, keeping pipelines reliable and documented.

What success looks like

Over time, the client teams you support will reach for your dashboards first because the data behind them is trustworthy and the models are built to last. Requirements you gather on-site translate cleanly into working deliverables. Domain experts recognise that you understood what they needed — not just what they said. The components you build are documented well enough that the wider team can maintain, extend and take them into operational use without relying on your recall.

What you bring

  • Practical Python scripting for ETL, data transformation, analysis and automation

Build Your Future with ILIAS

ILIAS Solutions, part of the Patria Group, builds software that defence organisations use to manage operational readiness, asset tracking, maintenance, mission planning and the data layers beneath them. The work has real consequences, and the people who do it know it.

As Analytics Engineer you will have direct contact with operational outcomes: the dashboards you build are not internal reporting tools — they are the view a team uses to make decisions about equipment and readiness. At the same time, the rotation structure means you are backed by colleagues, technical depth in the wider team, dedicated testing and documentation support outside your on-site periods, and the kind of stability that comes with a permanent role inside an established defence-software group.

If you want data work that is consequential, a client environment that takes precision seriously, and a team structure that supports without micromanaging, this is that role.

  • Group and health insurance
  • Ambulatory care coverage
  • Meal and eco vouchers
  • Phone, internet, and home office allowances

column8:

About Us

In defence operations, timing and reliable information shape every decision. Many organizations still rely on fragmented systems, limiting visibility and slowing execution. ILIAS Solutions connects logistics, maintenance, and operations into one integrated platform. This creates a single source of truth and enables teams to act on real time data across strategic, operational, and tactical levels. Large volumes of operational data move continuously between systems. This data reflects maintenance cycles, logistics flows, and asset readiness. Accuracy and consistency directly impact operational outcomes.

    • Responsible for designing and creating conversion and mapping rules so that the data correctly and functionally meets the requirements of the target system. These rules ensure that data is both technically and functionally in line with the specifications of the new system.

  • SQL and database skills:

  • Functional thinking and data architecture:

    • Thanks to a deep understanding of the functional implications of data issues, she/he can identify functional bottlenecks in the data migration and work out appropriate solutions in consultation with the migration engineer and the migration architect.
  • Communication and collaboration:

  • Proven experience with quality control processes, migration approaches and relevant migration solutions.
  • Strong affinity with data, data structures and data mapping.
  • Knowledge of data modeling and relational algebra.
  • Experience with SQL and database management.
  • Precise, analytical thinking skills and a practical attitude.

Additional Information

All our positions are open to both women and men and are, of course, open to people with disabilities.

Ability to translate complex business needs into effective technical solutions.

Hands-on, pragmatic and execution-oriented.

Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly.

Company: Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) Belgium
Employment Type: Full-time
Nature of the tasks
Create and maintain Enterprise Data Warehouses (EDW) and complex Business Intelligence Solutions (Data Lakes / Data Lakehouses).
Design modern Business Intelligence (BI) architectures (e.g., data lakehouse) for cloud, on premises, and hybrid environments, ensuring compliance with security and data residency requirements.
Gather and analyse business requirements specifically for data pipelines, storage, and reporting solutions.
Design and implement modern Extract, Transform, Load / Extract, Load, Transform (ETL/ELT) processes and orchestration workflows, incorporating data contracts and schema evolution management.
Implement and manage data virtualization layers to provide unified access to heterogeneous data sources while optimizing performance and security.
Design and implement data models (e.g., dimensional modeling) to support reporting and analytics, ensuring alignment with business requirements.
Design and build reporting and analytics applications, creating dashboards, KPIs, and self-service BI tools that deliver actionable insights to business stakeholders.
Design and optimize the physical database schema, including indexing, partitioning, and storage strategies, to balance performance, cost, and maintainability.
Conduct ongoing database performance analysis, tuning queries, optimizing resource utilization, and ensuring SLAs for latency and throughput are met.

Design and implement data quality frameworks and health monitoring processes that include data observability (lineage, freshness) and defined Service Level Agreements / Service Level Objectives (SLAs/SLOs).
Define and execute test programs for BI solutions, including data validation, regression tests, contract tests, and automated pipelines integrated into CI/CD.
Produce and maintain technical documentation (data dictionaries, lineage, design specifications, runbooks) to support transparency, governance, and audit readiness.
Perform deployment and configuration of BI systems and platforms, applying infrastructure-as-code, version control, and environment management practices.
Govern the BI semantic layer (KPIs, metrics catalog, naming conventions, row-level security) to ensure consistency and trusted insights.

Sia is a next-generation, global management consulting group. Founded in 1999, we were born digital. Today our strategy and management capabilities are augmented by data science, enhanced by creativity and driven by responsibility. We’re optimists for change and we help clients initiate, navigate and benefit from transformation. We believe optimism is a force multiplier, helping clients to mitigate downside and maximize opportunity. With expertise across a broad range of sectors and services, our 3,000 consultants serve clients worldwide from 48 locations in 19 countries. Our expertise delivers results. Our optimism transforms outcomes.



Job Description

As a Data &
column2:
Process Consultant, you play a key role in achieving our clients' strategic objectives by analyzing, optimizing, and implementing both business processes and data-driven solutions. You lead complex transformation projects from start to finish, bridging the gap between operations, IT, data teams, and business stakeholders.

You understand how processes generate and consume data and how data, in turn, drives smarter processes. You combine business insight, technological expertise, and analytical thinking to design solutions that are practical, scalable, and measurable.

Working closely with clients and internal teams, you guide initiatives from requirements analysis through implementation and performance monitoring, ensuring that process improvements are supported by robust data foundations.

What You Will Do

Process Excellence

  • Apply our methodology to efficiently specify, analyze, design, and implement business processes.

  • Independently lead projects and initiatives, providing substantive guidance to teams of professionals.

  • Translate complex organizational structures into understandable, workable solutions and ensure smooth collaboration within projects.

  • Develop product breakdown structures for large-scale, long-term programs (budgets ranging from €3–50 million).

  • Model business processes using BPM tools and perform simulations and analyses for optimization.

  • Advise clients on best practices in process design, operational excellence, and digital transformation.

  • Provide training and support to ensure effective adoption of newly designed processes.

Data-Driven Transformation

  • Analyze data flows across systems to identify inefficiencies, inconsistencies, and optimization opportunities.

  • Design data models and define data requirements aligned with business process improvements.

  • Translate business needs into data architecture, reporting, and dashboard requirements.

  • Perform data analysis to identify trends, performance gaps, and improvement potential.

  • Support the implementation of data governance frameworks, ensuring data quality, ownership, and compliance.

  • Define KPIs and performance measurement frameworks linked to optimized processes.

  • Work with BI, analytics, and IT teams to ensure seamless integration between process design and data infrastructure.

  • Leverage advanced analytics and automation to enable predictive and prescriptive process improvements.

Personal &
column3:
Professional Growth

  • Actively invest in personal development and deepen expertise in both process management and data analytics.

  • Communicate independently and confidently with clients at different organizational levels.

  • Take ownership of (sub)projects, proactively manage expectations, and escalate when needed.

  • Guide 1–2 analysts and coordinate their contributions within the project.

  • Act as a culture bearer within the organization, promoting collaboration, ownership, and excellence.



Contributing to Sia’s Growth

Commercial

  • Identify commercial opportunities within projects and share them with the responsible project manager.

  • Contribute to proposals and client discussions related to data and process transformation.

Knowledge

  • Share acquired knowledge internally and contribute to thought leadership in process excellence and data-driven transformation.

  • Support internal capability development in analytics, data governance, and digital process innovation.

Portfolio

  • Connect client challenges to Sia’s broader service portfolio, including digital transformation, data &
column4:
AI, operational excellence, and enterprise transformation.



Qualifications

Profile

  • Master’s degree in Business, Engineering, Data Science, Information Management, or related field.

  • 1–3 years of experience in process consulting, data consulting, or digital transformation.

  • Strong analytical mindset with experience in BPM, data modeling, and performance measurement.

  • Proficient with BI tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau), SQL, or data analysis tools is a plus.

  • You have a strong interest in data and AI-related topics, the ability to quickly build expertise in these areas, and you’re excited about helping our clients seize the opportunities they offer.

  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.

  • Fluent in Dutch, French and English (additional languages like German are a plus).

In return, you can expect:

  • An international company that gives importance to diversity, inclusion, employee well-being and corporate social responsibilities actions.
  • A great working atmosphere with friendly and professional colleagues where innovation and entrepreneurship are encouraged
  • A personal development plan with a regular follow-up as well training opportunities to develop yourself
  • A competitive salary with great advantages, like mobility budget/company car, hospital insurance, performance -related bonus,...

Additional Information

We are unable to provide a work permit for this position

Sia is an equal opportunity employer. All aspects of employment, including hiring, promotion, remuneration, or discipline, are based solely on performance, competence, conduct, or business needs.

Structure, govern and support the execution of complex projects, ensuring consistent practices, high-quality deliverables and robust financial data.

Work closely with stakeholders, identifying key actors, defining appropriate communication strategies and creating alignment across diverse teams.
Identify, assess and mitigate risks throughout transformation programmes.
Take ownership of your development and client relationships, progressively expanding your contribution to AION's business and growth within our liberated structure.
Beyond delivering on projects, you will have the opportunity to shape how we work, develop your expertise and take increasing ownership of your career and business contribution.

Equipped with a Master's degree in Business, Finance or a related field.

Able to look beyond individual tasks, understand the broader operational context and turn data into actionable insights.

An attractive gross monthly salary based on experience and impact.
A performance-based bonus linked to business contribution.
Company profit-sharing and a SLIM Budget dedicated to your professional development.

Cadre de la prestation
Dans le cadre du développement d'un compresseur basse pression, des études Matériaux & Procédés sont en cours au sein du département M&P de la Direction Technique.
Les objectifs de la prestation sont :
Supporter les activités Matériaux & Procédés au travers d'outils métiers, en étant force de proposition et de décision technique face aux problématiques rencontrées et aux besoins métiers.
Participer au Knowledge Management et à la capitalisation des connaissances matériaux et procédés au sein de l'équipe.
Administrer et améliorer la base de données métier afin de répondre aux besoins des utilisateurs.
Améliorer les échanges de données entre les différents services, notamment avec le bureau d'études.

Workpackages
Les deux Workpackages sont à traiter simultanément.
WP1 – Simplification et développement de la BDD DOGMA M&P
L'objectif est d'analyser en profondeur la BDD DOGMA M&P, développée sur l'outil Teexma, afin d'en améliorer l'utilisation et l'efficacité.
Principales missions
Comprendre la structure, l'historique et le fonctionnement de la base.
Identifier les choix existants et porter un regard critique sur la structure actuelle.
Simplifier et rendre la base plus facile à utiliser.
Automatiser et faciliter son remplissage.
Faciliter l'encodage par les ingénieurs métiers.
Adapter les fonctionnalités aux besoins des équipes M&P.
Réduire ou simplifier les tâches répétitives.
Comprendre et formaliser les besoins et usages des utilisateurs.
Piloter et suivre les développements réalisés par le fournisseur.
Mettre à jour le cahier des charges.
Challenger les développements du fournisseur afin de simplifier la base, garantir un encodage exhaustif et faciliter sa manipulation.
Identifier et valider de nouvelles implémentations.
Mettre à jour la base avec les solutions validées.
Communiquer les évolutions aux utilisateurs.
Livrables
Notes techniques
Présentations
Indicateurs
Documentation de traçabilité
Supports de Knowledge Management
WP2 – Développement d'outils métier et analyse des données
L'objectif est de mieux exploiter les données M&P et de développer des outils permettant d'améliorer leur analyse et leur utilisation.
Principales missions
Réaliser des analyses inter-données et des études de corrélation.
Proposer des modèles de corrélation.
Simplifier les plans d'expériences à l'aide d'outils tels que Next Step ou d'autres modèles IA.
Créer des outils métiers à partir de fichiers Excel ou de bases existantes.
Automatiser l'encodage et l'analyse des données.
Mettre en place des indicateurs.
Réaliser des PoC sur des périmètres restreints afin de démontrer l'intérêt des outils et méthodes.
Analyser les pratiques actuelles et identifier des pistes d'amélioration dans la gestion des données.
Construire une vision future autour de la thématique des bases de données.
Contribuer aux échanges multi-métiers sur la gestion et l'exploitation des données.
Mettre à jour les supports de Knowledge Management.

État des lieux de la thématique BDD
Documentation de connaissance

S'intégrer aux activités du département M&P et acquérir l'historique des études et travaux réalisés.
Analyser les données et outils existants.
Assurer le support et l'analyse technique en réponse aux demandes des ingénieurs métiers.
Communiquer régulièrement sur l'avancement et les éventuels risques ou délais.
Participer aux réunions techniques.
Assurer le suivi des développements et des fournisseurs.
Maintenir la documentation et la traçabilité des évolutions.
Capitaliser les connaissances produites au sein du département.
Présenter les résultats et les nouveaux outils aux utilisateurs.

Input :
Besoins et demandes des équipes M&P.
État existant de la base et des outils.
Données et documents disponibles.
Historique des travaux réalisés.
Output :
Outils fonctionnels.
Analyses et indicateurs.
Solutions d'amélioration validées.
Documentation technique et de traçabilité.

Suivi et reporting

La maîtrise des risques.
La maîtrise des délais.
Une communication régulière avec les équipes.
Un reporting hebdomadaire.
La mise à jour du tableau de bord.

Le suivi des actions et des développements.
Responsabilités
Aucune responsabilité managériale ni de subordination ne pourra être exercée par le prestataire vis-à-vis des équipes internes.
Réciproquement, aucun membre de l'entreprise ne pourra exercer de responsabilité managériale et/ou de subordination vis-à-vis du prestataire.

Entretiens d'évaluation

Hands-on experience developing dashboards, management reports, and analytical solutions.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a structured approach to investigating complex data and business challenges.
Experience identifying, investigating, and resolving data-quality issues.

Strong stakeholder-management and collaboration skills.
Ability to work independently, take ownership, and manage multiple priorities effectively.
English proficiency at B2–C1 level.

Exposure to an international organisation operating across multiple business functions and markets.
Close collaboration with data engineering, application, and business teams throughout the BI delivery lifecycle.
Opportunity to influence how business stakeholders define and use KPIs, metrics, and data-driven insights.

4464977121,https://ch.linkedin.com/jobs/view/flight-test-data-analyst-at-skysec-defence-4464977121?position=13&pageNum=0&refId=EthMC7og54QIAO96vp91qg%3D%3D&trackingId=%2FVpi3hy8AXAexPHi2BrbYg%3D%3D,Flight Test Data Analyst,Skysec Defence,"Aadorf, Thurgau, Switzerland","Über uns
Skysec Defence ist ein Schweizer Unternehmen, das sich auf die Entwicklung modernster C-UAS (Counter-Unmanned Aircraft Systems) Lösungen spezialisiert hat.

Mit einem interdisziplinären Team aus Software-, Elektronik-, System- und Entwicklungsingenieuren arbeiten wir an der Spitze der Drohnentechnologie und entwickeln Systeme, die neue Massstäbe in der Luftabwehr setzen.
Zur Verstärkung unseres Flight-Testing-Teams suchen wir per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung eine engagierte und verantwortungsbewusste Persönlichkeit als Flight Test Data Analyst.
Deine Rolle
Du arbeitest direkt mit Daten aus realen Flugversuchen und leistest einen wichtigen Beitrag zur Bewertung und Weiterentwicklung unserer Systeme.

Deine Analysen bilden die Grundlage für nachvollziehbare Testberichte, fundierte technische Entscheidungen und die Verbesserung unserer Systemmodelle. Gleichzeitig unterstützt du den Aufbau eines digitalen Zwillings, der zukünftig eine zentrale Rolle in Simulation, Entwicklung und Validierung einnehmen wird.
Wir suchen eine analytisch starke Persönlichkeit, die aus komplexen Messdaten klare Erkenntnisse gewinnt und diese in verlässliche Entscheidungsgrundlagen übersetzt.
Das bewegst du bei uns
Analyse von Flugversuchsdaten: Du analysierst Mess-, Sensor- und Telemetriedaten aus Flugtests und leitest daraus belastbare technische Erkenntnisse ab.

Unterstützung der Testberichterstattung: Du bereitest Daten für Testberichte auf, entwickelst aussagekräftige Auswertungen und stellst Ergebnisse in geeigneten Tabellen, Diagrammen und Kennzahlen dar.
Datenaufbereitung: Du bereinigst, strukturierst und synchronisierst Daten aus unterschiedlichen Quellen und stellst sicher, dass sie für weitere Analysen zuverlässig verwendet werden können.
Plausibilitäts- und Qualitätsprüfung: Du prüfst Datensätze auf Vollständigkeit, Konsistenz und Auffälligkeiten und identifizierst mögliche Messfehler oder Probleme in der Datenerfassung.
Vertiefte technische Auswertung: Du untersuchst Zusammenhänge zwischen Systemzuständen, Testbedingungen und gemessenen Ergebnissen und unterstützt bei der Interpretation komplexer Testverläufe.

Unterstützung der Systemmodellierung: Du arbeitest eng mit dem Flight Test Engineer – Systemmodellierung zusammen und bereitest Daten für Parameteridentifikation, Modellkalibrierung und Modellvalidierung auf.
Digitaler Zwilling: Du unterstützt beim Aufbau und bei der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung eines digitalen Zwillings, indem du reale Flugdaten mit Modell- und Simulationsergebnissen vergleichst.
Automatisierung von Analysen: Du entwickelst wiederverwendbare Analysewerkzeuge und automatisierte Auswertungen, um Testdaten effizient und reproduzierbar verarbeiten zu können.
Visualisierung und Kommunikation: Du stellst komplexe Ergebnisse verständlich dar und unterstützt Flight Testing, Engineering und Projektleitung bei datenbasierten Entscheidungen.
Dokumentation: Du dokumentierst Datenquellen, Analysemethoden, Annahmen und Ergebnisse nachvollziehbar und stellst reproduzierbare Analyseprozesse sicher.
Das bringst du mit

Aus- und Weiterbildung: Du verfügst über einen Masterabschluss in Data Science, Aerospace Engineering, Maschinenbau, Elektrotechnik, Physik, Mathematik, Statistik oder einem vergleichbaren technischen oder naturwissenschaftlichen Fachgebiet.
Berufserfahrung: Du hast in technischen Projekten die Datenanalyse durchgeführt.
Fundierte Datenanalysekenntnisse: Du hast Erfahrung in der strukturierten Aufbereitung, Analyse und Interpretation komplexer technischer Datensätze.
Programmierkenntnisse: Du kannst Datenanalysen mit geeigneten Programmiersprachen und Werkzeugen selbstständig umsetzen und automatisieren.
Weitere Skills: Qualitätsbewusstsein, analytische Arbeitsweise, hohe Eigenverantwortung und technisches Verständnis
Kommunikationsfähigkeit: Du kannst Analyseergebnisse sowohl für technische Fachpersonen als auch für weitere Projektbeteiligte klar und verständlich aufbereiten.
Sprachkenntnisse: Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.

Engagement: Du identifizierst dich mit der Mission und den Zielen von Skysec Defence, übernimmst Ownership und bringst dich mit hohem Einsatz und Verantwortungsbewusstsein in deinen Aufgabenbereich und die Weiterentwicklung unseres Unternehmens ein.

Du hast ein tiefes technisches Verständnis, vor allem von Flugobjekten und Aerodynamik.
Erfahrung mit der Erstellung interaktiver Analysewerkzeuge.

Motivierendes Umfeld – Flache Hierarchien, klare Ziele und moderne Technologie
Flexible Arbeitszeiten – Gleitarbeitszeit für eine gute Work-Life-Balance
Zukunftstechnologie – Arbeite an der Drohnentechnologie von morgen mit
Bezahlte Zertifizierungen – Drohnenprüfungen, Erneuerungen und relevante Weiterbildungen werden unterstützt
Innovation wird gefördert – Deine Ideen sind willkommen und werden aktiv weiterverfolgt
Gratis Kaffee – Bester Kaffee der Kaffeerösterei Küng, kostenlos für alle
Fitness-Abo – Vergünstigtes Fitness-Abo direkt neben dem Büro
Attraktive Konditionen – Attraktive Vergütung und wachsende Sozialleistungen
Team-Events – Regelmässige Teamevents, Apéros und gemeinsame Essen

  • Automatisierung von Analysen: Du entwickelst wiederverwendbare Analysewerkzeuge und automatisierte Auswertungen, um Testdaten effizient und reproduzierbar verarbeiten zu können.
  • Visualisierung und Kommunikation: Du stellst komplexe Ergebnisse verständlich dar und unterstützt Flight Testing, Engineering und Projektleitung bei datenbasierten Entscheidungen.
  • Dokumentation: Du dokumentierst Datenquellen, Analysemethoden, Annahmen und Ergebnisse nachvollziehbar und stellst reproduzierbare Analyseprozesse sicher.

Das bringst du mit

  • Aus- und Weiterbildung: Du verfügst über einen Masterabschluss in Data Science, Aerospace Engineering, Maschinenbau, Elektrotechnik, Physik, Mathematik, Statistik oder einem vergleichbaren technischen oder naturwissenschaftlichen Fachgebiet.
  • Berufserfahrung: Du hast in technischen Projekten die Datenanalyse durchgeführt.
  • Fundierte Datenanalysekenntnisse: Du hast Erfahrung in der strukturierten Aufbereitung, Analyse und Interpretation komplexer technischer Datensätze.
  • Programmierkenntnisse: Du kannst Datenanalysen mit geeigneten Programmiersprachen und Werkzeugen selbstständig umsetzen und automatisieren.
  • Weitere Skills: Qualitätsbewusstsein, analytische Arbeitsweise, hohe Eigenverantwortung und technisches Verständnis
  • Kommunikationsfähigkeit: Du kannst Analyseergebnisse sowohl für technische Fachpersonen als auch für weitere Projektbeteiligte klar und verständlich aufbereiten.
  • Sprachkenntnisse: Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.
  • Engagement: Du identifizierst dich mit der Mission und den Zielen von Skysec Defence, übernimmst Ownership und bringst dich mit hohem Einsatz und Verantwortungsbewusstsein in deinen Aufgabenbereich und die Weiterentwicklung unseres Unternehmens ein.

The RFP Data Analyst is part of LGT Capital Partners’ Product and Client Solutions (PACS) team in Pfäffikon SZ and plays an active role in both the firm's client engagement activities and its data infrastructure. The successful candidate is expected to start as soon as possible.

The role has a strong focus on data analysis within a client servicing and investor relations context. The successful candidate will work with fund, performance, portfolio and firm-level data that supports RFPs, RFIs, DDQs and other investor-facing materials. This is a role for someone who enjoys working analytically with data, understands the importance of accuracy in client-facing communication, and is able to translate quantitative inputs into clear, reliable and well-structured content.

The person will also help improve the team’s workflows by using AI and other tools to maintain the knowledge base and strengthen content and data processes. A key expectation is that the person acts as a bridge between the data and the wider PACS team, ensuring that analytical inputs are accurate, consistent and suitable for use in external client and investor communication.
As part of the PACS team, the successful candidate will contribute to data-driven client servicing across the following areas:

Take ownership of the analytical inputs used in RFPs, RFIs, DDQs and investor materials, including pulling, cross-checking, analyzing and formatting performance, fund, portfolio and firm-level data from multiple sources
Complete RFP, RFI and DDQ processes from prospective and existing clients across private and public markets, working within stated deadlines
Generate high-quality, tailored responses and continuously improve the firm's standard content library
Collaborate directly with business development, investment management and other internal teams to gather inputs and ensure responses reflect LGT CP's current positioning accurately
Act as the link between client-facing teams and the PACS Data team, translating investor relations and client servicing needs into clear data requirements and helping ensure timely, accurate delivery

Operate as a power user of the firm's RFP platform (Responsive), data workflows and AI-assisted tools, contributing to the continuous improvement of data quality, content maintenance, automation and process efficiency.
Requirements
University degree in quantitative finance, finance, business analytics, economics or a related field
column2: CFA, CAIA or an equivalent qualification is a plus

column1: Minimum two years of relevant experience in data analysis, ideally within investor relations, RFP/DDQ, product management, or a related function in asset management
Excellent written English
column2: French, German or other languages an asset

column1: Prior exposure to data workflows or digital tools, with eagerness to develop these skills further
Curiosity and confidence in using AI-assisted tools
Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple concurrent deadlines without losing precision and attention to detail
Clear, proactive communicator with the confidence to flag issues and ask clarifying questions across teams
Team-oriented, with a high sense of ownership and follow-through.
What You Can Expect
We provide modern working conditions, including work-from-home options, flexible hours and a home office allowance to ensure staff members have a work environment equipped with the latest technology
A diverse culture founded on mutual respect, teamwork and appreciation awaits you at LGT Capital Partners. We go the extra mile to generate impact

We empower and invest in you: your professional development and personal growth are our priority. We offer various internal and external training opportunities that are aligned with your ambitions and our business needs. If you are interested, you can also enhance your German or English language skills
We are proud to be owned by the Princely Family of Liechtenstein and our company is inspired by its entrepreneurial spirit
Commitment to ESG: our approach to business is influenced by the Princely Family’s long-term perspective. Sustainability is key for us and has shaped our actions since 2002
You benefit from favorable terms and conditions if you wish to participate in LGT Capital Partners’ investment programs or to use LGT banking products and services.
Contact Information

If you are interested in becoming an integral part of a successful alternative investment management team in an international, multicultural working environment we will be pleased to get to know you soon.
For further information please contact us.
Cassandra Fritschi
Human Resources
LGT Capital Partners AG, Pfaeffikon

EFG is committed to providing an equitable and inclusive working environment that is founded on the principle of mutual respect. Job Description

In his role as EPM OneStream Developer, the resource will oversee running, maintenance and development of our existing OneStream planning platform. In his role as EPM OneStream Developer/Business Data Analyst, the resource will support the performance measurement activities by running granular analysis of financial performance root causes and by providing insights on value creation levers.
The resource will play an active role supporting business development and providing value-added decision support using data modelling and forecasting intelligence.

EPM OneStream Developer
Business analyst and power user of MI data
Design and maintain data models for analysis and forecasting
Establish and compile dashboards and presentations to senior management
Take active role in the business performance dialogues
Active collaboration with Strategy & Corporate Development unit during budgeting and forecasting process
Design and develop MI reports and simulations with data from the various MIS systems of the bank to provide insight on value creation levers to the business
Develop strong relationship with business management and business controllers to support the Planning & Controlling business partnership
Skills And Experience
Professional experience in EPM Business Intelligence in Financial Industry
OneStream software: EPM applications maintenance and developments expert
Ability to understand large datasets and experience of data modelling, providing accurate data analysis
Power user of OneStream, MS-PowerBI, MS-Excel and PowerPoint

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
Join EY and help to build a better working world.

We are looking for a motivated and curious Data & Intelligence Delivery Consultant to join our team. The successful candidate will support large-scale data transformation, analytics, reporting, and automation initiatives across financial services.

This role offers an excellent opportunity to work with modern data technologies, business intelligence platforms, and automation tools while gaining exposure to complex financial, regulatory, and operational datasets.

You will work closely with senior analytics professionals to transform raw data into meaningful insights, support data-driven decision making, and help build scalable reporting and data processing solutions.
Key Responsibilities
Data Preparation & Engineering
Extract, transform and validate data from multiple source systems and file formats.
Support the development and maintenance of ETL processes.
Assist with data quality assessments and reconciliation procedures.
Work with large datasets and perform validation checks to ensure accuracy and completeness.
Support data migration and data transformation activities.
Analytics & Reporting
Develop and maintain Power BI dashboards and reports.
Prepare regular management and operational reporting packs.
Perform trend analysis, benchmarking, KPI monitoring, and variance analysis.
Translate business requirements into analytical solutions.
Assist stakeholders in interpreting analytical findings.
Automation & Process Improvement
Support automation initiatives using scripting and workflow tools.
Help streamline repetitive reporting and data processing activities.
Participate in the design of scalable and repeatable analytics solutions.
Document processes, business rules, and technical specifications.
Data Governance & Controls
Support data quality monitoring initiatives.
Perform reconciliation and validation activities across multiple datasets.
Help maintain documentation of data lineage, transformations, and controls.
Assist with audit and regulatory reporting requirements.
Required Qualifications
Education
Bachelor's or Master's degree in: Data Analytics,Computer Science, Information Systems, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, Finance with strong quantitative focus, Similar analytical discipline
Technical Skills
Experience or knowledge of some of the following:
SQL, Power BI, Alteryx, Excel (advanced level), Power Query, Python, Data modelling concepts, ETL principles, Relational databases, Data quality and validation techniques
Language Skills
Professional proficiency in English is required.
Professional proficiency in French is required for roles based in Geneva, while professional proficiency in German is required for roles based in Zurich.
Knowledge of any of the following would be considered an advantage:
PowerShell, Azure Data Platform, Tableau, Git, Databricks, Financial or insurance data
Desired Attributes
We are looking for someone who:
Has a genuine interest in data and technology.
Enjoys solving complex problems.
Is highly organized and detail-oriented.
Demonstrates strong analytical thinking.
Can communicate technical concepts clearly to non-technical audiences.
Takes ownership and shows initiative.
Is eager to learn and develop new technical skills.
Can work effectively both independently and as part of a team.
Is motivated to do the right thing and demonstrates integrity in their work and decision-making.
Thinks outside the box and develops creative, practical solutions that improve efficiency and productivity.
What You Will Learn
This role provides significant exposure to:
Enterprise-scale data processing
Business intelligence and dashboard development
Large financial and operational datasets
Data engineering and automation techniques
Data quality and governance frameworks
Regulatory and performance reporting
Advanced analytical methodologies
Preferred Experience
Any experience in one or more of the following areas would be beneficial:
Financial services
Banking
Insurance
Consulting
Audit analytics
Regulatory reporting
Data engineering
Business intelligence
Why Join Us?

You will join a team focused on delivering practical, high-impact analytics solutions. You will work on challenging projects, gain exposure to modern data technologies, and receive hands-on experience across the full data lifecycle, from source extraction to executive-level reporting.
EY | Building a better working world
EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

4460631595,https://ch.linkedin.com/jobs/view/data-delivery-consultant-financial-services-geneva-or-zurich-at-ey-4460631595?position=27&pageNum=0&refId=EthMC7og54QIAO96vp91qg%3D%3D&trackingId=l6d9AOTlvERasT3%2FIrMNlg%3D%3D,Data Delivery Consultant - Financial Services (Geneva or Zurich),EY,"Lancy, Geneva, Switzerland","At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
Join EY and help to build a better working world.

We are looking for a motivated and curious Data & Intelligence Delivery Consultant to join our team. The successful candidate will support large-scale data transformation, analytics, reporting, and automation initiatives across financial services.

This role offers an excellent opportunity to work with modern data technologies, business intelligence platforms, and automation tools while gaining exposure to complex financial, regulatory, and operational datasets.

You will work closely with senior analytics professionals to transform raw data into meaningful insights, support data-driven decision making, and help build scalable reporting and data processing solutions.
Key Responsibilities
Data Preparation & Engineering
Extract, transform and validate data from multiple source systems and file formats.
Support the development and maintenance of ETL processes.
Assist with data quality assessments and reconciliation procedures.
Work with large datasets and perform validation checks to ensure accuracy and completeness.
Support data migration and data transformation activities.
Analytics & Reporting
Develop and maintain Power BI dashboards and reports.
Prepare regular management and operational reporting packs.
Perform trend analysis, benchmarking, KPI monitoring, and variance analysis.
Translate business requirements into analytical solutions.
Assist stakeholders in interpreting analytical findings.
Automation & Process Improvement
Support automation initiatives using scripting and workflow tools.
Help streamline repetitive reporting and data processing activities.
Participate in the design of scalable and repeatable analytics solutions.
Document processes, business rules, and technical specifications.
Data Governance & Controls
Support data quality monitoring initiatives.
Perform reconciliation and validation activities across multiple datasets.
Help maintain documentation of data lineage, transformations, and controls.
Assist with audit and regulatory reporting requirements.
Required Qualifications
Education
Bachelor's or Master's degree in: Data Analytics,Computer Science, Information Systems, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, Finance with strong quantitative focus, Similar analytical discipline
Technical Skills
Experience or knowledge of some of the following:
SQL, Power BI, Alteryx, Excel (advanced level), Power Query, Python, Data modelling concepts, ETL principles, Relational databases, Data quality and validation techniques
Language Skills
Professional proficiency in English is required.
Professional proficiency in French is required for roles based in Geneva, while professional proficiency in German is required for roles based in Zurich.
Knowledge of any of the following would be considered an advantage:
PowerShell, Azure Data Platform, Tableau, Git, Databricks, Financial or insurance data
Desired Attributes
We are looking for someone who:
Has a genuine interest in data and technology.
Enjoys solving complex problems.
Is highly organized and detail-oriented.
Demonstrates strong analytical thinking.
Can communicate technical concepts clearly to non-technical audiences.
Takes ownership and shows initiative.
Is eager to learn and develop new technical skills.
Can work effectively both independently and as part of a team.
Is motivated to do the right thing and demonstrates integrity in their work and decision-making.
Thinks outside the box and develops creative, practical solutions that improve efficiency and productivity.
What You Will Learn
This role provides significant exposure to:
Enterprise-scale data processing
Business intelligence and dashboard development
Large financial and operational datasets
Data engineering and automation techniques
Data quality and governance frameworks
Regulatory and performance reporting
Advanced analytical methodologies
Preferred Experience
Any experience in one or more of the following areas would be beneficial:
Financial services
Banking
Insurance
Consulting
Audit analytics
Regulatory reporting
Data engineering
Business intelligence
Why Join Us?

You will join a team focused on delivering practical, high-impact analytics solutions. You will work on challenging projects, gain exposure to modern data technologies, and receive hands-on experience across the full data lifecycle, from source extraction to executive-level reporting.
EY | Building a better working world
EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

Mit erstklassigen Expertinnen und Experten aus Business und Technologie befähigen wir unsere Kunden, neue Massstäbe für nachhaltige Transformationen zu setzen – von der Strategie bis zur Umsetzung. Ob bei der Gestaltung zukunftsfähiger Organisationen, der Erschliessung neuer Potenziale durch Daten und KI oder der Absicherung von Unternehmen durch ganzheitliche Cybersicherheit: Wir liefern Resultate pragmatisch und zielgerichtet. Unser Team von rund 1‘200 engagierten Mitarbeitenden ist in Büros in der Schweiz, Deutschland, den Niederlanden, Spanien, Dänemark, Schweden, Österreich, Grossbritannien, Singapur und den USA vertreten und verbindet globale Perspektiven mit starken lokalen Wurzeln. An den Schweizer Standorten Zürich, Bern und Lausanne arbeiten rund 460 Mitarbeitende.
Das ist der Job

In unserem Team von rund 50 Data & AI-Berater:innen in der Schweiz arbeitest du eng mit unseren Kunden an spannenden Projekten, um mit quantitativen Methoden ihre Herausforderungen zu lösen. Der Wissensaustausch in der Community sowie das aktive Mitgestalten unserer wachsenden Data & AI-Services gehören für dich selbstverständlich dazu. International profitierst du von einem Netzwerk mit über 200 Expert:innen.
Beratung unserer Kunden zu Fragestellungen rund um Data Analytics, Reporting und datengetriebene Entscheidungsunterstützung.
Analyse geschäftlicher Herausforderungen und Entwicklung praxisnaher Analytics- und Reporting-Konzepte.
Konzeption und Umsetzung skalierbarer Reporting- und Analytics-Lösungen entlang moderner Datenarchitekturen.
Mitarbeit in Kundenprojekten in unterschiedlichen Rollen – von der Analyse und Konzeption bis hin zu Engineering-, Implementierungs- oder Projektleitungsaufgaben.
Beitrag zur Weiterentwicklung unseres Data & AI Beratungsportfolios sowie Unterstützung bei der Akquise neuer Projekte.
Dieser Job ist für dich, wenn
du Freude daran hast, komplexe Probleme strukturiert zu analysieren und datenbasierte Lösungen zu entwickeln.
du fundierte Kenntnisse in Data-Analytics-Methoden, Datenarchitekturen und Reporting-Lösungen mitbringst.
Themen wie Datenqualität, Data Governance, saubere ETL/ELT-Prozesse und IBCS-konformes Reporting für dich selbstverständlich sind.
du praktische Erfahrung in Data Engineering, Datenanalyse und Datenvisualisierung gesammelt hast.
du sicher mit gängigen Analytics-Tools arbeitest, z. B. Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Tableau, Qlik Sense oder SAP Analytics Cloud.
du gerne mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern zusammenarbeitest und komplexe Inhalte verständlich vermitteln kannst.
du über Beratungs- oder Projekterfahrung verfügst und eine pragmatische, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise mitbringst.
du einen Masterabschluss in einer quantitativen Disziplin besitzt, z. B. Data Science, Mathematik, Physik, Maschinenbau, Elektrotechnik oder Informatik.
du Deutsch und Englisch jeweils auf mindestens C1-Niveau beherrschst und sicher mit Kunden sowie Projektteams kommunizieren kannst.
Auch wenn du nicht jede einzelne Anforderung erfüllst, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung – entscheidend sind für uns dein Potenzial, deine Haltung und dein Verständnis für datengetriebene Lösungen.
Als i-Tüpfelchen bringst du mit
Zertifizierungen in Analytics- oder Cloud-Technologien (z. B. Microsoft, Tableau, Qlik, AWS oder GCP).
Programmiererfahrung in Python, SQL, M-Code oder vergleichbaren Technologien.
Erfahrung mit modernen Datenplattformen wie Snowflake oder Databricks.
Kenntnisse in Cloud-Architekturen (Azure, AWS oder GCP).
Erfahrung mit agilen Projektmethoden wie Scrum oder SAFe.
Dein nächster Schritt zur erfolgreichen Bewerbung
Hüseyin als deine Ansprechperson freut sich auf deine Direktbewerbung über unsere Webseite (Lebenslauf, Diplome und Arbeitszeugnisse in PDF).
Diversity wird bei uns grossgeschrieben – wir freuen uns über jede Bewerbung!
*Bewerbungen per E-Mail sowie von Personaldienstleistern werden nicht berücksichtigt und direkt gelöscht.

  • du Freude daran hast, komplexe Probleme strukturiert zu analysieren und datenbasierte Lösungen zu entwickeln.
  • du fundierte Kenntnisse in Data-Analytics-Methoden, Datenarchitekturen und Reporting-Lösungen mitbringst.
  • Themen wie Datenqualität, Data Governance, saubere ETL/ELT-Prozesse und IBCS-konformes Reporting für dich selbstverständlich sind.
  • du praktische Erfahrung in Data Engineering, Datenanalyse und Datenvisualisierung gesammelt hast.
  • du sicher mit gängigen Analytics-Tools arbeitest, z. B. Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Tableau, Qlik Sense oder SAP Analytics Cloud.
  • du gerne mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern zusammenarbeitest und komplexe Inhalte verständlich vermitteln kannst.
  • du über Beratungs- oder Projekterfahrung verfügst und eine pragmatische, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise mitbringst.
  • du einen Masterabschluss in einer quantitativen Disziplin besitzt, z. B. Data Science, Mathematik, Physik, Maschinenbau, Elektrotechnik oder Informatik.
  • du Deutsch und Englisch jeweils auf mindestens C1-Niveau beherrschst und sicher mit Kunden sowie Projektteams kommunizieren kannst.


Auch wenn du nicht jede einzelne Anforderung erfüllst, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung – entscheidend sind für uns dein Potenzial, deine Haltung und dein Verständnis für datengetriebene Lösungen.


Als i-Tüpfelchen bringst du mit

  • Zertifizierungen in Analytics- oder Cloud-Technologien (z. B. Microsoft, Tableau, Qlik, AWS oder GCP).
  • Programmiererfahrung in Python, SQL, M-Code oder vergleichbaren Technologien.
  • Erfahrung mit modernen Datenplattformen wie Snowflake oder Databricks.
  • Kenntnisse in Cloud-Architekturen (Azure, AWS oder GCP).
  • Erfahrung mit agilen Projektmethoden wie Scrum oder SAFe.


Dein nächster Schritt zur erfolgreichen Bewerbung

  • Hüseyin als deine Ansprechperson freut sich auf deine Direktbewerbung über unsere Webseite (Lebenslauf, Diplome und Arbeitszeugnisse in PDF).


Diversity wird bei uns grossgeschrieben – wir freuen uns über jede Bewerbung!


*Bewerbungen per E-Mail sowie von Personaldienstleistern werden nicht berücksichtigt und direkt gelöscht.

Diesen Beitrag können Sie leisten
Du analysierst komplexe Datenbestände im GEVER-Umfeld, erkennst Auffälligkeiten und erstellst fundierte technische Entscheidungsgrundlagen.
Die Datenqualität prüfst du systematisch und setzt geeignete Bereinigungs-, Harmonisie­rungs- und Validierungsmassnahmen um.
Du entwickelst, optimierst und dokumentierst SQL-Abfragen, Skripte sowie automati­sierte Analyse- und Prüfroutinen.
Für relationale Datenbanken übernimmst du den Betrieb, die Überwachung und die Weiterentwicklung und stellst Performance, Verfügbarkeit und Stabilität sicher.
Du planst und testest Backup-, Restore-, Recovery- und Wiederanlaufverfahren und setzt diese im Ereignisfall zuverlässig ein.
Bei Datenmigrationen, Störungsanalysen und Weiterentwicklungsvorhaben wirkst du aktiv mit und arbeitest eng mit Fachbereichen, Betrieb, Entwicklung und externen Partnern zusammen.
Das macht Sie einzigartig
Du verfügst über einen Abschluss in Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Data Engineering, Data Science oder über eine vergleichbare Aus- und Weiterbildung.
Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Datenbankumfeld sowie sehr gute Kenntnisse in relationalen Datenbanken, SQL, Datenmodellen und Performanceanalyse bringst du mit.
Du hast Praxiserfahrung in der Analyse komplexer Datenbestände, in Datenqualität, Datenbereinigung, Migrationen sowie ETL- oder ELT-Prozessen.
Mindestens eine Skript- oder Programmiersprache, beispielsweise PowerShell oder Python, beherrschst du sicher.
Du besitzt ein gutes Verständnis für Backup, Restore, Recovery, Monitoring, Betriebs­systeme, Schnittstellen und Applikationsarchitekturen.
Mit analytischem Denkvermögen, hoher Eigenverantwortung und einer sorgfältigen Arbeitsweise überzeugst du ebenso wie mit guten Kenntnissen einer Amtssprache und Englischkenntnissen.
Auf den Punkt gebracht

Du suchst keine klassische Datenbank-Administratorenstelle und auch keine reine Data-Scientist-Funktion. Du möchtest Daten verstehen, technische Ursachen ermitteln und gleich­zeitig Verantwortung für stabile Datenbankplattformen übernehmen. Bei uns arbeitest du an der Schnittstelle von Datenanalyse, Datenbank-Engineering und Be­trieb. Deine Arbeit hat unmittelbare Wirkung: Du unterstützt den zuverlässigen Betrieb der elektronischen Geschäftsverwaltung, verbesserst die Qualität zentraler Geschäftsdaten und schaffst die Grundlage für fundierte technische und fachliche Entscheide auf Basis unserer Kundendaten. Du erhältst Gestaltungsspielraum, übernimmst Verantwortung für anspruchsvolle Themen und arbeitest in einem Umfeld, in dem Datenintegrität, Informationssicherheit und nachhal­tige Lösungen einen hohen Stellenwert haben. Bist Du interessiert? Unser Team freut sich auf Dich!

Gelebte Vielfalt Dank Chancengleichheit entfalten wir unsere Kompetenzen und bringen unterschiedliche Perspektiven ein.

Wir entwickeln, be-treiben und unterstützen moderne E-Government-Anwendungen und leisten einen wichtigen Beitrag zur digitalen Transformation der Bundesverwaltung. Eine unserer zentralen Aufgaben ist der Betrieb und die Weiterentwicklung der bundesweit standardisierten Geschäftsverwaltungslösung GEVER. Diese unterstützt die tägliche Arbeit zahlreicher Verwaltungseinheiten und stellt entsprechend hohe Anforderungen an Verfügbar-keit, Datenqualität, Sicherheit und Performance. Bei uns erwartet dich ein kollegiales und interdisziplinäres Arbeitsumfeld mit anspruchsvollen Aufgaben, modernen Arbeitsformen und der Möglichkeit, einen sichtbaren Beitrag für eine leistungsfähige digitale Bundesverwaltung zu leisten. As the Senior Product Quality Intelligence Specialist, you will be responsible for transforming post-market product data into actionable business intelligence that drives product improvements, reduces quality risks, and protects consumer trust. Working across Warranty, Returns, Consumer Feedback, Reviews, Customer Support, and Product Quality data, you will build a unified view of product performance and convert complex data into clear recommendations for Product Creation, Sourcing, Manufacturing, Customer Experience, and Commercial teams. This role does not own policy or governance. Instead, it enables better business decisions by identifying trends, uncovering root causes, measuring the effectiveness of corrective actions, and providing trusted insights across the product lifecycle. This role will report directly to the Warranty CoE Lead.
Your mission
Develop a unified Product Quality Intelligence model by integrating Warranty, Returns, Consumer Feedback, Product Reviews, Customer Support, and Product Quality data.
Build scalable dashboards and self-service reporting that provide a single view of product performance across markets, products, suppliers, factories, and production batches.
Monitor product health and identify emerging quality trends, recurring defects, and consumer pain points.
Deliver timely insights that enable proactive quality interventions.
Apply advanced analytics, AI, and text mining techniques to analyze structured and unstructured product quality data.
Identify recurring failure modes, fit issues, material defects, and manufacturing deviations.
Measure product performance throughout the product lifecycle and identify opportunities for continuous improvement in collaboration with the key stakeholders
Translate quality data into clear, actionable recommendations for Product Creation, Product Quality, Sourcing, Manufacturing, Customer Experience, and Commercial teams.
Develop early warning dashboards to identify quality risks before they become large-scale customer issues.
Measure the effectiveness of corrective actions and product improvements.
Support supplier performance reviews with fact-based quality intelligence.
Present executive-ready insights that influence product and business decisions.
Your story
4+ years of experience in Business Intelligence, Product Analytics, Product Quality Analytics, Consumer Goods, Sportswear, Footwear, Manufacturing, or E-commerce.
Advanced SQL and strong experience with Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or similar visualization tools.
Experience working with large, complex datasets and developing scalable data models.
Experience applying AI, text analytics, or natural language processing to consumer feedback, product reviews, returns, or warranty data.
Strong analytical thinking with proven experience translating data into business recommendations.
Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders through data-driven insights.
What We Offer

On is a place that is centered around growth and progress. We offer an environment designed to give people the tools to develop holistically – to stay active, to learn, explore and innovate. Our distinctive approach combines a supportive, team-oriented atmosphere, with access to personal self-care for both physical and mental well-being, so each person is led by purpose.

On is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a work environment that is fair and inclusive, where all decisions related to recruitment, advancement, and retention are free of discrimination.

In short

As the Senior Product Quality Intelligence Specialist, you will be responsible for transforming post-market product data into actionable business intelligence that drives product improvements, reduces quality risks, and protects consumer trust. Working across Warranty, Returns, Consumer Feedback, Reviews, Customer Support, and Product Quality data, you will build a unified view of product performance and convert complex data into clear recommendations for Product Creation, Sourcing, Manufacturing, Customer Experience, and Commercial teams. This role does not own policy or governance. Instead, it enables better business decisions by identifying trends, uncovering root causes, measuring the effectiveness of corrective actions, and providing trusted insights across the product lifecycle. This role will report directly to the Warranty CoE Lead.

Your mission

  • Develop a unified Product Quality Intelligence model by integrating Warranty, Returns, Consumer Feedback, Product Reviews, Customer Support, and Product Quality data.
  • Build scalable dashboards and self-service reporting that provide a single view of product performance across markets, products, suppliers, factories, and production batches.
  • Monitor product health and identify emerging quality trends, recurring defects, and consumer pain points.
  • Deliver timely insights that enable proactive quality interventions.
  • Apply advanced analytics, AI, and text mining techniques to analyze structured and unstructured product quality data.
  • Identify recurring failure modes, fit issues, material defects, and manufacturing deviations.
  • Measure product performance throughout the product lifecycle and identify opportunities for continuous improvement in collaboration with the key stakeholders
  • Translate quality data into clear, actionable recommendations for Product Creation, Product Quality, Sourcing, Manufacturing, Customer Experience, and Commercial teams.
  • Develop early warning dashboards to identify quality risks before they become large-scale customer issues.
  • Measure the effectiveness of corrective actions and product improvements.
  • Support supplier performance reviews with fact-based quality intelligence.
  • Present executive-ready insights that influence product and business decisions.

Your story

  • 4+ years of experience in Business Intelligence, Product Analytics, Product Quality Analytics, Consumer Goods, Sportswear, Footwear, Manufacturing, or E-commerce.
  • Advanced SQL and strong experience with Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or similar visualization tools.
  • Experience working with large, complex datasets and developing scalable data models.
  • Experience applying AI, text analytics, or natural language processing to consumer feedback, product reviews, returns, or warranty data.
  • Strong analytical thinking with proven experience translating data into business recommendations.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders through data-driven insights.

Our distinctive approach combines a supportive, team-oriented atmosphere, with access to personal self-care for both physical and mental well-being, so each person is led by purpose.
