4455314173,https://ch.linkedin.com/jobs/view/natural-gas-analyst-at-metlen-4455314173?position=48&pageNum=0&refId=EthMC7og54QIAO96vp91qg%3D%3D&trackingId=rTM8iGpk9SzxuaF1lsD%2B6w%3D%3D,Natural Gas Analyst,Metlen,"Zug, Zug, Switzerland","Job description:

At METLEN Energy & Metals, we are catalysts for a sustainable future, positioned at the forefront of the energy transition while being a reference point for competitive green metallurgy at both the European and global levels.  We are a global industrial and energy company operating across two highly interconnected and complementary sectors: Energy and Metals. With a consolidated turnover of €5,683 million and an EBITDA of €1,080 million, along with a workforce of over 7,627 dedicated individuals, we drive success through cutting-edge technology and diverse talent.

We are committed to embracing new state-of-the-art technologies and advancements, propelling us towards a cleaner, brighter tomorrow. Our positive footprint extends across five continents, creating a lasting impact. At METLEN, we foster a culture of resilience, challenge, respect, excellence, and change, empowering our diverse workforce to achieve remarkable outcomes.
We are currently looking for a Natural Gas Analyst to join our International Energy Trading division in Zug, Switzerland.

In this role, you will be an integral part of the trading desk: building, maintaining, and refining fundamental and quantitative market models to identify commercial opportunities across European gas markets.
Working directly with traders, you will translate complex data into actionable insights that directly form trading strategies and risk management decisions.
Your role will encompass:
Developing, maintaining, and continuously improving short- and long-term supply and demand models, storage forecasts, and regional flow models across key European gas hubs.
Monitoring daily physical gas infrastructure dynamics, including cross-border capacity constraints, pipeline nominations, storage injection/withdrawal rates, and LNG import schedules.
Providing traders with market intelligence, trade ideas, and scenario analyses to support proprietary trading decisions.
Building and automating data pipelines and analytical tools, transforming complex energy data into actionable insights and user-friendly dashboards.
Monitoring macroeconomic, regulatory, and policy developments, including EU ETS and other factors affecting European energy balances.
Working closely with traders, quantitative analysts, and other teams to translate market data and analysis into actionable trading strategies.
Continuously improving analytical models, data quality, and processes to support a fast-paced trading environment.
What you bring to the role:
3+ years of experience as a gas market analyst within an energy trading company, utility, consultancy, or commodity brokerage.
Strong understanding of the fundamental drivers of major European gas hubs, including TTF, THE, PSV, CEGH, and NBP.
In-depth knowledge of European gas infrastructure, including pipeline networks, storage facilities, interconnections, and LNG regasification infrastructure.
Understanding the gas-to-power relationship, renewable intermittency, and the impact of carbon prices on European energy markets.
Advanced proficiency in Python, SQL, and Excel, with hands-on experience in data extraction, statistical modelling, and process automation.
Experience with data visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau and relevant energy market data sources.
Strong analytical and quantitative capabilities, with excellent attention to detail and the ability to interpret complex, fast-moving datasets.
Ability to work independently, communicate insights clearly, and deliver under tight deadlines in a fast-paced trading environment.
Share the same Value Based Behaviors:
People & Personal Growth
Results Orientation & Safety Excellence
Collaboration & Trust
Empathy & Effective Communication
Flexibility & Adaptability
Your Benefits:
Competitive remuneration package including performance-based bonus structure.
Opportunities for responsibility, ownership, and career growth as the business expands
Group Health Insurance Plan
Follow us on LinkedIn and stay updated on our latest news
We respect your personal data. All personal information in your application and CV will remain strictly confidential.

At Metlen Energy & Metals we are proud to have Diversity and Inclusion at the centre of everything we do. We are committed to Equal Employment Opportunity regardless of race, colour, national origin, ethnicity, gender, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or religion.

Collating, analysing and interpreting data to produce commodity market insights

Build and maintaining supply and demand models, and develop detailed market reports, presentations, and trade recommendations to inform trading strategies
Provide trade flow analysis and other ad-hoc analysis to support decision-making by senior traders and management
Collaborate closely with traders, operations teams, and other analysts to identify trading opportunities, monitor positions, and manage risk exposure
Build and maintain proprietary models and tools for market analysis, forecasting, and scenario planning.
Stay up-to-date on industry news, market intelligence, and competitor activities to provide a competitive edge
Establish strong relationships with key market participants, including refiners, suppliers, and customers, to gather market intelligence.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Economics, Finance, Engineering, or a related quantitative field
Minimum of 4 years of experience in commodity analysis or a related analytical role, preferably with exposure to fuel oil/refined products markets
Prior experience in commodity research, specifically in LPG analytics
Strong quantitative and analytical skills with the ability to synthesize complex data sets and extract meaningful insights

Pricing & Profitability Support: Collaborate with pricing teams to analyze rate adequacy, validate assumptions, and recommend underwriting and renewal actions.
Predictive Analytics: Develop predictive models and leverage advanced analytics to support underwriting automation and decision-making tools.

Minimum 5 to 10 years of experience in commercial insurance, with a focus on large corporate industry portfolios.

Proficiency in data analytics tools and predictive modeling (Python or R)

Innovative and investigative mindset with experience in leveraging technology, advanced analytics, and digitization for portfolio optimization
Natural curiosity with a drive to uncover insights and understand underlying patterns

Discover your journey into the extraordinary.
Your Purpose

Explora Journeys is a vibrant, cosmopolitan, European luxury brand, imagined in the heart of Swiss hospitality in Geneva. Leveraging our parent company MSC Group’s hundreds of years of maritime expertise, our fleet of six luxury ships (four currently in the pipeline) are being built and designed in a totally different and unique way that will transform and redefine the cruise experience, creating a category of its own, appealing to the next generation of luxury travellers.

An exciting opportunity exists for a talented, skilled at analysis, strategic and highly organized professional with strong marketing, digital and commercial acumen to join our newly created luxury travel brand Explora Journeys, based in our offices in Geneva, Switzerland.
Your Impact

The objective of the role is to optimize full-funnel marketing investments holistically, maximizing revenue impact and ROI optimization across markets. This role is responsible for analysing performance across the customer journey — from awareness through loyalty — to identify growth opportunities, improve marketing efficiency, and drive commercial outcomes through data-driven decision-making.

Performance analysis: monitor and analyse marketing performance against brand and commercial KPIs, providing insights and recommendations for continuous improvement. Own the development, tracking and actioning of key marketing KPIs across touchpoint (all paid, owned and earned channels), campaigns and audience performance.

Drive efficiency, quantifying ROI/ROAS/CPA/CPLA by campaign, touchpoint and audience for each market to continuously optimize investments. Recommend reinvestments toward highest-impact activities, to hit awareness and revenue targets.

Build and maintain full-funnel performance scorecards by market (awareness → consideration → conversion → loyalty) to identify revenue bottlenecks and optimize budget allocation between markets. Both on Excel and partnering with corporate team to make it available in self-serve tools (Power BI).
Develop attribution models (e.g.  media mix, multi-touch attribution) to clarify revenue contribution across platforms and improve investment efficiency.
Partner with Marketing & Digital heads, Finance, Commercial and Revenue teams to forecast investment impacts and align marketing activities with commercial outcomes.
Competitive analysis: monitor market conditions, competitive activity, and industry trends to support strategic planning and identify opportunities for differentiation and growth.

Prepare executive-ready presentations, with clear data-based recommendations to support senior leadership strategic decision-making, leveraging stellar data visualization combined with depth of insights.
Your Journey so far
5+ years of prior experience in marketing analytics, commercial analytics, business intelligence, or performance marketing analysis.
Preference for prior experience in the luxury hospitality/travel industry or consulting agencies.
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Finance, Marketing, Commercial, or related field (Masters, MBA or equivalent experience preferred).
Your Essentials
Proven experience supporting senior executives and thriving in a fast-paced, start-up environment, managing multiple priorities simultaneously.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex data into actionable business insights.
Highly Proficient in Excel and comfortable manipulating large datasets data and maintaining large spreadsheets with high level of accuracy
Outstanding PowerPoint and storytelling skills — able to craft clean, crisp, high-impact presentations for C-suite audiences.
Experience working with Salesforce, Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics or similar platforms, as well as BI and visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar platforms.
Knowledge of marketing measurement methodologies including attribution modelling, media mix modelling, customer segmentation, and ROI analysis.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Fluent in English.
Passion and curiosity to continuously learn about the ever-evolving travel industry.
At Explora Journeys, we are redefining luxury ocean travel — where discovery, well-being, and a deep respect for the seas come together in harmony.
We seek passionate professionals who share our vision of a more immersive, transformative way to discover the world’s most inspiring destinations by sea.
Are you ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at Explora Journeys, where an ocean of opportunities awaits. Your journey to the Ocean State of Mind starts here.

Diesen Beitrag können Sie leisten
Du analysierst komplexe Datenbestände im GEVER-Umfeld, erkennst Auffälligkeiten und erstellst fundierte technische Entscheidungsgrundlagen.
Die Datenqualität prüfst du systematisch und setzt geeignete Bereinigungs-, Harmonisie­rungs- und Validierungsmassnahmen um.
Du entwickelst, optimierst und dokumentierst SQL-Abfragen, Skripte sowie automati­sierte Analyse- und Prüfroutinen.
Für relationale Datenbanken übernimmst du den Betrieb, die Überwachung und die Weiterentwicklung und stellst Performance, Verfügbarkeit und Stabilität sicher.
Du planst und testest Backup-, Restore-, Recovery- und Wiederanlaufverfahren und setzt diese im Ereignisfall zuverlässig ein.
Bei Datenmigrationen, Störungsanalysen und Weiterentwicklungsvorhaben wirkst du aktiv mit und arbeitest eng mit Fachbereichen, Betrieb, Entwicklung und externen Partnern zusammen.
Das macht Sie einzigartig
Du verfügst über einen Abschluss in Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Data Engineering, Data Science oder über eine vergleichbare Aus- und Weiterbildung.
Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Datenbankumfeld sowie sehr gute Kenntnisse in relationalen Datenbanken, SQL, Datenmodellen und Performanceanalyse bringst du mit.
Du hast Praxiserfahrung in der Analyse komplexer Datenbestände, in Datenqualität, Datenbereinigung, Migrationen sowie ETL- oder ELT-Prozessen.
Mindestens eine Skript- oder Programmiersprache, beispielsweise PowerShell oder Python, beherrschst du sicher.
Du besitzt ein gutes Verständnis für Backup, Restore, Recovery, Monitoring, Betriebs­systeme, Schnittstellen und Applikationsarchitekturen.
Mit analytischem Denkvermögen, hoher Eigenverantwortung und einer sorgfältigen Arbeitsweise überzeugst du ebenso wie mit guten Kenntnissen einer Amtssprache und Englischkenntnissen.
Auf den Punkt gebracht

Du suchst keine klassische Datenbank-Administratorenstelle und auch keine reine Data-Scientist-Funktion. Du möchtest Daten verstehen, technische Ursachen ermitteln und gleich­zeitig Verantwortung für stabile Datenbankplattformen übernehmen. Bei uns arbeitest du an der Schnittstelle von Datenanalyse, Datenbank-Engineering und Be­trieb. Deine Arbeit hat unmittelbare Wirkung: Du unterstützt den zuverlässigen Betrieb der elektronischen Geschäftsverwaltung, verbesserst die Qualität zentraler Geschäftsdaten und schaffst die Grundlage für fundierte technische und fachliche Entscheide auf Basis unserer Kundendaten. Du erhältst Gestaltungsspielraum, übernimmst Verantwortung für anspruchsvolle Themen und arbeitest in einem Umfeld, in dem Datenintegrität, Informationssicherheit und nachhal­tige Lösungen einen hohen Stellenwert haben. Bist Du interessiert? Unser Team freut sich auf Dich!
Das bieten wir
Arbeiten für die Schweiz Wir setzen uns für das Erfolgsmodell Schweiz ein und arbeiten zum Wohl der Bevölkerung.
Gelebte Vielfalt Dank Chancengleichheit entfalten wir unsere Kompetenzen und bringen unterschiedliche Perspektiven ein.
Gesund am Arbeitsplatz Wir unterstützen und beraten unsere Mitarbeitenden im Bereich der physischen und psychischen Gesundheit.
Alle Benefits

Das Information Service Center WBF ISCeco ist der Informatik-Leistungserbringer des Eid-genössischen Departements für Wirtschaft, Bildung und Forschung WBF. Wir entwickeln, be-treiben und unterstützen moderne E-Government-Anwendungen und leisten einen wichtigen Beitrag zur digitalen Transformation der Bundesverwaltung. Eine unserer zentralen Aufgaben ist der Betrieb und die Weiterentwicklung der bundesweit standardisierten Geschäftsverwaltungslösung GEVER. Diese unterstützt die tägliche Arbeit zahlreicher Verwaltungseinheiten und stellt entsprechend hohe Anforderungen an Verfügbar-keit, Datenqualität, Sicherheit und Performance. Bei uns erwartet dich ein kollegiales und interdisziplinäres Arbeitsumfeld mit anspruchsvollen Aufgaben, modernen Arbeitsformen und der Möglichkeit, einen sichtbaren Beitrag für eine leistungsfähige digitale Bundesverwaltung zu leisten. As a foundational member of the CUO Office, you will play a pivotal role in shaping its capabilities, focusing on building robust analytical frameworks and performance monitoring tools from the ground up.

This hands-on position requires a proactive and detail-oriented individual who thrives on creating structure and driving meaningful change. While business decisions will remain the responsibility of underwriters, you will serve as a critical voice in influencing underwriting strategies and supporting data-driven decision-making processes. Your contributions will be instrumental in optimizing portfolio performance, enhancing risk management practices, and aligning operations with strategic objectives.

As the CUO Office evolves, this role offers the potential to expand its scope and contributes to the development of a team that will further enhance the organization’s portfolio analytics capabilities. This is an exciting chance to make a lasting impact on the organization’s success and shape the future of portfolio analytics within a dynamic and globally connected environment.

Location: This position will be based preferably out of our Zurich office, but potential candidates might also sit in our other European office locations in Paris, Milan, Cologne or Munich. Our business, your impact, our opportunity
What You’ll Be Doing

Portfolio Performance Analysis: Regularly evaluate underwriting performance, identify trends, and analyze profitability, risk quality, and portfolio composition to drive growth and improvement. Prepare quarterly and ad-hoc performance reviews for leadership.
Underwriting Portfolio Steering: Refine risk appetite, recommend strategies for growth or remediation, support underwriting plans, and monitor execution against targets.
Risk Aggregation & Management: Analyze risk accumulation across perils and geographies, monitor exposure limits, and integrate data into reinsurance and capital modeling.
Catastrophe & Scenario Analysis: Conduct catastrophe loss scenarios, assess tail risks, and support stress testing, capital planning, and reinsurance structuring.
Pricing & Profitability Support: Collaborate with pricing teams to analyze rate adequacy, validate assumptions, and recommend underwriting and renewal actions.
Predictive Analytics: Develop predictive models and leverage advanced analytics to support underwriting automation and decision-making tools.
Reporting & Dashboards: Create executive dashboards, automate underwriting metric reporting, and provide data-driven insights for decision-makers.
Reinsurance Strategy Support: Provide exposure and performance data to inform treaty and facultative decisions and improve retention strategies.
Regulatory & Capital Requirements: Support regulatory filings, collaborate on risk assessments, and align portfolio decisions with capital efficiency.
Innovation & Technology: Pilot AI models, integrate new data sources, and drive digitization of portfolio management processes.
What You’ll Bring

This role requires a strategic thinker with a deep understanding of commercial insurance, strong analytical capabilities, industry expertise, and a passion for driving innovation to optimize portfolio performance and deliver value to internal and external stakeholders.
Advanced degree in Finance, Actuarial Science, Data Analytics, Risk Management, Business Administration, or a related field
Minimum 5 to 10 years of experience in commercial insurance, with a focus on large corporate industry portfolios.
Strong knowledge of underwriting principles, risk aggregation, catastrophe modeling, and reinsurance structures.
General understanding of insurance product coverages, resulting exposures and their triggering portfolio impacts.
Proficiency in data analytics tools and predictive modeling (Python or R)
Expertise in regulatory compliance (e.g., Solvency II, NAIC), capital modeling, and risk management.
Proven leadership and collaboration skills with cross-functional teams and executive management.
Innovative and investigative mindset with experience in leveraging technology, advanced analytics, and digitization for portfolio optimization
Natural curiosity with a drive to uncover insights and understand underlying patterns

Expansive Health & Wellness Benefits

Com a oportunidade de Analista de BI Sênior vamos proporcionar cada vez mais saúde e bem-estar para todo o Brasil! Vem ser Cimed!
Responsabilidades e atribuições
Descrição geral do cargo

O(a) Analista de BI é responsável por extrair, organizar, analisar e interpretar dados para gerar insights e suportar tomadas de decisão. Trabalha em conjunto com diversas áreas (Marketing, Vendas, Inteligência de Mercado, Pesquisa & Desenvolvimento, TI, Finanças) para mapear e compreender tendências, avaliar a eficácia de estratégias comerciais e propor melhorias baseadas em dados.
Principais responsabilidades:
Coleta e Organização de Dados
Realizar a extração de dados a partir de múltiplas fontes (sistemas internos, bancos de dados, plataformas de mercado, relatórios de auditoria etc.).
Garantir a integridade, qualidade e consistência dos dados, utilizando técnicas de limpeza e padronização.
Desenvolvimento de Relatórios e Dashboards
Criar e manter relatórios e dashboards interativos em ferramentas de BI ( Power BI), facilitando a visualização de indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) para diferentes áreas da empresa.
Personalizar e automatizar atualizações de relatórios, gerando análises em tempo hábil para a tomada de decisão.
Análise e Interpretação de Dados
Aplicar técnicas de análise estatística e modelagem preditiva para identificar tendências de mercado, comportamentos de clientes, oportunidades de negócio e riscos.
Gerar insights e recomendações claras e objetivas, embasadas em dados, para suportar estratégias de marketing, vendas, pesquisa clínica e desenvolvimento de novos produtos.
Suporte à Inteligência de Mercado
Colaborar com a equipe de Inteligência de Mercado para monitorar concorrência, tendências regulatórias (ANVISA), inovações tecnológicas e variações de demanda.
Participar na construção de análises sobre pipeline de produtos, performance de mercado e estimativas de vendas.
Aprimoramento Contínuo e Governança de Dados
Contribuir para a melhoria dos processos de coleta e análise de dados, sugerindo novas ferramentas ou metodologias.
Adotar e promover práticas de governança de dados, garantindo segurança, acessibilidade e conformidade com políticas internas e normas regulatórias.
Colaboração com Equipes Multidisciplinares
Atuar como facilitador no uso de soluções de BI por áreas parceiras, oferecendo treinamentos e suporte técnico.
Alinhar-se com equipes de TI e Infraestrutura para garantir a melhor performance dos sistemas de BI e a integração dos dados.
Principais desafios do cargo:
Garantir a confiabilidade e agilidade na geração de relatórios e análises em um ambiente competitivo e regulado.
Manter-se atualizado(a) sobre novas ferramentas e técnicas de análise de dados, visando aprimorar processos e sistemas internos.
Equilibrar demandas de diferentes áreas, priorizando projetos de maior impacto e alinhados às estratégias da organização.
Promover uma cultura de decisões baseadas em dados, fortalecendo o valor da área de Business Intelligence na empresa.
Requisitos e qualificações
Formação:
Ensino superior completo em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Matemática, Estatística, Administração ou áreas correlatas.
Pós-graduação ou MBA em áreas relacionadas a Inteligência de Negócios, Análise de Dados ou Ciência de Dados é um diferencial.
Experiência:
Vivência anterior em funções de análise de dados, desenvolvimento de relatórios e dashboards.
Experiência no setor farmacêutico ou em empresas de bens de consumo, varejo ou consultorias de dados será considerada um diferencial.
Conhecimentos técnicos:
Domínio de ferramentas de BI (ex.: Power BI, Tableau, Qlik Sense) e Excel avançado.
Habilidades em SQL e bancos de dados relacionais (ex.: BQ, Oracle, SQL Server, MySQL).
Conhecimento de metodologias de ETL, modelagem de dados e, de preferência, linguagens de programação como Python ou R.
Familiaridade com indicadores e análises específicas do setor farmacêutico (market share, auditorias de demanda (IQVIA, Close-up, Scanntech, etc.).
Competências comportamentais:
Raciocínio analítico e crítico, com capacidade de transformar dados em insights de valor.
Comunicação clara, sabendo adaptar a linguagem para públicos técnicos e não técnicos.
Organização e atenção aos detalhes para lidar com grande volume de dados.
Proatividade e agilidade para lidar com demandas de diferentes áreas simultaneamente.
Trabalho em equipe e interesse em compartilhar conhecimento.

Quer fazer parte de umas das maiores indústria farmacêutica do Brasil, ser desafiado, aprender e vivenciar uma rotina com times cheios de vontade de fazer acontecer?

Com a oportunidade de Analista de BI Sênior vamos proporcionar cada vez mais saúde e bem-estar para todo o Brasil! Vem ser Cimed!

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Descrição geral do cargo

O(a) Analista de BI é responsável por extrair, organizar, analisar e interpretar dados para gerar insights e suportar tomadas de decisão. Trabalha em conjunto com diversas áreas (Marketing, Vendas, Inteligência de Mercado, Pesquisa &
column2:
Desenvolvimento, TI, Finanças) para mapear e compreender tendências, avaliar a eficácia de estratégias comerciais e propor melhorias baseadas em dados.

Principais responsabilidades:

Coleta e Organização de Dados

  • Realizar a extração de dados a partir de múltiplas fontes (sistemas internos, bancos de dados, plataformas de mercado, relatórios de auditoria etc.).
  • Garantir a integridade, qualidade e consistência dos dados, utilizando técnicas de limpeza e padronização.


Desenvolvimento de Relatórios e Dashboards

  • Criar e manter relatórios e dashboards interativos em ferramentas de BI ( Power BI), facilitando a visualização de indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) para diferentes áreas da empresa.
  • Personalizar e automatizar atualizações de relatórios, gerando análises em tempo hábil para a tomada de decisão.


Análise e Interpretação de Dados

  • Aplicar técnicas de análise estatística e modelagem preditiva para identificar tendências de mercado, comportamentos de clientes, oportunidades de negócio e riscos.
  • Gerar insights e recomendações claras e objetivas, embasadas em dados, para suportar estratégias de marketing, vendas, pesquisa clínica e desenvolvimento de novos produtos.


Suporte à Inteligência de Mercado

  • Colaborar com a equipe de Inteligência de Mercado para monitorar concorrência, tendências regulatórias (ANVISA), inovações tecnológicas e variações de demanda.
  • Participar na construção de análises sobre pipeline de produtos, performance de mercado e estimativas de vendas.


Aprimoramento Contínuo e Governança de Dados

  • Contribuir para a melhoria dos processos de coleta e análise de dados, sugerindo novas ferramentas ou metodologias.
  • Adotar e promover práticas de governança de dados, garantindo segurança, acessibilidade e conformidade com políticas internas e normas regulatórias.


Colaboração com Equipes Multidisciplinares

  • Atuar como facilitador no uso de soluções de BI por áreas parceiras, oferecendo treinamentos e suporte técnico.
  • Alinhar-se com equipes de TI e Infraestrutura para garantir a melhor performance dos sistemas de BI e a integração dos dados.


Principais desafios do cargo:

  • Garantir a confiabilidade e agilidade na geração de relatórios e análises em um ambiente competitivo e regulado.
  • Manter-se atualizado(a) sobre novas ferramentas e técnicas de análise de dados, visando aprimorar processos e sistemas internos.
  • Equilibrar demandas de diferentes áreas, priorizando projetos de maior impacto e alinhados às estratégias da organização.
  • Promover uma cultura de decisões baseadas em dados, fortalecendo o valor da área de Business Intelligence na empresa.


Requisitos e qualificações

Formação:

  • Ensino superior completo em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Matemática, Estatística, Administração ou áreas correlatas.
  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em áreas relacionadas a Inteligência de Negócios, Análise de Dados ou Ciência de Dados é um diferencial.


Experiência:

  • Vivência anterior em funções de análise de dados, desenvolvimento de relatórios e dashboards.
  • Experiência no setor farmacêutico ou em empresas de bens de consumo, varejo ou consultorias de dados será considerada um diferencial.


Conhecimentos técnicos:

  • Domínio de ferramentas de BI (ex.: Power BI, Tableau, Qlik Sense) e Excel avançado.
  • Habilidades em SQL e bancos de dados relacionais (ex.: BQ, Oracle, SQL Server, MySQL).
  • Conhecimento de metodologias de ETL, modelagem de dados e, de preferência, linguagens de programação como Python ou R.
  • Familiaridade com indicadores e análises específicas do setor farmacêutico (market share, auditorias de demanda (IQVIA, Close-up, Scanntech, etc.).


Competências comportamentais:

  • Raciocínio analítico e crítico, com capacidade de transformar dados em insights de valor.
  • Comunicação clara, sabendo adaptar a linguagem para públicos técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Organização e atenção aos detalhes para lidar com grande volume de dados.
  • Proatividade e agilidade para lidar com demandas de diferentes áreas simultaneamente.
  • Trabalho em equipe e interesse em compartilhar conhecimento.


Informações adicionais

  • No processo pode ser aplicado teste técnico de acordo com a necessidade da área.
  • Local: Faria Lima, São Paulo - SP
  • Horário: das 08h30 às 17h30
  • Modalidade de Trabalho: 100% Presencial

What You’ll Do
Core Goal: Deliver excellent customer solutions via reliable, high-quality data analyses, strong communication, and top-tier problem solving

You will be a hire at our early-stage, profitable startup. We are still figuring out many aspects of this business, and we’re looking for a hands-on thought partner to help build the company while managing a client relationship day-to-day. We want to be upfront: this is not a 9-5 job, and it’s
really difficult at times, but our shared mission to serve is what we rally around.
Client Relationships

You’ll be the primary point of contact for one client to start, which is a US-based company. At the beginning, you will be working on your own. However, our goal is for this role to grow into a people management role. Our analysts have previously worked as receptionists, delivery drivers, waiters, and in other non-technical roles. You’re not just going to be teaching them SQL/analysis/critical thinking, but also how to navigate a different culture in their second language (English) and gain confidence in their new skills. Most importantly, you’ll be transforming their lives by changing their mindsets about what’s possible through coaching them to independently solve hard problems. If done right, we believe you will be empowering a new learner to sustainably 10x their income in 2 years or less.

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.
Data at Brex

The Data organization develops insights, models, and data infrastructure for teams across Brex, including Sales, Marketing, Product, Engineering, and Operations. Our Data Scientists, Analysts, and Engineers work together to make data—and insights derived from data—a core asset across the company.
What You’ll Do

As a Data Analyst II (DA), you will play a central role in enhancing the operational tracking and reporting capabilities of different business teams across Brex. You will work closely with Data Scientists, Data Engineers, and partner teams to drive meaningful insights for the business through visualizations, self-service tools, and ad-hoc analyses. This is a high-impact role in a fast-paced fintech environment where your work will directly influence strategic decisions.
Where you’ll work

This role will be based in our São Paulo office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!
Responsibilities
Apply data visualization and storytelling skills in creating business intelligence solutions (such as Looker and/or Hex dashboards) that enable actionable insights.
Perform ad-hoc analyses and deep dives to investigate business questions, surface trends, and provide data-driven recommendations.
Develop self-service data tools and processes that empower business stakeholders to independently monitor the performance and health of their respective areas.

Collaborate closely with Data Scientists and Data Engineers to identify data sources, enable data pipelines, and support the development of analytical data models that operationalize reports and dashboards.
Implement and maintain rigorous data quality checks to ensure the integrity and robustness of datasets used across dashboards, reports, and analyses.
Partner with various departments—including Sales, Operations, Product, and Finance—to understand their data needs and deliver tailored analyses and reporting that support strategic planning.
Contribute to the automation of recurring analyses and reporting workflows using Python.
Requirements
4+ years of experience in data analytics or a related role in a professional setting.
3+ years of experience working directly with Sales, Operations, Product, or equivalent business teams.
Fluency in SQL to manipulate data and perform complex analyses (CTEs, window functions, joins across large datasets).
Proficiency in Python for data analysis, automation, and scripting (Pandas, NumPy, and similar libraries).

São milhões de alunos, seguidores e assinantes em jornadas bem diferentes entre si, e é o time de dados que ajuda produto, conteúdo, marketing e CRM a entenderem o que está funcionando, o que não está e por quê.


Estamos buscando um(a) Analista de Dados Sênior para assumir análises de ponta a ponta e ajudar a estruturar os dados e as métricas oficiais dessa vertical.


O que você vai fazer

  • Conduzir análises completas, da pergunta de negócio até a recomendação final
  • Decidir quais dados usar em cada situação — e, quando eles não existem, desenhar os testes e a instrumentação necessários (A/B em funis, pesquisas com alunos, novos eventos de produto)
  • Apoiar as lideranças de produto, conteúdo, marketing e CRM em decisões baseadas em dados
  • Trabalhar com grandes volumes de dados no BigQuery, escrevendo queries eficientes, com atenção a custo e performance (partições, clusterização)
  • Modelar e transformar dados com dbt, construindo junto com a engenharia de dados os datasets e métricas oficiais da vertical
  • Versionar seu trabalho em Git, abrir e revisar Pull Requests, e manter queries, modelos e notebooks documentados e reprodutíveis
  • Usar SQL, Python e IA no dia a dia de extração, análise e automação (por aqui, usamos Claude)
  • Analisar a jornada completa do aluno — do seguidor no Instagram e YouTube ao assinante ativo: lançamento, onboarding, engajamento, renovação e indicação
  • Acompanhar métricas-chave dos produtos de educação: MRR, churn, LTV/CAC, conversão, consumo e conclusão de conteúdo, evasão e NPS
  • Identificar oportunidades de cross-sell do aluno para os produtos de investimento do grupo (Grão e Portfel)
  • Mentorar analistas menos experientes do time


O que buscamos

  • Experiência sólida em análise de dados, com histórico de análises que efetivamente mudaram decisões de negócio
  • Perfil híbrido: domina o negócio e tem autonomia técnica para implementar as próprias soluções, sem depender de terceiros
  • SQL avançado (BigQuery é um plus) e Python para análise de dados
  • Experiência com dbt para modelagem e transformação de dados
  • Vivência com Git e fluxo de PRs, incluindo revisão de código de outras pessoas
  • Conhecimento em Databricks e Snowflake é diferencial
  • Visão de negócio: entende riscos, oportunidades, e como produto, engenharia e áreas comerciais se conectam
  • Familiaridade com assinaturas, edtech, funis de lançamento ou mercado financeiro é um diferencial
  • Consciência do impacto do próprio trabalho na experiência do aluno
  • Abertura para dar e receber feedback
  • Adaptabilidade para transitar entre marcas e modelos de negócio bem diferentes dentro da mesma vertical
  • Um perfil que agregue à cultura do Grupo Primo

Responsabilidades e atribuições
Mapear, compreender e documentar as bases, fontes de dados e regras de negócio utilizadas pela área de Combate à Fraude.
Desenvolver consultas em SQL para extração, integração, tratamento e validação de grandes volumes de dados.
Utilizar Python para análises exploratórias, tratamento de bases e desenvolvimento de rotinas automatizadas.
Construir e manter dashboards no Tableau, assegurando confiabilidade, rastreabilidade e atualização das informações.
Estruturar indicadores de volume, produtividade, capacidade operacional, SLA, tempo de análise, criticidade e complexidade dos casos.
Desenvolver critérios que permitam mensurar a produtividade de forma ponderada, considerando o nível de dificuldade, o risco e o esforço envolvido em cada análise.
Criar indicadores estratégicos relacionados a perdas evitadas, valores recuperados ou preservados, custos de judicialização e efetividade das ações corretivas e preventivas.
Analisar ocorrências por produto, canal, jornada, modalidade e classificação, identificando padrões, tendências, anomalias e vulnerabilidades.
Apoiar a identificação de causas-raiz e a elaboração de recomendações para Prevenção à Fraude, Riscos Operacionais, Produtos, Atendimento, Jurídico e demais áreas relacionadas.
Desenvolver automações e soluções de RPA para reduzir atividades manuais e aumentar a eficiência e a segurança dos processos.
Atender, de forma transversal, às frentes de Diagnóstico e Certificação e de Investigação e Repressão.
Documentar consultas, automações, regras, indicadores e procedimentos, garantindo a continuidade e a disseminação do conhecimento.
Requisitos e qualificações
Requisitos
Ensino superior completo em Ciência de Dados, Estatística, Matemática, Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia, Economia, Administração ou áreas correlatas.
Experiência em prevenção, diagnóstico, investigação ou combate à fraude.
Experiência consistente em Data Analytics, Business Intelligence ou análise de dados aplicada a operações.
Domínio de SQL para consultas, cruzamentos, validação e manipulação de grandes bases.
Conhecimento prático de Python para análise, tratamento de dados e automação.
Experiência na construção e manutenção de dashboards e indicadores gerenciais.
Vivência com automação de processos e/ou RPA.
Conhecimento de processos de ETL, integração, qualidade e validação de dados.
Experiência na construção de indicadores de produtividade, eficiência, SLA, capacidade ou desempenho operacional.
Diferenciais
Vivência em bancos, fintechs, instituições financeiras, adquirentes, meios de pagamento ou seguradoras.
Conhecimento de produtos bancários, como cartão de crédito, crédito consignado, contas PF e PJ, boletos, câmbio e jornadas digitais.

Building/maintaining Partner Marketing Data Hub for partners
Insights & Impact
Translate data into actionable recommendations for:
Campaign Development needs
Partner Marketing follow up
Partner level recommendations
Identify high-performing industries, segments, accounts for partners
Surface gaps in campaigns or coverage and influence new campaign development or optimization
Hypothesis-Driven Thinking
Actively explore data to answer: “What is this telling us, and what should we do differently?”

Develop hypotheses, validate through analysis and
Bring forward recommendation and proposals, for teams to act upon

Improve data visibility and enable more scalable, data-driven execution
Advanced Analytics
Introduce predictive insights (e.g., partner performance, campaign recommendations)
Enable automated insights like trend and anomaly detection
Focus on practical, high-impact analytics, not complex custom AI builds
Partner & Process Understanding
Engage with stakeholders and partners to understand how data is created, used, and experienced in real workflows
Use this context to improve data quality, reporting accuracy, and insight relevance
Combine data analysis with real-world understanding to explain why performance looks the way it does
Collaboration
Partner with global content, regional marketing, partner enablement, Opportunity Development and analytics teams to drive measurable impact to partner pipeline

Required
4+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or a related field within or supporting B2B marketing

Strong proficiency in BI tools such as Power BI, demonstrated by the ability to architect scalable star schema data models, author advanced DAX and Power Query logic, and implement robust security and governance protocols to deliver automated, high-performance enterprise insights
Strong dashboarding and data visualization storytelling skills
Proficiency in SQL and working with large data sets
Experience building dashboards and delivering business insights
Strong communication skills with the ability to explain data to non-technical audiences, visualization of data.
Preferred
Ability to connect data insights to business outcomes and recommendations
Experience with predictive analytics or machine learning (Python, R, etc.)
Familiarity with marketing, sales, or partner/channel metrics
Experience working with tools such as CRM systems, campaign platforms, or content platforms (e.g., Highspot)
Experience integrating data across multiple systems
Experience working with generative AI tools
Mendix experience

Identificar gargalos operacionais e oportunidades de melhoria por meio da análise de dados.

Como será o seu dia a dia

Compreender as solicitações dos stakeholders e ser capaz de identificar se o entregável responde à pergunta ou resolve o problema, além disso, ser proativo para melhorar as soluções solicitadas e obter um impacto mais significativo.
Desenvolver entregas técnicas operacionais com excelente qualidade e agilidade e participar ativamente de análises estratégicas que direcionem o negócio e a empresa.
Construir um bom relacionamento com os stakeholders e colegas, possibilitando melhores soluções e impactando o negócio.

Desenvolver visualizações de dados que respondam a perguntas ou contem histórias direcionadas às necessidades da empresa.
Utilizar a efetividade da estrutura do banco de dados e ser capaz de aprimorar e automatizar fluxos de trabalho para melhorar soluções e processos.
Seguir e propor melhorias nos padrões de dados da empresa, como documentação, estrutura, indentação e organização.
Ágil na execução de códigos organizados, com bom desempenho, que extraiam dados corretos para solucionar problemas.
Requirements

Gradução completa (estatística/ matemática/ ciência da computação/ engenharia/ economia/ negócios)
Conhecimento de linguagens de análise de dados (SQL, Python)
Atuação com grandes conjuntos de dados e números e ambientes de big data
Conhecimento em modelagem, preparação e manipulação de dados
Experiência com ferramentas de visualização de dados para reportar dados
Experiência com gestão de stakeholders e desafios de negócios
Inglês intermediário

Vale Transporte, Vale Mobilidade ou Estacionamento no local

Zenklub e Conexa
Assistência Pet
Benefícios exclusivos para quem tem filhos
Bônus anual discricionário, atrelado à performance.

Entra a far parte del Reinvention Partner Industry & Enterprise in ambito Data&AI nel settore Public Service. Lavorerai con tecnologie innovative su progetti entusiasmanti, collaborando con numerosi enti governativi centrali, locali e comunitari per garantire che le aspettative e le esigenze della comunità siano al centro dei servizi pubblici. Lavorare in Todis, significa lavorare in un ambiente dinamico, organizzato ed innovativo.
La nostra convinzione è che ogni individuo possa portare un contributo unico al successo della nostra organizzazione.
In Todis accogliamo il cambiamento attraverso l’innovazione, la formazione e la sperimentazione, perseguendo il miglioramento continuo.
La nostra Vision: essere il luogo più accogliente dove fare la spesa e dove trovare prodotti buoni, genuini e alla portata di tutti.

La nostra Mission: selezionare prodotti e produttori per la marca privata di qualità e al giusto prezzo. Privilegiare i prodotti freschi e provenienti dai nostri territori. Lavorare ogni giorno in partnership con i nostri imprenditori.
Il nostro Purpose: per dare a tutti la possibilità di migliorare la qualità della vita e far fiorire l’economia locale per le generazioni di oggi e domani.
I nostri Valori: trasparenza ed integrità senso di responsabilità per il bene comune. Appartenenza e Lealtà Generosità e vicinanza, miglioramento continuo con ottimismo e fiducia nel futuro.
Posizione:
In IGES Srl crediamo che il giusto prezzo sia il punto d’incontro tra il valore dei nostri prodotti e la fiducia dei nostri clienti.

Siamo alla ricerca di un/una Pricing Analyst che, attraverso l'analisi dei dati e l'utilizzo di tecnologie all'avanguardia (Minderest), contribuisca a definire le strategie di prezzo per i nostri 300 punti vendita.
La risorsa avrà l'obiettivo di ottimizzare la competitività di Todis sul mercato, garantendo al contempo la marginalità aziendale.
In IGES, questa figura non è un semplice ""gestore di listini"", ma un consulente strategico capace di leggere le dinamiche del mercato in tempo reale.
In particolare, siamo alla ricerca di una figura dedicata e capace che lavorando a stretto contatto con l’area Acquisti e la Direzione Generale, si occuperà di:
Monitoraggio Competitivo : Utilizzo quotidiano della piattaforma Minderest per il monitoraggio dei prezzi della concorrenza e l’analisi del posizionamento di mercato.
Analisi Strategica : Elaborazione di report periodici sugli scostamenti di prezzo e suggerimento di azioni correttive per bilanciare volumi di vendita e margini.
Gestione Elasticità : Analisi dell'elasticità della domanda per le diverse categorie merceologiche (freschi, grocery, marca privata).
Supporto alle Promozioni: Collaborazione con l'ufficio Marketing e Acquisti per valutare l'efficacia delle campagne promozionali e il loro impatto sul posizionamento di lungo periodo.
Ottimizzazione Processi: Contribuire all'automazione dei flussi di aggiornamento prezzi tra i sistemi di analisi e l'ERP aziendale.
Requisiti:
Il/la nostro/a candidato/a ideale è in possesso delle seguenti caratteristiche:
Competenze Tecniche:
Esperienza: Almeno 2-3 anni in ruoli di analisi dati, preferibilmente nel settore GDO o Retail.
Padronanza avanzata di Excel (Pivot, Power Query, macro) per la manipolazione e pulizia di grandi dataset

Sistemi Gestionali (ERP): Conoscenza operativa di sistemi gestionali strutturati (preferibile esperienza su ambiente AS400) per l'estrazione e la verifica dei dati transazionali e delle anagrafiche prodotto.

Price Intelligence: Conoscenza (anche teorica o su piattaforme analoghe) di strumenti per il monitoraggio dei competitor come Minderest, con capacità di interpretare alert di prezzo e variazioni di assortimento.

Business Intelligence: Familiarità con piattaforme di Intelligent Planning ed EPM (costituirà titolo preferenziale la conoscenza di Board) per l'elaborazione di simulazioni ""what-if"", analisi della marginalità e visualizzazione di dashboard strategiche.
Data Visualization: Capacità di trasformare l'output dei sistemi (Board/Minderest) in presentazioni chiare e sintetiche per il supporto alle decisioni della Direzione Generale.
Competenze Trasversali:
Forte orientamento analitico e attenzione al dettaglio.
Capacità di sintesi per presentare dati complessi in modo chiaro alla Direzione Generale.
Proattività e curiosità verso le nuove tecnologie e le dinamiche del largo consumo.
Altro: Passione per il mondo GDO, orientamento al risultato e attitudine al lavoro di squadra.
Altre informazioni:
Retribuzione : RAL compresa tra € 35.000,00 e € 45.000,00 annui, commisurata all'esperienza e al livello delle competenze maturate.
Contratto: CCNL Commercio (CNEL - H011)

Siamo alla ricerca di un/una Pricing Analyst che, attraverso l'analisi dei dati e l'utilizzo di tecnologie all'avanguardia (Minderest), contribuisca a definire le strategie di prezzo per i nostri 300 punti vendita.

La risorsa avrà l'obiettivo di ottimizzare la competitività di Todis sul mercato, garantendo al contempo la marginalità aziendale.

In IGES, questa figura non è un semplice ""gestore di listini"", ma un consulente strategico capace di leggere le dinamiche del mercato in tempo reale.

In particolare, siamo alla ricerca di una figura dedicata e capace che lavorando a stretto contatto con l’area Acquisti e la Direzione Generale, si occuperà di:

  • Monitoraggio Competitivo : Utilizzo quotidiano della piattaforma Minderest per il monitoraggio dei prezzi della concorrenza e l’analisi del posizionamento di mercato.
  • Analisi Strategica : Elaborazione di report periodici sugli scostamenti di prezzo e suggerimento di azioni correttive per bilanciare volumi di vendita e margini.
  • Gestione Elasticità : Analisi dell'elasticità della domanda per le diverse categorie merceologiche (freschi, grocery, marca privata).
  • Supporto alle Promozioni: Collaborazione con l'ufficio Marketing e Acquisti per valutare l'efficacia delle campagne promozionali e il loro impatto sul posizionamento di lungo periodo.
  • Ottimizzazione Processi: Contribuire all'automazione dei flussi di aggiornamento prezzi tra i sistemi di analisi e l'ERP aziendale.

Requisiti:

Il/la nostro/a candidato/a ideale è in possesso delle seguenti caratteristiche:

Competenze Tecniche:

  • Esperienza: Almeno 2-3 anni in ruoli di analisi dati, preferibilmente nel settore GDO o Retail.
  • Padronanza avanzata di Excel (Pivot, Power Query, macro) per la manipolazione e pulizia di grandi dataset
  • Sistemi Gestionali (ERP): Conoscenza operativa di sistemi gestionali strutturati (preferibile esperienza su ambiente AS400) per l'estrazione e la verifica dei dati transazionali e delle anagrafiche prodotto.
  • Price Intelligence: Conoscenza (anche teorica o su piattaforme analoghe) di strumenti per il monitoraggio dei competitor come Minderest, con capacità di interpretare alert di prezzo e variazioni di assortimento.
  • Business Intelligence: Familiarità con piattaforme di Intelligent Planning ed EPM (costituirà titolo preferenziale la conoscenza di Board) per l'elaborazione di simulazioni ""what-if"", analisi della marginalità e visualizzazione di dashboard strategiche.
  • Data Visualization: Capacità di trasformare l'output dei sistemi (Board/Minderest) in presentazioni chiare e sintetiche per il supporto alle decisioni della Direzione Generale.

Competenze Trasversali:

  • Forte orientamento analitico e attenzione al dettaglio.
  • Capacità di sintesi per presentare dati complessi in modo chiaro alla Direzione Generale.
  • Proattività e curiosità verso le nuove tecnologie e le dinamiche del largo consumo.
  • Altro: Passione per il mondo GDO, orientamento al risultato e attitudine al lavoro di squadra.

Altre informazioni:

Retribuzione : RAL compresa tra € 35.000,00 e € 45.000,00 annui, commisurata all'esperienza e al livello delle competenze maturate.

Contratto: CCNL Commercio (CNEL - H011)

Sede di lavoro : Fiano Romano (RM)

I candidati sono invitati a leggere l'informativa privacy ai sensi degli articoli 13 e 14 del Reg. EU 679/2016.

Job Description

The JJMT Transformation function is responsible for designing and realizing the future-state supply chain network for Johnson & Johnson MedTech. This function includes oversight of consolidation and rationalization actions for the global distribution network, a strategic shift toward an asset-light model, and the build-out of new, future-looking logistics capabilities including partner management, network design, systems strategy, and defining the transition standards required to sustain performance in the future state. The team operates centrally, working in close partnership with regional Deliver teams across EMEA, APAC, LATAM, and North America.
PURPOSE OF POSITION

As part of the Logistics Partner Management pillar within the Transformation function, this role supports analytics, reporting, and operational tracking activities related to 3PL partner management across the global distribution network.

The position is responsible for supporting data analysis, KPI tracking, reporting development, and operational insights generation to enable visibility into partner performance, operational execution, and adherence to defined standards and expectations. This includes supporting governance processes through preparation of analytics, tracking partner-related metrics, and identifying trends, gaps, and improvement opportunities across the logistics partner network.

The role works closely with regional teams and cross-functional stakeholders to support data-driven decision-making, operational transparency, and continuous improvement within the asset-light operating model.
RESPONSIBILITIES / PRINCIPAL DUTIES (Essential Functions)
Support development and maintenance of reporting, dashboards, and analytics related to 3PL partner operations and performance
Collect, consolidate, validate, and analyze operational and performance data from regional teams and logistics partners
Track KPIs and operational metrics related to service, operational execution, governance, and partner adherence to defined expectations
Support governance forums through preparation of reporting materials, analytical insights, and performance summaries
Identify trends, risks, gaps, and improvement opportunities through analysis of operational and partner-related data
Maintain standardized reporting templates, tracking files, and data repositories supporting partner management activities
Support issue tracking and follow-up activities, ensuring visibility into action items, risks, and operational escalations
Collaborate with regional teams and stakeholders to ensure consistency and accuracy of operational and performance reporting
Support continuous improvement initiatives through analysis of operational performance trends and process effectiveness
Assist in documentation and standardization of reporting methodologies, KPI definitions, and analytical frameworks
Education/Experience
Education and/or additional training:
A minimum of a Bachelor’s degree is required
A Master's degree in Supply Chain, Operations, Business, Engineering, or a related field is preferred
Experience And Functional Competencies
Minimum 2–5 years of relevant experience in supply chain, logistics, analytics, reporting, or operations support roles
Experience working with operational data, KPI reporting, dashboards, or performance tracking
Exposure to warehouse, transportation, or 3PL-managed logistics environments is preferred
Strong analytical skills, including ability to interpret operational data and generate actionable insights
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint required

Sarai coinvolto in attività di raccolta ed analisi dei business requirement, analizzando consistenza e accuratezza dei requisiti. Analizzerai le fonti dati implementando servizi di progettazione dati con competenza e metodologia in ambito Data Modeling.
Svilupperai sistemi di analisi delle performance, report interattivi e

dashboard analitiche con tecnologie come QlikView, QlikSense, Tableau, PowerBI, SAP BO per elaborare le analisi e rappresentare i risultati, implementando le metriche più efficaci al fine di costruire validi strumenti di supporto alle decisioni di business.

Tra le tue responsabilità potranno anche esserci l’estrazione e rappresentazione sintetica di analisi complesse realizzate da altre figure professionali (es. Data Scientist, Data Governance expert, Data Architect, Data Project Manager).

Ti sarà richiesto, in modo commisurato alla tua seniority, di dimostrare ed evolvere le capacità di costruire relazioni con clienti, vendor di tecnologie, partner, assicurare il raggiungimento della migliore elaborazione dei risultati delle tue analisi comunicandoli efficacemente a colleghi e Clienti e, per finire, il coordinamento di analisti più junior all’interno di team articolati.

Conoscenza di almeno una delle tecnologie di data processing and extraction Big Data (Hive, Pig, Flume, Sqoop, Python basico)

Conoscenza dei principali servizi dei Cloud provider (Google Cloud Platform, Azure, AWS) normalmente coinvolti nel disegno di piattaforme di BI (BigQuery, DataFlow, Synapse Anaytics, Azure Analysis Services, Data Factory, Data Bricks, ecc)

Perchè Bip?
People at the center of our culture
Fiducia e collaborazione, imprenditorialità e coraggio, meritocrazia e sviluppo guidano la crescita delle nostre persone.
Lavorare in BIP è un'esperienza sfidante, in cui il merito paga e l'innovazione avviene attraverso idee coraggiose, collaborazione e un rapporto di fiducia con i nostri clienti.
Challenging yourself

Avrai la possibilità di metterti alla prova in contesti progettuali diversi in termini di ambito, natura delle attività e stakeholders coinvolti. Vedrai valorizzato il tuo spirito di iniziativa, la tua passione, l’autonomia e la capacità di assumerti responsabilità e metterti in gioco.
Unlocking your potential
Potrai partecipare a + di 300 corsi formativi all’avanguardia per accrescere le tue competenze su tecnologie e temi di business emergenti.
Work-life Integration
Troverai una policy che supporta lo smartworking fino al 100% del proprio tempo e favorisce il work-life integration
Diversity & Inclusion
Valorizziamo l'unicità e ci impegniamo a garantire che tutti i dipendenti abbiano pari opportunità di dare un contributo ed esprimere al massimo il potenziale nell'ambiente di lavoro.

Il nostro approccio alla diversità e all'inclusione si fonda sui principi di etica e integrità e rappresenta il fattore determinante per lo sviluppo di orizzonti, di crescita personale e aziendale, più ampi.
Promuoviamo l'inserimento e l'integrazione lavorativa delle persone appartenenti alle categorie protette - in base a quanto disciplinato dalla legge 68/99-.
Next Steps
Una volta ricevuto il tuo cv ci prenderemo del tempo per valutarlo attentamente.
Se c’è un match con questa o con altre posizioni aperte all’interno del Gruppo, ti contatteremo per iniziare la nostra conoscenza reciproca.
L’iter di selezione comprende generalmente un colloquio con HR, un colloquio tecnico con un line manager ed un eventuale colloquio con un Partner.
L’ordine e il numero delle interviste potrebbero variare a seconda delle esigenze di recruiting.
In alternativa, saremo felici di conservare il tuo CV nel nostro database per poterlo rivalutare per altre opportunità future.
Se dovessi identificare tu stesso ulteriori posizioni di tuo interesse ed in linea con il tuo profilo, aspettiamo la tua candidatura per poterla valutare nuovamente.
Su di Noi
Nati nel 2003, abbiamo raccolto e valorizzato l’esperienza storica della consulenza e abbiamo aggiunto due ingredienti chiave: l’innovazione e la digitalizzazione.

Grazie a questo percorso siamo oggi oltre 3500 professionisti, presenti in 13 Paesi, con oltre 4500 progetti alle spalle e le conoscenze più all’avanguardia nell'ambito della Digital Transformation, Data Science, Cybersecurity, Industry 4.0, IOT e di tutte le Disruptive Technologies che mettiamo a servizio di ogni settore di mercato.
Aiutiamo i nostri clienti a fare la differenza creando qualità su larga scala attraverso una formula che opera su tre leve: Valore, Persone e Tecnologia.

Crediamo nel valore dell’eccellenza, che è la bussola su cui orientiamo il nostro agire, e adottiamo un approccio etico e leale nei confronti di quante e quanti scelgono di lavorare con noi, promuovendo un ambiente in cui le persone possano crescere insieme, grazie alla contaminazione tra competenze diverse.

Schumacher & Co. is an innovative interior design company that is disrupting the$150 billion-dollar global interior design industry. We are a technological leader on the design frontier, constantly pushing boundaries and striving for excellence. With over 500+ employees and growing, we are driven by a shared belief that design transforms life.We are dedicated to the mission of helping our customers “celebrate the feeling of home”. F. Schumacher & Co designs and produces some of the most beautiful fabrics, wallcoverings, trims, rugs, furniture, and accessories in the world. Our portfolio of products is broad, but they are united by a passion for design, a thirst for what is next, an appreciation for what’s come before, a drive to make our products with enormous care and attention for detail. F. Schumacher & Co is a globally recognized company with a myriad of showrooms both domestically and internationally.

Our Competitive Advantage In The Industry Is Our People. We Believe That Our Employees Are Our Most Important Assets. F. Schumacher & Co Is Deeply Anchored In Our Company Core Values Which Are As Follows
Preserve Our Entrepreneurial Spirit
Take Ownership & Accountability
Be Solutions-Oriented
Demonstrate Courage
Practice Adaptability
Embrace Collaboration

We empower our employees to live these values daily because we understand how it will positively impact the customer's journey. F. Schumacher & Co., also known as FSCO, is the parent company to many brands within our portfolio. This role is a 12 month contract and is a part of Data Insights & AI team
Role Overview

We're looking for a hands-on, Senior Quantitative Analyst, Product Portfolio (Statistical Modeling) to own analytics and reporting in support of our Portfolio Development team, with a specific focus on SKU productivity & capital allocation across a portfolio of 20,000+ SKUs and growing. This role will report directly to the Sr. Director of AI & Data Insights, but is expected to work directly with the CEO & Chief of Staff on a day-to-day basis.

This is not a role for someone who takes data at face value. You'll need to distinguish real signal from noise (e.g., a SKU selling poorly because it's out of stock, not because demand is weak), and when you find data that's wrong or inconsistent, you'll have the access and judgment to go into Snowflake and fix it — not just flag it and wait.
What You’ll Do
Work hands-on with CEO & Product Strategy stakeholders to understand key strategic questions, and then build analysis and reporting to address them directly

Use statistical methods (e.g. conjoint analysis, multivariate regression) to identify which product attributes and characteristics (e.g., color, pattern, material, price point, availability) drive productivity, and translate that into data-driven guidance on where the portfolio should expand, contract or shift
Cut through data noise at scale: systematically identify and control for confounders like stock-outs, new/discontinued SKUs, and seasonality so reported trends reflect real pattern performance

Identify data inconsistencies at the source (e.g., ERP, web, product master data) and directly and systematically correct records in Snowflake and work with upstream platform owners to improve the accuracy of source data and downstream analytics
Present findings clearly and independently to executive audiences, adapting the message for technical or non-technical stakeholders
Recommend and maintain recurring analytics & reporting to provide accurate and timely snapshot of SKU productivity
Use AI across your own workflow to explore data faster, automate repetitive reporting, catch errors, and multiply output given the scale and growth of the SKU portfolio
What We're Looking For
2-5 years in data science, analytics, statistics in similar SKU-driven businesses

Solid grounding in statistics or operations research (e.g. regression, hypothesis testing, multivariate analysis, optimization). Able to move beyond descriptive reporting to model relationships between variables and quantify drivers, not just flag correlations
Strong SQL and Python, with hands-on Snowflake experience including writing back to correct or clean production data (not just read-only querying)
A track record of presenting findings and challenging assumptions directly with senior stakeholders and executives
Independent executor — sets analysis priorities against business goals without waiting for direction, and ships accurate, high-impact work in a timely manner
Curiosity — asks why the numbers look the way they do and keeps digging until the answer holds up, rather than reporting the first number that looks plausible
Thinks in terms of SKU-level economics: sell-through, margin, inventory position, lifecycle stage — and knows how to separate a true productivity problem from a data artifact
Treats data quality as part of the job, digging into root causes and correcting them directly rather than working around bad data
Hands-on experience applying AI/ML in a business context for task automation - automating repetitive analysis to spend more time on judgment calls
Strong English communication skills and a high ownership mindset
Nice to Have
Experience with Power BI or similar BI tools alongside Snowflake
Exposure to margin, pricing, or demand forecasting data
Experience in retail, e-commerce, or luxury/home furnishings goods
What We Offer
Competitive salary and benefits, based on experience
Fully remote work within Europe, with optional time in our NYC office (1–2 weeks per year)
Direct visibility with the CEO, with real influence on Product Strategy and Merchandising decisions
Collaborative, inclusive, and low-ego working environment

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to diversity, inclusion, and equality in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, race, color, age, national origin, religion, physical and mental disability, genetic information, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity/assignment, citizenship, pregnancy or maternity, protected veteran status, or any other status prohibited by applicable national, federal, state or local law.

Monitorare e analizzare le performance dei customer journey digitali, individuando trend, opportunità di ottimizzazione e aree di miglioramento.
Definire KPI e modelli di misurazione, raccogliendo e analizzando dati provenienti da piattaforme CRM, sistemi di Marketing Automation, Digital Analytics e database aziendali.

Estrarre e analizzare dati attraverso query SQL, garantendo qualità, affidabilità e coerenza delle informazioni (Saper utilizzare Python per automatizzare attività di analisi, preparazione dei dati e produzione della reportistica è un plus)
Supportare la pianificazione delle iniziative digitali attraverso analisi, insight e misurazione dei risultati.

Realizzare analisi periodiche e presentazioni direzionali a supporto delle decisioni di business, traducendo gli insight in raccomandazioni operative.

Esperienza nell’analisi delle performance di canali digitali e customer journey.
Ottima conoscenza di SQL per estrazione e analisi dei dati e buona conoscenza di Python per automazione e analisi dati.
Esperienza nella realizzazione di dashboard e reportistica tramite Power BI.
Conoscenza di Google Analytics
Capacità di definire KPI e trasformare dati in insight a supporto delle decisioni.
Ottime capacità analitiche, problem solving e orientamento ai risultati.
Esperienza nella collaborazione con stakeholder di business e team tecnici.
Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese.

5+ anni in ruoli Digital Marketing, Marketing Automation, CRM, Digital Analytics o Business Intelligence.
Esperienza in contesti digital-driven (banking, telco, utilities, retail, e-commerce).

La Squad di Marketing Automation ha il compito di concretizzare sui canali digitali una customer experience sempre più personalizzata e coerente con le esigenze dei clienti e gli obiettivi di business, valorizzando i dati e le piattaforme CRM per supportare l’evoluzione dei customer journey con l’obiettivo di aumentare le digital sales.

Job Description
Research, analysis and collection of reference data for Italian and foreign companies, in particular personal data and International Issuer Codes (LEI, S&P, Moody's, Fitch, Local code).
Identification of economic activity and assignment of international codes (ATECO, NACE, SIC, NAICS, GICS) based on official classifications by competent authorities.
Monitoring and management of the ordinary/extraordinary company operations (name change, re-domiciliation, M&A, etc.).
Monitoring and management of the upcoming companies on the Italian and international market.
Manages the terms of the Board of Directors/ordinary/extraordinary/special shareholders' meetings.
Updates Governance and shareholding of some client portfolios and Italian listed companies.

Analysis of the group structure, resulting in the identification and management of direct parents, ultimate parents, subsidiaries, public control, and public administration - elements fundamental to the majority of ICE products and services.
Basic live stock creation and mapping. creation and management of skeletal/partial ISINs in Database, coming from any internal or external supplier and linking them to the correct issuer.
Manages daily Stock Exchange Notices for topics of interest in the sector.
Monitors the Italian Official Gazette, controls the companies present in the Database and manages the variations.
Interacts with multinational colleagues (London, Dublin, New York) for data control and help desk.

Conduct a systematic analysis of companies subject to international sanctions, with the goal of accurately identifying and registering them within internal systems. This activity supports data integrity.
Design and implement automated solutions to optimize recurring processes in corporate data management and analysis, reducing operational time and enhancing efficiency and data quality.

Ensure daily management and updating of corporate data for Italy and other countries, including monitoring of Borsa Italiana exchange announcements, census of new Italian SPVs, PIR verification, input of Adjusted Non-Performing Loan Rate values, and monitoring of Banca d’Italia codes. Provide biannual support for updating macroeconomic data and geographic areas, and contribute to the maintenance of short company profiles.
Ensure the efficient and accurate management of information related to entities and securities, while guaranteeing the timely and high-quality fulfillment of client requests (daily challenges).
Collaborate with internal teams to enhance request traceability and identify potential workflow optimization opportunities.

Ensure continuous monitoring and updating of companies rated by credit agencies (e.g., Moody’s, S&P, Fitch) within internal systems, guaranteeing accurate registration and classification of rating data and consistency with official sources.
Involved in support activities related to the management of conflicts of interest for pension funds and the management of macroeconomic data extrapolated from EUROSTAT and ISTAT files.
Creates company profiles (business, shareholders, governance, etc.).
Uploads Bank of Italy counterpart codes.
Research of company documentation (Annual Report).

column4:

We move fast and keep things simple. We turn ideas into action, trust people to take ownership, and work as one team to win together with integrity. Our culture is high‑performance, collaborative and focused on getting things done.

The role

At The Magnum Ice Cream Company, Revenue Growth Management is a critical capability that helps us drive profitable growth through data-driven pricing, promotion, assortment and trade investment decisions.

The Revenue Growth Management Specialist will play a key role in translating market, customer and performance data into actionable recommendations that improve net revenue, profitability and sustainable growth. Support the development and execution of Revenue Growth Management strategies across pricing, promotions, assortment and mix.

Monitor promotional effectiveness and recommend actions to maximize return on trade investments.
Develop business cases and financial analyses to support pricing and portfolio decisions.
Partner with Sales, Marketing and Finance teams to embed RGM principles into commercial planning.
Build dashboards, reports and performance tracking tools to monitor key RGM KPIs.
Support annual planning cycles, forecast reviews and customer business planning processes.
Generate actionable insights from internal and external data sources to support strategic decision-making.
Provide fact-based recommendations and challenge commercial assumptions to improve revenue and profit delivery.
We're Looking For Someone Who
Has 3+ years of experience in Revenue Growth Management, Commercial Finance, Category Management or Business Analytics within FMCG or Consumer Goods.
Brings strong skills in data analysis, financial modelling, pricing analytics and stakeholder management.
Has advanced knowledge of Excel and Power BI

Role Description

Are you ready to start an exciting career where you can learn, grow, and make a real difference? LEO Pharma is looking for a Business Insight and SFE Specialist to join our team. In this role, you’ll gain hands-on experience, work alongside cross-functional teams, and contribute to impactful projects within a leading pharmaceutical company. This is your chance to embark on your professional journey in a dynamic and innovative environment. Let’s shape the future of healthcare together!
Join us in creating a future legacy in medical dermatology

At LEO Pharma, we are global leaders in medical dermatology. We have 115 years’ experience in bringing innovation to healthcare. And we are eager to do much more. Each year, close to 100 million people have a better day because of our medicines.

In Finance & Commercial Excellence department we share a “challenge accepted” mindset and are guided by our winning behaviours of simplification, collaboration, and accountability, to achieve our goals.
Your role

As a Business Insight and SFE Specialist, you’ll play a key role in supporting the operational and strategic activities of our commercial and business operations functions. Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:
Providing operational support in commercial activities, including key projects and market data analysis.
Collaborating with the sales and marketing teams to monitor performance and help develop action plans to improve outcomes.
Contributing to cross-functional projects by coordinating with different departments to implement innovative and effective solutions.
Analyzing data and insights using advanced tools to provide actionable recommendations for business strategies.
Preparing detailed reports and support materials for management to assist in decision-making processes.
Identifying opportunities for process improvement and presenting ideas to simplify internal operations and enhance efficiency.
Working on internal systems and platforms to upload, download and analyze data.
Your Qualifications
To succeed in this role, we imagine that you have the following qualifications:
A degree in Economics, Management Engineering, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or related fields.
Proficiency in MS Office, with strong skills in Excel and PowerPoint.
Excellent knowledge of English, both written and spoken.

LEO Pharma is built on collaboration, innovation and curiosity. Is this you? Can you bring this and strong analytical abilities, attention to detail, and organizational skills to help drive meaningful impact and contribute to our mission?
Your new team

At LEO Pharma, you’ll join a team of passionate and experienced professionals who are dedicated to shaping the future of healthcare. As a Business Insight and SFE Specialist, you’ll have the opportunity to collaborate on meaningful projects, work alongside talented colleagues, and gain hands-on experience in a global organization that’s committed to making a difference. Our inclusive and innovative culture ensures you’ll feel supported and inspired every step of the way.
Your application
You do not need to upload a cover letter, but feel free to add a few sentences in your resume or CV on why this position has your interest. Please refrain from adding a photo to your CV.

The annual gross base salary for new hires in this role ranges from EUR 30.000 to EUR 35.000. This range has been established by considering multiple factors such as the candidate’s experience, educational background, unique skill set, and the market value for the position. Employment for this position is governed by the CCNL Chimico Farmaceutico.
More detailed information about the full compensation and benefits package will be shared during the recruitment process.

Compensation is offered within the established range and is calculated based on the candidate’s skills, professional background, and level of expertise. The higher end of the range is typically allocated to individuals with substantial experience or outstanding qualifications that meet the specific demands of the role.
Beyond the skin

Join LEO Pharma, a global leader in medical dermatology, as we go beyond the skin to make a lasting impact. Our innovative approach sets us apart. We are dedicated to leaving a legacy that positively impacts patients, colleagues, and our planet.

At LEO Pharma, we believe in the power of individuals to drive change. Our flat organizational structure empowers you to make a visible impact and offers versatile roles for professional growth. We value diversity and welcome applications from all qualified candidates, recognizing that our different perspectives, backgrounds, and attitudes enable us to make the best decisions. Join our passionate team at LEO Pharma and be yourself as we work together to make a difference.
For certain positions, LEO Pharma might complete a background check conducted by a third party.
